**How You’ll Make an Impact**

As a **Hotel Manager** at a Hilton property, you’re not just leading hotel operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Your responsibilities will include:

* **Lead with Hilton’s commitment to exceptional hospitality:** Oversee all hotel operations to deliver warm, reliable, and hospitable service – ensuring every guest experience is seamless, consistent, and reflective of the brand’s high standards
* **Drive performance and profitability:** Manage revenue, budgets, and cost controls to achieve financial targets while balancing operational efficiency with innovative guest experiences
* **Oversee property priorities:** Lead capital projects, refurbishments, and service initiatives to maintain operational excellence and brand alignment
* **Set and execute strategic direction:** Shape short- and long-term goals, making decisions in the best interests of the hotel, the Hilton brand, and Hilton’s long-term vision
* **Inspire and develop talent:** Provide visionary leadership to the executive team and all Team Members, embedding Hilton’s values and fostering a team of passionate and creative professionals
* **Strengthen communication and collaboration:** Hold regular briefings with the Heads of Department (HOD) team and maintain strong relationships with owners, auditors, and Hilton stakeholders to ensure alignment and accountability
* **Commit to continuous improvement:** Uphold and exceed Hilton service standards, respond to audits proactively, and drive innovation and operational integrity across the business

  

**What It Takes to Make the Stay**

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . A belief that **Teamwork** drives the best outcomes. A sense of **Ownership** and accountability. And a focus on the **Now** , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on leader, with a strong focus on owner relations, commercial performance, and operational excellence. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

* An Established Director of Operations or Hotel Manager with strong operational experience in Rooms and/or F&B.
* Having strong international brand experience in a luxury resort environment is preferred.
* Extensive multi-cultural experience, adept at working with diverse teams and customers.
* Strong ability to collaborate and foster networks and relationships, with owners, contractors, corporates, and Tour Operators – must be highly visible.
* Demonstrable experience in delivering innovative commercial opportunities with experience in increasing profitability especially within Resorts.
* Dynamic and proactive approach with solid experience as an agent of change
* Exceptional people leadership and retention of talent with the ability to bring a team together on a journey and instilling the Hilton culture and values.
* Exceptional stakeholder/owner relations experience with demonstrable influencing skills.
* Ability to show resilience, judgement and leadership.
* Experience managing budgets, revenue proposals, and forecasting results in a similar resort style property.
* Proven experience in delivering results with an eye for details and quality
* Experience in GCC/Qatar will be an advantage
* Degree or diploma in Hotel Management or equivalent.
* Fluency in English and Arabic required (spoken and written)

  

**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Title: The Berkeley Hotel Executive Housekeeper
Description:
**About Company:**

Looking for an inspired leader to head up our housekeeping department at the historic luxury Berkeley Hotel.

55 rooms. Previous hotel management housekeeping required. Must be able to work weekends. As this is a smaller hotel, the exec would be expected to have a board of their own near daily.

**Our Vision**

Our vision is to become the premier hotel development company with a concentration in Washington, committed to excellence through strategic development and continued innovation in the hospitality industry. Guided by our core values, we will exceed the expectations of our guests and members and enhance the value of our partners' investments.

**Our Mission**

Our mission is to provide the ultimate guest experience through exceptionally talented associates committed to providing true hospitality. We do this by providing support, training, and growth for our team members while being fiscally responsible to our owners and investors.

**About the Role:**

The Hotel Executive Housekeeper at Berkeley plays a pivotal role in ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness and guest satisfaction throughout the property. This leadership position is responsible for managing and supervising the housekeeping team to maintain impeccable guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house spaces. The Executive Housekeeper will develop and implement cleaning procedures, schedules, and quality control measures to optimize operational efficiency and uphold brand standards. Additionally, this role involves coordinating with other hotel departments to support seamless guest experiences and address any housekeeping-related concerns promptly. Ultimately, the Executive Housekeeper contributes significantly to the hotel's reputation by fostering a clean, safe, and welcoming environment for all guests and staff.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 1 years of experience in housekeeping, with at least 1 year in a supervisory or management role.
* Strong knowledge of cleaning.
* Ability to lead and motivate a diverse team effectively.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working in a branded hotel environment.
* Familiarity with budgeting and inventory management.
* Knowledge of OSHA regulations and environmental sustainability practices.
* Bilingual abilities, especially in Spanish, to communicate with a diverse workforce.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead, train, and supervise the housekeeping team to ensure consistent delivery of high-quality cleaning services.
* Develop and maintain cleaning schedules, inventory controls, and quality assurance protocols to meet brand and safety standards.
* Inspect guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house spaces regularly to ensure cleanliness and maintenance needs are addressed.
* Collaborate with the front desk, maintenance, and management teams to coordinate room availability and resolve guest requests or complaints.
* Manage housekeeping budgets, including labor costs, supplies, and equipment procurement, while optimizing resource utilization.
* Recruit, onboard, and evaluate housekeeping staff performance, fostering a positive and productive work environment.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, and sanitation regulations.

**Skills:**

The Executive Housekeeper utilizes leadership and interpersonal skills daily to manage and inspire the housekeeping team, ensuring high morale and productivity. Organizational skills are critical for creating efficient cleaning schedules, managing inventory, and maintaining compliance with safety standards. Communication skills enable effective collaboration with other hotel departments and clear resolution of guest concerns. Problem-solving skills are essential when addressing unexpected maintenance issues or staffing challenges to maintain seamless operations. Additionally, knowledge of hospitality software and budgeting tools supports accurate tracking of expenses and resource allocation, contributing to the hotel's operational success.

Title: Hotel Manager
Description:
**Company Description**

**Raffles Hotels & Resorts**

The Birthplace of stories and legends since 1887, Raffles is a legendary brand, steeped in history and loved by generations past, present and future. Raffles, at distinguished landmark addresses around the world, is the vibrant heart of its destination, curating experiences that are culturally enriching, intellectually stimulating and always respectful of local communities, heritage and the environment.

**About Raffles Doha**

Step into a world of refined elegance and timeless artistry at Raffles Doha, an iconic address nestled within the architectural landmark of Katara Towers in Lusail.

Raffles Doha is where luxury becomes deeply personal — a place defined by quiet sophistication, meaningful moments, and the art of thoughtful service. Rooted in a legacy of gracious hospitality, Raffles is renowned for creating experiences that are intimate, bespoke, and unforgettable.

Here, every detail is considered, every interaction intentional, and every guest journey uniquely curated. Our colleagues are artisans of hospitality, empowered to anticipate needs, craft memories, and deliver service with elegance, discretion, and genuine care.

Joining Raffles Doha means becoming part of a storied brand where excellence is not an aspiration, but a standard — and where hospitality is expressed as an art form.

**About the Application Process**

At Raffles Doha, we want to bring out your highest potential. Shortly after applying, you will receive an email from our partner AssessFirst prompting you to create a profile and complete a questionnaire. This is a mandatory step for your candidacy to be considered as it enables us to explore your compatibility with this role and our culture of luxury excellence.

 **Job Description**

We invite you to join the world of luxury hospitality at Raffles Doha as our new Hotel Manager.

The Hotel Manager provides strategic leadership and operational oversight across all hotel departments, ensuring the delivery of exceptional luxury hospitality experiences in line with the standards and philosophy of Raffles Hotels & Resorts.

The role is responsible for driving operational excellence, financial performance, guest satisfaction, and colleague engagement while ensuring seamless coordination and alignment across all operational functions. Working closely with the Executive Committee and department heads, the Hotel Manager translates the hotel's strategic objectives into actionable business plans, strengthens operational efficiencies, and drives a culture of service excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

As a key member of the hotel's leadership team, the Hotel Manager acts as the Managing Director's principal operational partner, ensuring the effective execution of business strategies, safeguarding the hotel's reputation, and reinforcing Raffles Doha's position as a leading luxury hospitality destination.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with the Managing Director to define and execute the hotel's strategic objectives and priorities
* Provide strategic leadership and operational oversight across all hotel departments
* Drive operational excellence, revenue growth, profitability, and continuous improvement
* Monitor hotel performance and implement initiatives to enhance business results
* Ensure seamless operations and consistent delivery of Raffles brand standards
* Champion personalised luxury hospitality and exceptional guest experiences in line with Forbes Travel Guide and LQA standards
* Oversee guest satisfaction, feedback, and effective service recovery
* Lead and develop the Executive Committee and departmental leaders, fostering a high-performance culture
* Drive colleague engagement, talent development, and succession planning
* Oversee financial performance, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and resource optimisation
* Maximise commercial opportunities and profitability across operational departments
* Ensure compliance with brand standards, company policies, and local regulations
* Oversee quality assurance, health and safety, security, and risk management
* Drive Forbes Travel Guide and LQA standards, audits, service evaluations, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Build strong relationships with ownership, corporate stakeholders, key clients, and external partners
* Collaborate with commercial and support functions to strengthen business performance and market positioning
* Promote innovation, technology, and best practices to enhance operational efficiency and guest experience
* Safeguard the hotel's reputation and strengthen Raffles Doha's position as a leading luxury destination

  
**Qualifications**

**What will you bring to this role?**

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field
* Minimum 10 years of experience in luxury hotel operations, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership position
* Proven track record within internationally recognised luxury hotel brands
* Strong knowledge of luxury hospitality standards, including Forbes Travel Guide, and LQA requirements
* Strong Food & Beverage experience across multiple outlets, with proven expertise in managing high-volume banquet operations
* Demonstrated success in driving operational excellence, financial performance, and guest satisfaction
* Strong commercial acumen and experience in budgeting, forecasting, and cost management
* Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop multicultural teams and senior leaders
* Excellent strategic thinking, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills
* Extensive knowledge of hotel operations, quality assurance, and service excellence
* Strong understanding of health, safety, security, and regulatory compliance
* Previous experience in the Middle East luxury hospitality market is preferred
* Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage

  
**Additional Information**

**Employee Benefits**  
Join our team and enjoy a range of exclusive colleague perks, including complimentary upgrades, extended stays, discounted stays across Fairmont & Raffles properties, special dining and wellness discounts, and added luxuries to enhance your experience. We believe in taking care of our team, ensuring that your hard work is rewarded with exceptional benefits.

**Our Values**

Respect: We value the needs, ideas and individuality of others. We treat everyone with fairness and dignity.

Excellence: We make genuine connections, and we cherish every opportunity to make the people around us feel special.

Belonging: We celebrate our differences. We support each other and we always stand together.

Empowerment: We have authority to take initiative and anticipate moments that create unforgettable experiences.

Integrity: We build trust through mutual respect and being authentic.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where diverse talent thrives. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team.

Title: HR Operations Manager – Manufacturing & Building Materials | Saudi Arabia
Description:
Leverage your abilities and join the dynamic team of a leading global manufacturer of building materials, supporting operational expansion and manufacturing initiatives in KSA.

The **HR Operations Manager** will own full accountability for the plant HR agenda, core HR operations, employee services, and team leadership, acting as a key HR Business Partner to plant management. The role offers executive HR leadership, team management, and the opportunity to drive company-wide HR practices, talent pipeline development, and operational efficiency across multi-site plant and office locations.

**Location: Jeddah/Yanbu, Saudi Arabia**

Key Accountabilities

* Supervise daily HR operations across all functions, managing payroll processing, benefits administration, employee services, and immigration/PRO activities.
* Own full oversight of HR operational budgets and administrative processes to ensure cost control and compliance across plant operations.
* Monitor HR service delivery, employee inquiries, and admin workflows to maximize team responsiveness and minimize operational downtime.
* Design and implement operational HR policies, procedures, and global competency frameworks across manufacturing sites.
* Ensure labor law compliance, route efficiency in employee mobility/travel, and regulatory safety adherence across all plant departments.
* Develop and maintain a smooth industrial relations environment, managing workplace culture, employee grievances, and risk mitigation.
* Lead, direct, and motivate HR operations teams, setting operational KPIs and guiding staff toward organizational goals.
* Mobilize new HR programs, talent initiatives, and onboarding schedules on time, covering manpower, training, and start-up plant operations.
* Partner with department heads on manpower planning, budgeting, and talent acquisition before committing to operational headcount.
* Collaborate with Plant Leadership on performance management, employee retention, and work with HSE on health and safety compliance.
* Set and monitor HR KPIs, resolving workplace disputes and reporting performance metrics directly to Country and Regional HR Leadership.

Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–7 years of progressive HR experience in manegerial level, including at least 2 years in a manufacturing, industrial, or plant environment.
* Proven experience managing HR operations, payroll budgets, and administrative cost control strategies.
* Demonstrated experience leading small HR teams and managing multi-site plant workforces.
* Deep knowledge of KSA labor laws, workplace regulations, and industrial best practices.
* Hands-on experience with HRIS, ERP systems, HR analytics, and advanced Excel reporting.
* Fluent in both English and Arabic (written and spoken).
* HR certification (e.g., SHRM, CIPD) is a plus.
* Strong leadership, negotiation, dispute resolution, and stakeholder management skills.
* Flexibility to travel regularly between plant operations in Yanbu and office locations in Jeddah as required by project operations.

Title: Human Resources Manager
Description:
**Additional Information**  
**Job Number**26149704  
**Job Category**Human Resources  
**Location**The St. Regis Residence, Marsa Arabia Island, Doha 14875, Qatar  
**Schedule**Full Time  
**Located Remotely?**N  
**Position Type** Management  

At **The St. Regis Doha**, we are more than a luxury hotel; we are a brand defined by bespoke service, timeless elegance, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. Inspired by the legacy of St. Regis, we create unforgettable experiences through personalized service that anticipates the needs of every guest. We are seeking a passionate and people-focused **Human Resources Manager** who will play a key role in attracting, developing, and engaging talent while fostering a culture that reflects our values and elevates the associate experience.

**JOB SUMMARY**

As a member of the property Human Resources support staff, he/she works with Human Resources employees to carry out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including oversight of recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she focuses on delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensures compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

**Preferred Qualifications & Attributes**

* Proven Human Resources leadership experience within a luxury hospitality environment
* Strong working knowledge of Qatar Labour Law and local employment regulations
* Ability to act as a strategic business partner, influencing stakeholders and driving people-focused initiatives across the hotel

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process**

* Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.
* Establishes and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.
* Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.
* Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.
* Oversees/monitors candidate identification and selection process.
* Provides subject matter expertise to property managers regarding selection procedures.
* Partners with vendor partners to ensure effective advertisement efforts are being utilized for open positions in appropriate venues to attract a diverse candidate pool.
* Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.

**Administering and Educating Employee Benefits**

* Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.
* Prepares, audits and distributes unemployment claim activity reports to property management.
* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented.
* Ensures that department has the available resources on hand to administer employee.

**Managing Employee Development**

* Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
* Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
* Uses all available on the job training tools for employees; supervise on-going training initiatives and conducts training, when appropriate.
* Ensures coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.
* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs
* Collaborates with management team to ensure departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

**Maintaining Employee Relations**

* Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property-wide meetings).
* Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.
* Utilizes an “open door” policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner
* Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi-Property Director of Human Resources.
* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.
* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

**Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**

* Ensures employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.
* Ensures compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.
* Ensures medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.
* Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).
* Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.
* Ensures all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.
* Conducts periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.
* Represents Human Resources at the property Safety Committee; helps to identify ways to create awareness of the importance of safety in the workplace and decrease accident frequency and severity.
* Manages Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.
* Oversees the selection/non-selection and offers processes to ensure proper procedures are followed (e.g., valid reasons for selection/non-selection and applicants receive status notifications).

Beginning with the debut of The St. Regis hotel in New York by John Jacob Astor IV at the dawn of the twentieth century, the brand has remained committed to an uncompromising level of bespoke and anticipatory service for all of its guests, delivered flawlessly by a team of gracious hosts that combine classic sophistication and modern sensibility, as well as our signature Butler Service. In joining St. Regis, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. **Be** where you can do your best work, **begin** your purpose, **belong** to an amazing global team, and **become** the best version of you.

Title: Senior Manager | Tax & Legal | Legal | Legal Management Consultancy | KSA
Description:
**Job Title: Manager/ Senior Manager – Legal Management Consultancy**
**Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia**
When you work for us, you commit to a career at one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the world. Looking for a rewarding career? Take a closer look at Deloitte & Touche ME. It has received numerous awards in the last few years which include Best Employer in the Middle East, best consulting firm, and the Middle East Training & Development Excellence Award by the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales (ICAEW).
  
  
Our region encompasses diverse tax laws and is part of what makes a career in tax with Deloitte & Touche Middle East a truly stimulating experience. With many corporations operating across several borders, your knowledge of tax will be key to making sure our clients stay on the right side of tax laws and minimize their tax costs. Your people skills will also be engaged as you form a close working relationship with clients, while your technical knowledge will be stretched as you develop expertise across the board in consulting, business, finance and law to craft commercially sound solutions. As you gain experience, you will do so with the full support of a firm that believes in helping you grow and providing you with the skills to succeed.
  
  
The legal sector is undergoing rapid, technology-driven transformation. Large language models, agentic AI, intelligent automation and broader digital technologies are fundamentally reshaping how legal services are designed, delivered and managed - creating significant opportunities for legal organizations and law firms that are transforming the way they operate.
  
  
Deloitte’s Legal Management Consulting (LMC) team in the Middle East partners with in-house legal departments and law firms to redesign their operating models across process, people and technology; from strategy through to implementation and sustained operational change. LMC combines deep legal sector expertise with enterprise-grade consulting and technology delivery capabilities. As part of the global Deloitte Legal network - over 2,500 legal professionals across 85+ jurisdictions - we are now building a dedicated LMC capability in Riyadh, KSA, to serve the Middle East market. This is a foundational hire for that team.
  
  
**Our Purpose**
Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. We serve clients distinctively, bringing innovative insights, solving complex challenges and unlocking sustainable growth. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. We contribute to society, building confidence and trust in the markets, upholding the integrity of organizations and supporting our communities.
  
  
Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact:
  
  

* Lead the way
* Serve with integrity
* Take care of each other
* Foster inclusion
* Collaborate for measurable impact

**Job Summary**
As a Manager/Senior Manager (level dependent on experience), you will independently lead engagements or major workstreams within large-scale programmes, reporting to engagement partners and directors. You will serve as a technical leader across both legal operations and growth, and legal technology and AI - leading legal operating model and operations transformation work alongside LLM-powered solutions, AI workflow design, agentic AI workflows and system deployments. You will also develop senior client relationships to build the sales pipeline in the Middle East, and coach and develop junior team members.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Independently managing complex end-to-end client engagements and major workstreams spanning legal operations, operating model design and legal technology/AI, acting as the senior Deloitte presence on projects
* Building trusted senior client relationships across in-house legal departments and law firms, acting as a recognised advisor on legal operations, growth and AI enabled transformation
* Actively developing and owning your own sales pipeline, and building your personal brand as an LMC specialist through thought leadership and professional networks
* Taking a leading role in shaping LMC propositions and market positioning in the Middle East, and inspiring high-performing, diverse teams across multiple engagements
* Leading the design and implementation of legal operating models and legal technology solutions at scale — including legal operations redesign, LLM-powered tools, AI workflow, agentic AI architectures and enterprise legal platforms - to transform clients' legal operations and service delivery models

**Day To Day Activities**

2. Qualified leads generated.

Title: Senior Procurement Manager
Description:
**Overview Of The Role:**  
  
  

* The Senior Procurement Manager leads strategic aspects within key Indirect Categories such as IT, Logistics, Marketing, and Human Capital across divisions on a global level. The purpose of the role is to develop and maintain organizational structures and necessary alignments to ensure an effective procurement process while providing high-value external solutions to support business projects in Saudi Arabia. This position acts as the primary procurement business partner for Business Units in KSA, ensuring alignment with budgets, strategy, productivity, and margin expansion initiatives. Success in this role involves designing and delivering comprehensive procurement strategies, fostering relationships with stakeholders, and maintaining operational compliance and governance.

  
**What You Will Do:**  
  
  

#### **Business Engagement & Demand Forecasting**

  
  

* Develop a deep understanding of business unit strategies, operational plans, and upcoming requirements across all KSA divisions.
* Lead structured demand planning and forecasting cycles to ensure accurate visibility of procurement needs.
* Maintain a rolling procurement pipeline for KSA, updated monthly and shared with regional category and sourcing teams.
* Facilitate early engagement between stakeholders and procurement to ensure timely planning and alignment with category strategies.
  

  

#### **Compliance, Governance & Policy Adherence**

  
  

* Ensure all procurement activities within KSA adhere to corporate policies, procedures, and delegated authority frameworks.
* Monitor compliance levels across business units and implement corrective actions where gaps are identified.
* Conduct periodic training and awareness sessions for local stakeholders on procurement processes, systems, and compliance expectations.
* Support internal and external audit requirements by providing documentation, clarifications, and process insights.
  

  

#### **Coordination with Regional Category & Sourcing Teams**

  
  

* Act as the primary interface between KSA stakeholders and category/sourcing teams based in UAE and Egypt.
* Translate business needs into clear category briefs and sourcing requests to enable efficient remote support.
* Track progress of sourcing activities and ensure timely delivery of outcomes (RFPs, supplier evaluations, negotiations, contracts).
* Escalate bottlenecks or misalignments and drive resolution to maintain service levels.
  

  

#### **Procurement Planning & Execution Support**

  
  

* Support the execution of sourcing events, supplier onboarding, and contract finalization in coordination with regional teams.
* Ensure procurement requests (PRs) are complete, accurate, and aligned with approved budgets and category strategies.
* Monitor contract lifecycle milestones and support renewals, amendments, and performance reviews.
  

  

#### **Stakeholder Relationship Management**

  
  

* Build strong, trust-based relationships with business leaders, project managers, finance, and operations teams across KSA.
* Provide proactive guidance on procurement timelines, market insights, and sourcing options.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to stakeholders, helping them optimize cost, quality, and risk outcomes.
  

  

#### **Supplier Performance & Issue Resolution**

  
  

* Support supplier performance monitoring by gathering feedback from KSA stakeholders and sharing insights with category managers.
* Coordinate resolution of supplier issues, disputes, or service failures in collaboration with regional teams.
* Contribute to supplier review meetings and ensure local performance data is captured and acted upon.
  

  

#### **Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement**

  
  

* Deliver regular reporting on procurement pipeline, compliance metrics, sourcing progress, and savings achievements for KSA.
* Identify opportunities to streamline local procurement processes and enhance stakeholder experience.
* Contribute to regional procurement improvement initiatives and support implementation within KSA.
  

  

#### **Local Market & Regulatory Awareness**

  
  

* Maintain awareness of KSA-specific regulatory requirements, local content rules, and market dynamics.
* Ensure procurement activities reflect local legal and compliance obligations.
* Provide insights to category teams to help shape regional strategies with KSA-specific considerations.
  

  
  
**Required Skills To Be Successful:**  
  
  

* Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and financial modeling tools.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to execute projects successfully and deliver external solutions timely, within budget, and meeting quality standards.
* Understanding of Procurement KPIs related to market insights, price and demand development, and performance metrics.

  
**What Qualifies You For The Role:**  
  
  

* University/Advanced degree needed.
* Master's Degree or other advanced degree preferred.
* CIPS (or equivalent) qualification.
* 10+ years of relevant business experience, preferably in Procurement, Automotive, Retail, or Real Estate industries.
* Experience in Procurement, category management, supplier management, or related areas with a focus on Indirect Categories.

The Senior Manager of Logistics – Procurement, Inventory & School-Based Programs leads food procurement, inventory control, shipping and receiving, and logistics coordination for Manna’s school-based programs. The role ensures food is sourced responsibly and cost-effectively, inventory transactions are accurate, and food availability and program needs are aligned with warehouse production and distribution plans. This position supervises the Food Procurement Manager, Shipping & Receiving Coordinator, and School-Based Program Logistics Coordinator and works in close partnership with the Senior Manager of Logistics responsible for warehouse execution, transportation, and production. Both Senior Managers report to the Director of Logistics and share responsibility for coordinated, reliable warehouse operations and act both as a key liaison between the Director of Logistics and the rest of the Logistics team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Supervise and develop the Food Procurement Manager, Shipping & Receiving Coordinator, and School-Based Program Logistics Coordinator, setting clear expectations and monitoring performance.
* Oversee food sourcing, purchasing plans, vendor relationships, pricing, delivery schedules, and purchasing records in accordance with Manna policies and budget parameters for all food programs – food for families, School Base Program, Prince George County Pantries and Market
* Ensure accurate receiving, inventory, and shipping transactions in Fishbowl or any other applicable system in the future, including product quantities, source information, pallet locations, adjustments, and outgoing shipments.
* Maintain effective inventory controls, FIFO practices, counts, reconciliations, and timely resolution of discrepancies, damaged products, and inventory risks.
* Oversee logistics planning for Smart Sacks, School Pantries, School Markets, and other assigned school-based distributions, ensuring deliveries and partner pickups are scheduled and documented.
* Share timely information about food availability, inbound deliveries, inventory locations, and school-based demand and food for family program with the other Senior Manager to support production, staging, and distribution.
* Review procurement, inventory, vendor, and program fulfillment reports; identify risks and improvement opportunities and provide updates to the Director of Logistics.
* Ensure assigned functions follow Manna policies, food safety requirements, purchasing controls, inventory procedures, and applicable workplace safety practices.
* **Any other duties as assigned**.

**Summary of Essential Job Functions**

**Procurement & Vendor Management**
-----------------------------------

* Direct the Food Procurement Manager’s work on purchased, donated, rescued, farm-sourced, and partner-provided food, ensuring sourcing plans reflect program demand, budget, storage, and production needs.
* Review vendor pricing, performance, delivery schedules, purchasing documentation, and sourcing recommendations; address routine issues and escalate material supply or cost risks.

**Inventory Control, Shipping & Receiving**
-------------------------------------------

* Supervise the Shipping & Receiving Coordinator to verify and record inbound and outbound product movements accurately, maintaining complete supporting documents and timely system transactions.
* Monitor inventory counts, FIFO rotation, pallet locations, adjustments, damaged or spoiled food, and discrepancies; coordinate reconciliations and provide reliable inventory information to warehouse staff.
* Ensure compliance with shipping documentation requirements: Implement and oversee procedures requiring a completed bill of lading for every outbound food shipment or distribution before it leaves the warehouse. Ensure staff consistently follow this requirement and that all documentation is accurate and retained for recordkeeping and accountability
* Maintain appropriate separation of duties: procurement manages sourcing and purchasing, while Shipping & Receiving verifies physical receipts and records inventory movements.

**School-Based Program Logistics**
----------------------------------

* Supervise the School-Based Program Logistics Coordinator and coordinate logistics for Smart Sacks, School Pantries, School Markets, and other assigned school-based distributions.
* Oversee the coordination of pickup and delivery schedules, packing lists, delivery requests, required inserts, and partner communications are completed accurately and by established deadlines
* Ensure the School Program coordinate maintain program forecasts and food availability with procurement and inventory staff and align staging and delivery execution with the other Senior Manager.
* Monitor program logistics performance and service issues, ensuring routine concerns are addressed by the Coordinator, and significant risks are escalated to the Director of Logistics

**Coordination, Reporting & Communication**
-------------------------------------------

* Maintain regular planning with the Senior Manager of Logistics 1 to align procurement timing, inventory availability, production needs, warehouse capacity, and distribution schedules.
* Communicate changes, shortages, substitutions, delivery issues, and other risks early; agree on clear handoffs and escalate unresolved or high-impact issues to the Director of Logistics.
* Prepare and review reports on purchasing, vendor performance, inventory accuracy and aging, discrepancies, spending, and school-based fulfillment; recommend practical improvements.

**Team Leadership, Safety & Compliance**
----------------------------------------

* Coach and develop direct reports, maintain clear procedures and accountability, and support collaboration across Logistics.
* Ensure assigned staff follow Manna policies, ethical purchasing practices, food safety requirements, inventory controls, and applicable workplace safety procedures.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Associate degree preferred
* 3+ years of supervisory experience
* ServSafe certification or ability to pass certification within 90 days of hiring.
* Knowledge of warehouse operations, safety practices, and proper food handling procedures.
* Demonstrated knowledge of FIFO (First-In, First-Out) principles and their application to food production, inventory rotation, and product handling.
* Demonstrated experience safely operating electric and manual pallet jacks, walkie stackers, and other warehouse material-handling equipment.
* Experience with procurement, vendor relationships, inventory control, shipping & receiving, and inventory software experience preferred, with Fishbowl a plus.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Demonstrated sound judgment, integrity, and commitment to ethical purchasing, accurate records, and cross-functional collaboration.

* Able to multi-task effectively and handle a wide variety of diverse and concurrent responsibilities.

* Experience effectively collaborating with diverse staff, volunteers and other senior level management
* Able to lift 50 pounds repeatedly and 75 pounds at one time.
* Valid driver’s license with the proven ability to drive any Manna vehicle.
* Clean driving record with no moving violations in the past two years and no major violations in the past ten years. No DUI citations.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, and/or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit and climb or balance. The employee must regularly lift and/or move objects up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move objects that weigh more than 75 pounds. The employee must be able to stand continuously for up to 3 hours at a time. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

**Environmental Conditions**

While picking up and distributing food, the employee will be exposed to a wide array of environmental conditions, including extreme heat and cold, rain, snow, and ice. The employee must be able to work in these conditions for up to 3 hours at a time.

Title: Procurement Manager
Description:
**Procurement Manager**

**About SIS Pitches**

SIS Pitches is a leading international provider of sports surfaces, delivering world-class football, rugby, hockey, cricket, and multi-sport facilities across global markets. Our expertise spans the complete project lifecycle, including design, manufacturing, construction, surfacing, installation, and long-term maintenance of natural, hybrid, and synthetic turf systems.

As we continue to expand internationally, we are seeking a highly experienced Procurement Manager to lead our global sourcing and procurement activities, ensuring the highest quality materials and services are secured at the most competitive commercial terms.

**Position Summary**

The Procurement Manager is a senior leadership position responsible for developing and executing procurement strategies that support SIS Pitches' global operations. The role requires exceptional negotiation skills, commercial acumen, supplier management expertise, and a strong focus on cost optimization without compromising quality, performance, safety, or project timelines.

The successful candidate will be responsible for sourcing and securing the best-value products, materials, equipment, subcontractors, and services from international markets while building strategic supplier relationships that contribute to the company's long-term success.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Procurement & Sourcing**

* Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Source high-quality materials, products, equipment, and services for sports pitch construction and maintenance projects in Saudi Arabia.
* Identify and evaluate new suppliers, manufacturers, and strategic partners globally.
* Continuously assess market conditions, industry developments, and pricing trends to maximize procurement efficiencies.
* Establish and maintain approved supplier frameworks and preferred vendor agreements.

**Supplier Management**

* Build and manage strong relationships with key suppliers and manufacturers.
* Conduct supplier performance evaluations covering quality, pricing, delivery performance, sustainability, and reliability.
* Negotiate long-term supply agreements that secure favourable commercial terms and mitigate supply chain risks.
* Lead supplier audits and due diligence processes where required.

**Contract Negotiation**

* Lead high-value procurement negotiations for materials, equipment, logistics, and subcontracted services.
* Secure the best combination of cost, quality, warranty, service support, and delivery schedules.
* Review, negotiate, and administer supplier contracts and commercial agreements.
* Ensure all contracts comply with company policies and legal requirements.

**Cost Management & Value Engineering**

* Deliver measurable cost savings across all procurement categories.
* Drive value engineering initiatives to improve product performance while reducing overall project costs.
* Analyse total cost of ownership rather than simply focusing on purchase price.
* Prepare procurement budgets and cost forecasts for major projects.

**Supply Chain Management**

* Manage procurement schedules in line with project delivery requirements.
* Identify and mitigate supply chain risks and disruptions.
* Ensure timely delivery of materials and equipment to project sites.
* Work closely with logistics providers to optimize transportation and storage costs.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Teams, Design Teams, Finance, and Senior Leadership.
* Provide procurement expertise during project planning and tender stages.
* Support bid preparation by obtaining competitive pricing and supplier commitments.
* Assist project teams in resolving procurement and supply-related issues.

**Compliance & Governance**

* Ensure ethical procurement practices are maintained across all regions.
* Maintain accurate procurement records and reporting systems.
* Ensure suppliers comply with company standards relating to quality, health and safety, environmental compliance, and sustainability.
* Implement procurement best practices and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Leadership Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop the procurement function across the business.
* Mentor and support procurement and supply chain personnel.
* Establish procurement KPIs and performance metrics.
* Prepare and present procurement reports to senior management.
* Drive a culture of commercial excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Requirements**

* Minimum 10 years' procurement experience, with at least 5 years in a senior procurement role.
* Experience within construction, sports infrastructure, civil engineering, manufacturing, or related industries.
* Proven ability to negotiate significant cost savings without compromising quality.
* Strong commercial, analytical, and contract management skills.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

**Essential**

* Outstanding negotiation and influencing skills.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen.
* Ability to consistently source high-quality products at the most competitive prices.
* Excellent contract management and procurement knowledge.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strategic thinker with excellent decision-making ability.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to perform under pressure and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality.

**Preferred**

* Experience procuring sports turf systems, construction materials, irrigation systems, sports lighting, equipment, or specialist infrastructure products.
* Experience working across international markets.
* Knowledge of procurement software and ERP systems.

**Mission:** To serve the needs of transit riders by providing a safe, reliable, efficient, and accessible mass public transit service through a seamless integrated network to create access to opportunity for everyone.

  

**Career Opportunity**
----------------------

Looking to lead high-value, strategic procurements that support TTC's critical operations and capital programs? We are seeking a Lead Procurement & Category Specialist to manage complex procurements across areas such as Construction, Major Projects, Professional Services, Information Technology, Specialized Engineered Equipment, and Revenue Vehicles.

In this role, you will lead end-to-end procurement activities, including sourcing strategy, competitive and negotiated procurements, contract development, stakeholder engagement, supplier negotiations, and contract award. You will act as a trusted advisor to internal clients, providing expert guidance on procurement strategy, market conditions, risk management, commercial terms, and procurement best practices.

As a subject matter expert, you will oversee high-profile and high-risk procurement initiatives, develop category strategies, support continuous improvement initiatives, and provide mentorship and guidance to procurement staff. This role offers an opportunity to influence major business decisions, support organizational priorities, and drive value through effective procurement and supplier management.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

Reporting to the Category Manager, you will lead and manage complex, high-value procurement initiatives from planning through contract award and execution. You will partner with internal stakeholders to develop sourcing strategies, procurement plans, evaluation methodologies, contract structures, and commercial approaches that align with business objectives and procurement best practices.

  

You will lead competitive and negotiated procurement processes, including RFPs, NRFPs, RFBs, RFIs, ACANs, prequalification initiatives, and sole-source procurements. This includes coordinating evaluations, facilitating negotiations, managing bidder communications, preparing award recommendations, and supporting approvals through TTC governance processes.

  

You will serve as the procurement lead and subject matter expert for your assigned category, providing strategic advice on procurement approaches, contract terms, risk management, market conditions, supplier capabilities, and commercial negotiations. You will also support category management activities by conducting market research, evaluating industry trends, identifying sourcing opportunities, and developing long-term procurement strategies.

  

As a senior member of the team, you will mentor procurement staff, contribute to policy and process improvements, lead training initiatives, and support the continuous evolution of procurement practices across the department.

**What Skills Do You Bring?**
-----------------------------

Apply accounting principles and practices

Apply analytical skills

Communicate in a variety of mediums

Create, document, and manage information and records

Demonstrate knowledge of the industry and / or sector

Demonstrate specialized expertise and knowledge in the assigned field

Use office technology, software and applications

Understand and apply administrative policies, processes, and procedures

**What Qualifications Do You Bring?**
-------------------------------------

* University degree or college diploma in Business, Commerce, Supply Chain Management, Construction Management, Engineering, Public Administration, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Significant experience leading complex public-sector procurements from planning through award and contract execution.
* Strong experience supporting construction, engineering services, professional services, major capital projects, IT, transit vehicles, or specialized equipment procurements.
* Extensive knowledge of public procurement principles, strategic sourcing, contract management, category management, and procurement governance.
* Experience developing and administering RFPs, NRFPs, RFBs, RFIs, ACANs, prequalification processes, and negotiated procurements.
* Strong understanding of procurement law, contract law, construction law, CFTA, CETA, and public-sector procurement requirements.
* Demonstrated experience developing procurement strategies, evaluation methodologies, commercial terms, and negotiation approaches.
* Experience leading commercial negotiations involving legal, technical, operational, and financial considerations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to interpret technical specifications, scopes of work, construction documents, engineering requirements, and complex commercial agreements.
* Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority procurements while balancing competing stakeholder needs.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and electronic procurement platforms.

**Assets**

* SCMP, CPPB, CPPO, NISCL, or similar procurement designation.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) designation.
* Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation.
* Experience with high-value infrastructure, transit, engineering, construction, fleet, or technology procurements.
* Experience facilitating Commercial Confidential Meetings (CCMs) and complex negotiated procurements.
* Experience developing procurement policies, procedures, governance frameworks, and training programs.

**What We Offer**

* Commitment to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture that promotes a sense of belonging, representation and reflects the needs of the communities we serve.
* A flexible, hybrid work approach that allows colleagues to find balance between their professional and personal lives and making the most of the benefits of working remotely and purpose-driven in-person collaboration opportunities.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Title: RESTAURANT MANAGER

Collaborates with the Executive Chef / Head Chef and other department heads to uphold the restaurant's reputation for excellence in cuisine, ambiance, and hospitality.

1. Oversee day-to-day operations of the restaurant, including dining room service, kitchen operations, and overall guest experience.

2. Set and maintain high standards for service quality, cleanliness, and presentation throughout the restaurant.

3. Monitor restaurant performance metrics, such as guest satisfaction scores, sales figures, and labor costs, and take corrective actions as needed.

4. Train, and supervise front-of-house staff members.

5. Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, and performance evaluations to ensure team members deliver exceptional service and uphold brand standards.

16. Overseeing inventory levels, ordering supplies, and managing food and beverage costs.

17. Resolving issues that arise in the restaurant, such as customer complaints, staffing problems, or equipment malfunctions.

19. Work closely with the marketing team to develop and execute marketing campaigns, promotions, and special events to attract new guests and retain existing ones.

21. Sending weekly Rota’s Schedule.

22. Maintain records of attendance.

-Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with ability to inspire and motivate a diverse team.

-Exceptional customer service skills and a passion for delivering memorable dining experiences.

-Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.

- Financial acumen and proficiency in budgeting, financial analysis, and cost control.

-Knowledge of restaurant operations, including food and beverage service, kitchen management, and front-of-house procedures.

-Understanding of useful computer programs (MS Office, restaurant management software, POS).

Title: Retail Operations Manager
Description:
Retail Operations Manager – Kids Toys retail brand

**Job Summary**

Client is looking for an experienced and commercially driven **Retail Operations Manager** to oversee the operations and business performance of all Client's retail stores.

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth, improving store profitability, managing inventory, overseeing buying and merchandising activities, developing supplier relationships and ensuring an excellent customer experience across all locations.

This role requires a hands-on retail leader with strong commercial awareness, analytical skills and the ability to lead teams, identify business opportunities and translate performance insights into practical actions.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Retail Operations & Sales Management**

* Oversee the day-to-day operations of all Client's stores, ensuring consistent operational standards and efficient store management.
* Drive sales performance by setting, communicating and monitoring store and individual sales targets.
* Review daily, weekly and monthly sales results, identify performance gaps and implement corrective actions.
* Conduct regular store visits to monitor operational standards, customer service, sales performance and overall store execution.
* Ensure stores maintain attractive layouts, effective product displays, proper visual merchandising and a positive shopping environment.
* Identify opportunities to improve store productivity, sales conversion and customer experience.

**2. Inventory, Merchandising & Buying**

* Oversee stock management across all stores, ensuring optimal inventory levels and product availability.
* Monitor fast-moving, slow-moving and ageing stock and implement appropriate actions to improve stock turnover and sell-through.
* Plan replenishment and stock transfers between stores based on sales trends, inventory levels and customer demand.
* Oversee product buying and ordering activities, ensuring purchasing decisions are aligned with sales forecasts, market demand and business objectives.
* Analyze product and category performance to identify buying opportunities, reduce excess inventory and improve stock investment.
* Identify new products, brands and emerging toy trends to strengthen the company's product range and drive additional sales.
* Ensure new products and brands are effectively introduced, displayed and promoted across stores.

**3. Supplier & Market Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, brand principals and product representatives.
* Negotiate competitive pricing, payment terms, promotional support and other commercial arrangements to improve profitability.
* Follow up on purchase orders, deliveries, product availability and supplier-related issues.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, product offerings and pricing through regular market visits and industry engagement.
* Identify new suppliers, brands and business opportunities that can enhance the company's product portfolio and competitive position.

**4. Financial Performance & Profitability**

* Monitor sales, gross margins and overall profitability across all Client's stores.
* Review store and business P&L performance, identify key financial drivers and take action to address underperformance.
* Improve gross margins through effective buying, supplier negotiations, product selection and pricing strategies.
* Monitor discounts, promotions and promotional activities to drive sales while protecting profitability.
* Identify opportunities to control operating expenses, improve operational efficiency and maximize store profitability.
* Ensure effective stock investment and inventory turnover to support healthy cash flow and business returns.

**5. Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, coach and develop Store Managers, Supervisors and retail teams to achieve business and operational objectives.
* Monitor individual and store team performance, providing regular feedback, guidance and support.
* Improve team capabilities through training in product knowledge, selling techniques, customer service and store operations.
* Ensure clear communication of targets, responsibilities and operational expectations across all stores.
* Address performance gaps and operational challenges in coordination with Human Resources and relevant departments.

**6. Business Development & Reporting**

* Identify and recommend opportunities to improve store performance, expand product categories and enhance the customer experience.
* Oversee store improvement, renovation and development initiatives in coordination with relevant departments.
* Work closely with Finance, Marketing, Procurement, Supply Chain and Human Resources to ensure effective retail operations.
* Prepare regular management reports covering sales, profitability, inventory, buying, supplier performance, store operations and key business opportunities.
* Present business insights and recommendations to senior management to support commercial and operational decision-making.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Marketing or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in retail management, sales operations, merchandising, buying or multi-store operations.
* ***Experience in managing multiple retail locations, preferably in toys, children's products, specialty retail*** or a similar consumer retail environment.
* Proven ability to manage sales targets, inventory, customer experience and store profitability.
* Strong understanding of retail buying, merchandising, stock management, supplier relations and commercial negotiations.
* Experience reviewing sales reports, gross margins, stock movement and P&L performance.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Commercially minded, results-oriented and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced retail environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on the following key areas:

* **Sales Performance:** Achievement of sales targets and overall retail growth.
* **Profitability:** Gross margin improvement, P&L performance and operating cost control.
* **Inventory Management:** Stock turnover, sell-through, product availability and ageing stock reduction.
* **Buying & Merchandising:** Effective purchasing decisions, product range development and supplier performance.
* **Operational Excellence:** Store standards, customer experience and operational efficiency.
* **People Development:** Team performance, productivity, training and staff development.

Work Schedule & Conditions

* Full-time position following retail operational and business requirements.
* Two days off per week, in accordance with the company's work schedule.
* Regular visits to all Client's stores are required.
* Occasional market visits, supplier meetings and business-related travel may be required.

Pay: QAR17,000.00 - QAR20,000.00 per month

Title: Head of Sales, North America — Agentis Asset Management Services

**Our Firm**

Asset Management Services (“AMS”) is the asset management practice of Agentis Capital Advisors, a global infrastructure advisory and investment platform. AMS manages more than 120 infrastructure assets representing over $35bn in enterprise value across renewables, public-private partnerships, digital and social infrastructure. We support our clients over the life of their assets through four service pillars:

* Financial Model Management – We build, standardize, enhance and maintain the financial models behind our clients’ funds and portfolio companies
* Financial Services Management – We run the accounting, budgeting, lender compliance and financial reporting for project companies
* Operations Management – We oversee the day-to-day management of assets, including contract administration, performance monitoring, and board and stakeholder support

AMS gives private markets and infrastructure investors one consistent, auditable and trusted view of their portfolios, delivered as a managed service. Our clients include leading infrastructure funds, pension funds, developers and project companies. Our guiding principles of excellence, client success, commitment, people and entrepreneurship set us apart.

**The Opportunity**

Private-markets managers and large asset owners run their portfolios on hundreds of inconsistent models, built by different advisors in different formats. Valuation, investor reporting and portfolio oversight are slow, manual and hard to audit. AMS solves this. We take over a client’s portfolio models, rebuild them to one standard on our technology-enabled platform, and deliver a live, fund-level view of the whole portfolio. We maintain and enhance it with our specialists on an ongoing basis.

We are looking for a Head of Sales, North America to take this service to market and expand our client base. This is a hands-on, player-coach role, reporting to the Agentis Capital Managing Partners.

This role suits a commercially driven seller who has sold value-added services into funds (e.g., fund administration, back-office, data, valuation or portfolio-monitoring software and services), selling to CEOs, heads of asset management, CFOs, COOs and finance teams of private-markets managers. You want to own a territory and build a business, not inherit a book.

**Our Differentiators**

* The first dedicated sales leader for a new AMS service line, shaping how it goes to market from day one
* A differentiated product to sell: an exclusive, technology-enabled modelling and portfolio-reporting platform, delivered by Agentis professionals as a managed service and not as another software licence
* Ability to build on Agentis’s long-standing relationships with infrastructure funds, pension funds and asset owners across North America
* A competitive base plus uncapped commission tied to the recurring revenue you bring in
* The opportunity to hire and lead additional sales professionals as the business grows
* An entrepreneurial culture with a flat structure and direct access to Partners and senior leadership, where good ideas are acted on quickly

**Key Responsibilities**

**Build and Run the North American Pipeline**

* Own the North American target universe: private-markets fund managers (infrastructure and renewables first, then real estate and private equity), pension and institutional direct investors, and large asset-portfolio owners
* Run a disciplined outbound campaign: prioritize and tier targets, secure first meetings and keep a steady weekly cadence of new conversations
* Use Agentis’s existing relationships, working with Partners to convert warm introductions into qualified opportunities
* Keep the CRM accurate as the system of record for contacts, meetings, pipeline stage, forecast and next steps

**Win and Close Mandates**

* Lead the full sales cycle, from discovery and demonstrations to pilots, proposals, pricing, negotiation and signed multi-year mandates
* Sell to multiple stakeholders: CFOs, COOs, heads of portfolio/asset management, valuation and investor relations, and the risk, IT and procurement teams who must approve the service
* Run structured pilots and proofs of concept that turn into paying, recurring engagements
* Address data-security, information-handling and technology questions with the AMS delivery team, including due-diligence questionnaires
* Expand existing clients from an initial portfolio into wider fund, valuation and reporting work

**Shape the Go-to-Market**

* Feed market insight into the sales narrative, buyer personas, objection handling, pricing and packaging
* Help develop sales collateral, case studies, demonstrations and the website, using the platform’s outputs as proof points
* Represent AMS at industry conferences and events across North America, and build the service’s profile in the market
* Track competitors and adjacent offerings, and report what is winning and losing deals

**Build the Sales Team**

* As the business grows, recruit, onboard and lead additional sales professionals
* Coordinate with the European sales lead on shared global clients, consistent messaging and pipeline reporting

**Partner with Delivery**

* Work closely with the AMS modelling and delivery team so that what is sold can be delivered well and on time
* Ensure a smooth handover from sale to delivery during onboarding, set realistic client expectations and support client change management
* Report weekly to the Partners and AMS steering group on pipeline, conversion, forecast and market feedback

**Skills and Experience**

* Seven or more years of B2B sales or business development experience, including a meaningful track record of selling value-added services, data or software into funds or institutional investors
* Experience selling fund administration, fund accounting, back-office, valuation, portfolio-monitoring, investor-reporting or financial-data solutions to private-markets managers is strongly preferred

**Compensation and Benefits**

Title: Head of Sales
Description:

Martin is a leading, tech-enabled insurance advisory firm celebrating over 30 years of excellence. We partner with national, regional, and local insurance carriers and Managing General Agents (MGAs) across the U.S. to solve their most critical challenges. Our expertise spans Product Development, Actuarial Services, Regulatory Compliance, State Filings, and Data Analytics. Our mission is simple: build lasting partnerships and deliver technology-driven outcomes that fuel business success.

We recently acquired Adaptify, bringing its engineering team in-house and accelerating our platform roadmap. We are now a fully remote team backed by private equity, with consulting expertise and technology under one roof.

**The Opportunity**

We are hiring a Head of Sales to lead our sales team day to day and build the sales engine for Martin’s next stage of growth. In this newly created role, you will own team performance, pipeline, forecasting, and sales process. That frees our Chief Revenue Officer to focus on revenue strategy, strategic relationships and new markets.

With our recent acquisition of Adaptify, we have a bigger story to tell and a broader offering to sell. This role will shape how we take that combined offering to market.

Selling at Martin is consultative. Our clients increasingly buy expertise and software together, and our deals range from productized platform sales to complex, custom engagements. You will lead a team that sells both well, working alongside Sales Engineers and our Professional Services Group so that what we sell is what we deliver.

This is a builder's role. We are looking for a leader who coaches as well as they close, who brings structure without slowing the team down, and who is energized by taking a capable sales team to the next level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Lead and develop the sales team**

* Manage, coach and develop the sales team through regular one-on-ones, deal coaching and call reviews
* Set clear expectations for activity, pipeline and results, and hold the team accountable to them
* Hire, onboard and ramp new sellers as the team grows
* Build the team's fluency in selling services and software together

**Own pipeline, forecast and results**

* Own team quota attainment across new business and expansion
* Run a disciplined pipeline and forecast cadence, and report results to the CRO and executive team
* Stay close to the deals that matter: join key client conversations, shape strategy and help the team close
* Use CRM data to spot what is working, what is stalling and where to focus

**Build the sales engine**

* Define and document a repeatable sales process, from qualification through close, for both productized and custom deals
* Establish the playbooks, messaging and tools the team needs to sell consistently
* Partner with the CRO on territory and account planning, pricing approach and compensation design
* Work with Marketing on pipeline generation and with Product on market feedback
* Lead the team's shift to selling the combined services and technology offering, including positioning, messaging and cross-sell into existing clients

**Partner across the business**

* Work with Sales Engineers on discovery, demonstrations and solution design
* Bring the Professional Services Group into deals early so scope, pricing and timelines are right before signature
* Represent Sales in deal review alongside Operations, Finance and Product
* Stay engaged through the transition from sale to delivery, so clients experience one team
* Coordinate with Account Management on renewals and growth within existing clients

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of B2B sales experience, including 3+ years leading and developing a sales team
* A record of meeting or beating team targets in a consultative, multi-stakeholder sale
* Experience selling professional services, software, or ideally both together
* Insurance, insurtech or financial services experience strongly preferred; curiosity and the ability to learn a technical domain quickly are required
* Experience building sales process and forecasting discipline in a growth-stage company, ideally PE- or VC-backed
* A coaching mindset, with examples of sellers you have developed and promoted
* Comfort working in the details: CRM data, deal strategy and live client conversations
* The ability to build trust across Sales, Delivery, Product and Finance in a fully remote company

**Why Join Us?**

* **Real scope at the right moment.** You will shape how Martin sells as we scale, with direct access to the CRO and executive team.
* **Expertise that scales.** Our value comes from deep insurance expertise, delivered through people and a platform. You will sell something clients need and that few firms can offer.
* **Own the outcomes.** We give leaders room to build and expect them to deliver. You will have the mandate to make the changes the team needs.
* **Do the right thing.** We sell what we can deliver and stand behind it. Long-term client trust matters more to us than a quick close.

* **A remote team that stays connected.** We are fully remote by design and invest in bringing people together.
* **Momentum you can sell.** A recent acquisition, an expanded engineering team and private equity backing give us the product, the resources and the ambition to grow.

**Salary and Benefits**

* **Base salary:** $185,000 – $210,000, based on experience.

* **Variable compensation:** On-target earnings (OTE) of $290,000 – $330,000, with an approximately 65/35 base-to-variable mix. Variable pay is tied to team performance.
* **Benefits:** Our salaries are complemented by an extensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance, including:

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan options
* Generous, flexible paid time off (PTO) policy
* Fully remote work environment

Title: Director of Sales & Marketing
Description:
**Your day to day**
