* Maintain effective business relationships with key decision makers and influencers.
* Conduct regular sales team meetings to review month-to-date and year-to-date performance against forecast.
* Conduct regular revenue meetings to forecast demand and set appropriate rate strategies.
* Set and direct channel management strategies, both on line and via the GDS.
* Represent voco® Doha West Bay Suites in all sales activities including travel trade shows, site inspections, client sales calls, and product training.
* Implement strategies to create effective lead generation internally as well as externally.
* Identify opportunities to foster partnerships with complementary businesses that deliver mutual benefit.
* Maintain contacts with relevant industry associations deemed beneficial to voco® Doha West Bay Suites.
* Manage relationships with key business partners including GDS representation, General Sales Agents, third party websites, and travel management companies (TMC’s).
* Prepare and submit a monthly sales report on time that reflects consolidated information from sales team activities, market intelligence and any necessary adjustments to the business and marketing plans.

**MARKETING**

* Implement effective promotional activities that support business plan objectives using social, print, on line, consumer direct and B2B channels.
* Direct public relations strategies that deliver positive media coverage, generate editorial content, brand profiling, industry awards other associated activities beneficial to voco® Doha West Bay Suites.

**PEOPLE**

* Conduct ongoing performance appraisal reviews in line with company guidelines for all direct reports.

* Identify appropriate training and development needs for the sales team.
* Demonstrate leadership by setting a positive and professional example.
* Be prepared to give and receive feedback on all matters pertaining to the performance and the conduct of the team, individuals and self.
* Manage the welfare of the sales team with a view to developing a positive and harmonious work place.
* Actively observe all workplace OHS requirements and report any issues to the relevant department manager without delay.

**GENERAL**

* Communicate effectively with all other operating departments of the property.
* Attend daily operations and sales briefings, weekly sales meetings, revenue/yield meetings, department head meetings, workplace safety meetings, monthly financial meetings and any other required meeting.
* Attend and deliver presentations to the owner, owner’s appointed representative and/or senior IHG executives as required.

* Identify opportunities to innovate service delivery and product offerings to meet and exceed client expectations.

* Develop a tactical marketing plan that successfully targets identified market segments.
* Set and review sales team performance. Ensure appropriate sales targets established with accountability for achieving all required activities to achieve goals.
* Effective implementation of the business plan. Review and update as and when required.
* Achieve budgeted revenue targets across all revenue streams eg: rooms, banquets and events.
* Manage and control department expenses in accordance with the budget guidelines.
* Achieve budgeted RevPAR.

Title: Channel Sales Director - Canada
Description:
### **About Us**

At Versa Networks, we're revolutionizing the way businesses connect, secure, and optimize their networks. Our mission is to secure anywhere, anytime access to anything. As a leader in Secure SD-WAN, SSE (Secure Service Edge), SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) and Next-generation Managed Services, we are empowering organizations across the globe to transform their IT infrastructure for the modern cloud era. Our innovative products enable enterprises to deliver a seamless, scalable, and secure digital experience, no matter where their users, devices, or applications are located. Founded by industry veterans and backed by premier venture capital firms, Versa is a market leader driving innovation and growth as it positions itself for a future IPO.

We believe in fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and customer success. Our team is comprised of passionate, forward-thinking professionals dedicated to driving the future of networking technology. We encourage creativity, offer opportunities for growth, and provide a dynamic environment where our people can thrive and make an impact.

At Versa Networks, we don’t just build products – we build relationships, elevate businesses, and shape the digital future. Join us and be part of a fast-paced, cutting-edge company that's making a real difference in how the world connects and communicates.

### **Job Summary**

Versa Networks is seeking an accomplished, highly motivated Director of Channel Sales – Canada to drive the expansion of our Service Provider, Managed Service Provider (MSP), and Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) business across the Canadian market.

This is a strategic, revenue-generating role responsible for developing and expanding relationships with Canada's leading Tier 1 telecommunications providers, including Rogers Communications and Bell Canada, while identifying, recruiting, and enabling high-potential MSP and MSSP partners throughout the country.

The successful candidate will be responsible for building a scalable partner ecosystem, driving adoption of Versa's networking and cybersecurity solutions, and generating sustainable recurring revenue through partner-led go-to-market strategies.

This position requires an entrepreneurial, hands-on sales leader with strong executive relationship skills, deep knowledge of the Canadian telecommunications and managed services landscape, and a demonstrated track record of developing new business.

The role is remote and must be based in Eastern Canada, preferably within Ontario or Quebec, to facilitate engagement with strategic partners and their leadership teams

### **Responsibilities**

Strategic Service Provider Account Development

* Own and execute Versa's channel sales strategy for Canada's Tier 1 telecommunications and service provider market, with particular emphasis on Rogers Communications, Bell Canada, and other strategic providers.
* Establish and expand executive-level relationships across partner product management, managed services, cybersecurity, network engineering, sales, and business development organizations.
* Identify opportunities to integrate Versa's SD-WAN, SASE, SSE, and security technologies into partners' managed networking and cybersecurity portfolios.
* Develop joint business plans, technology roadmaps, and go-to-market strategies with strategic service provider partners.
* Navigate complex partner organizations, commercial negotiations, procurement processes, and long-term technology evaluations.
* Drive strategic agreements and commercial commitments that create sustainable recurring revenue for Versa.

MSP & MSSP Ecosystem Development

* Identify, recruit, and develop high-potential MSP and MSSP partners across Canada.
* Prioritize partners with established enterprise and midmarket customer bases and the ability to deliver managed networking and security services.
* Develop relationships with partner executive leadership, sales organizations, and technical decision-makers.
* Build and execute partner business plans with defined revenue targets, pipeline commitments, and joint sales activities.
* Drive partner onboarding, technical enablement, sales readiness, and go-to-market execution.
* Expand existing partner relationships through additional Versa solutions and new managed service offerings.
* Establish a scalable and productive partner ecosystem focused on measurable revenue contribution.

Revenue Generation & Pipeline Management

* Own and deliver assigned annual bookings and Annual Contract Value (ACV) targets for the Canadian Service Provider, MSP, and MSSP business.
* Proactively generate new business opportunities through strategic partner development and joint selling.
* Build, maintain, and accurately forecast a qualified pipeline of partner-led opportunities.
* Collaborate with partners to identify and pursue enterprise and midmarket customer opportunities.
* Drive opportunities through technical validation, commercial negotiations, and contract execution.
* Establish measurable quarterly business objectives and conduct regular partner business reviews.
* Maintain strong accountability for pipeline conversion, partner productivity, and recurring revenue growth.

Solution Positioning & Go-to-Market Execution Position Versa's integrated networking and cybersecurity portfolio, including:

* Networking Solutions
* + Secure SD-WAN and Advanced SD-WAN
  + Software-Defined LAN (SD-LAN)
  + Secure routing and network transformation
  + Branch and distributed enterprise connectivity
  + Network segmentation and infrastructure modernization
* Cybersecurity Solutions
* + Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)
  + Security Service Edge (SSE)
  + Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)
  + Secure Web Gateway (SWG)
  + Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB)
  + Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW)
  + DNS Security and Filtering
  + Advanced Threat Protection and Data Loss Prevention
* Translate these capabilities into compelling managed service offerings that help partners differentiate, increase recurring revenue, improve customer retention, and expand their addressable markets.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with Versa's North American Service Provider leadership, solution engineering, product management, marketing, and customer success organizations.
* Coordinate executive engagement and strategic partner initiatives with Versa's senior leadership.
* Collaborate with internal teams to support partner technical evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and solution launches.
* Partner with channel marketing to develop joint campaigns, partner events, demand-generation initiatives, and sales enablement programs.
* Provide market intelligence and competitive insights to influence Versa's Canadian go-to-market strategy.

  
**Requirements**  

### **Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, channel sales, telecommunications, networking, or cybersecurity.
* Minimum 5 years of experience working with Service Providers, MSPs, MSSPs, or managed services organizations.
* Demonstrated success developing strategic partnerships and generating net-new revenue through indirect sales channels.
* Established relationships within the Canadian telecommunications, MSP, or MSSP ecosystem, preferably including Rogers, Bell Canada, or other major service providers.
* Strong understanding of SD-WAN, SASE, SSE, Zero Trust, and enterprise cybersecurity architectures.
* Proven experience developing partner business plans, building qualified pipelines, and exceeding sales quotas.
* Ability to engage credibly with senior executives, product leaders, technical stakeholders, and partner sales teams.
* Experience managing complex sales cycles, commercial negotiations, and strategic partner agreements.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Self-motivated, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate independently in a remote environment.
* Must reside in Eastern Canada and be willing to travel regularly throughout Canada and occasionally to the United States.
* Preferred Qualifications
* + Existing executive relationships within Rogers Communications, Bell Canada, or other major Canadian telecommunications providers.
  + Experience building or scaling an MSP/MSSP partner ecosystem in Canada.
  + Background selling networking and cybersecurity solutions through service providers.
  + Familiarity with competitive technologies from Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, HPE/Juniper, and other SASE or SD-WAN providers.
  + Experience launching managed networking or security offerings with telecommunications providers.
  + Bilingual proficiency in English and French is an asset, particularly for engagement with Quebec-based partners.

Location: Toronto, Canada

 **Benefits**  

### **Why Versa?**

At Versa Networks, we believe in taking care of our people – both professionally and personally. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being, growth, and work-life balance of our employees. When you join our team, you can expect:

* Competitive Salary & Incentives: We offer a competitive compensation package with and pre-IPO equity to reward your hard work and dedication.
* Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans to ensure you and your family stay healthy and covered.
* Paid Time Off (PTO): Enjoy a generous PTO policy that includes vacation days, sick leave, and paid holidays to recharge and take care of personal matters.
* Flexible Work Environment: We understand the importance of work-life balance. Enjoy the flexibility of remote work, and hybrid option to create the work schedule that works best for you.
* Professional Development: We believe in continuous learning. Access to training, certifications, and educational resources to help you grow in your career and stay ahead of industry trends.
* Employee Recognition: We celebrate achievements both big and small, with regular recognition programs and awards that highlight your contributions to our collective success.
* Collaborative Culture: Be part of a dynamic, inclusive, and supportive team where innovation and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do.
* Parental Leave: Generous parental leave policies to support you during life's important moments.

At Versa Networks, our benefits are designed to help you thrive both inside and outside the office. Join us and experience a rewarding, fulfilling career in a supportive environment that values your health, happiness, and success.

Versa Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Title: Sales Manager - Tashkeel
Description:
**Sales Manager Tashkeel**

**Department**: Sales & Business Development  
**Reporting to**: Director of Operations & Commercial Strategy and General Manager  
**Working with**: Marketing Manager, Art Consultant, Design Consultant, Business Development Manager, Workshop Team, Graphic Design & Branding Team, and Accounts Team  
**Location**: Tashkeel, Nad Al Sheba 1, Dubai, UAE  
**Employment Type**: Full-time  
**Salary Range** : AED 15,000 - 18,000 per month + sales commission per quarter  
**Start Date**: January 2027

**About Tashkeel**

Established in 2008, Tashkeel is a Dubai-based art and design studio and consultancy supporting creative practice, professional development, and the growth of the UAE's art and design industries.

Tashkeel operates across education and outreach, workshops, exhibitions, artist and designer mentorship programmes, retail, and commercial creative services.

Its professional development initiatives include the Tanween Design Programme, Critical Practice Programme (CPP), and Art & Design Residencies.

Through its commercial consultancy, Tasmeem Tashkeel, the organisation provides bespoke art and design commissions, graphic design and branding, interior and spatial design, furniture and product development, manufacturing, corporate and VIP gifting, public art, and complete turnkey solutions for corporate, government, hospitality, and private clients.

**Position Overview**

Tashkeel is seeking an experienced, results-driven Sales Manager responsible for generating new business, securing contracts, expanding commercial partnerships, and achieving revenue targets across Tashkeel and Tasmeem Tashkeel.

The role requires a strong B2B sales professional capable of selling educational programmes, corporate workshops, wholesale products, artwork, branding, bespoke design services, and large-scale commercial commissions.

A key responsibility is identifying opportunities to cross-sell services across departments, transforming individual client requirements into larger, integrated turnkey projects.

The Sales Manager will work closely with internal specialists to develop commercially viable proposals, while maintaining direct responsibility for client acquisition, negotiations, sales conversion, and revenue growth.

This is strictly a sales position, not a marketing or creative management role.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Workshops, Courses & Educational Programme Sales**

* Work closely with the Workshop and Education & Outreach teams to increase enrolment and sales for weekend drop-in workshops, structured courses, seasonal programmes, and creative learning activities at Tashkeel.
* Secure contracts with schools for after-school workshops, term-based programmes, and recurring educational activities.
* Develop and sell corporate team-building workshops, employee engagement experiences, and creative development programmes to commercial and government entities.
* Establish annual and recurring workshop contracts with companies, schools, universities, and institutions.
* Understand Tashkeel's mentorship and professional development programmes, including Tanween and CPP, to identify suitable commercial partnerships and institutional opportunities.
* Coordinate workshop proposals, pricing, capacity, and scheduling with the Workshop team and Accounts department.

**2. Tasmeem Tashkeel Commercial Sales**

* Generate new business for bespoke design, product development, manufacturing, furniture, lighting, interior design, corporate and VIP gifting, public art, and turnkey commissions.
* Target developers, hospitality groups, architects, interior designers, luxury brands, government entities, corporate clients, and private collectors.
* Work closely with the Art Consultant on artwork sales, art commissions, public art, and art consultancy projects.
* Work closely with the Design Consultant on interior design, furniture, spatial design, and bespoke product commissions.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, long-term commercial relationships, and larger project contracts.
* Coordinate with the relevant consultants and production teams to establish project scope, feasibility, pricing, and delivery requirements.

**3. Graphic Design, Branding & Integrated Turnkey Sales**

* Actively acquire clients for Tashkeel's graphic design and branding team, securing commissions for brand identity, visual communication, packaging, branded collateral, and complete branding projects.
* Target new businesses, hospitality operators, developers, retailers, corporate organisations, and established brands seeking new identities or rebranding services.
* Work with the Graphic Design & Branding Team to develop client briefs, proposals, and commercial quotations.
* Identify opportunities to expand branding commissions into interior design, signage, furniture, product design, packaging, and bespoke manufacturing.
* Collaborate across the branding, interior design, product design, and production teams to present integrated turnkey solutions to clients.
* Maximise the commercial value of each client relationship by identifying additional services that can be delivered across Tasmeem Tashkeel's departments.

**4. Retail, Wholesale & Product Distribution**

* Identify and secure new wholesale clients, retail stockists, museum shops, concept stores, hotels, and design boutiques in the UAE and selected international markets.
* Manage relationships with existing wholesale clients, encouraging repeat orders and increased product placement.
* Negotiate wholesale agreements, minimum order quantities, pricing, and commercial terms.
* Identify opportunities for exclusive collections, bulk orders, seasonal products, and corporate gifting.
* Work with Retail, Production, and Accounts to ensure product availability, competitive pricing, and approved profit margins.
* Support revenue growth across Tashkeel's physical and online retail channels.

**5. Client Acquisition, Contracts & Sales Management**

* Proactively generate qualified leads through direct outreach, networking, client meetings, presentations, and industry events.
* Develop and maintain relationships with corporate clients, government entities, procurement departments, retailers, and private clients.
* Manage the full sales cycle from initial enquiry and client presentation through quotation, negotiation, and signed contract.
* Work with the in-house Accounts team to calculate sales prices, project costs, gross profit margins, and financial forecasts.
* Ensure all proposals and quotations are commercially approved before submission and that no consultancy or design work begins without an agreed scope and approved commercial terms.
* Coordinate with Project Managers and relevant departments to hand over confirmed projects for execution.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, sales forecasts, client follow-ups, and weekly pipeline reports.
* Work closely with the Marketing Manager to convert campaign-generated leads into confirmed sales, without responsibility for marketing or content production.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The Sales Manager will be assessed against the following proposed performance targets, subject to management approval.

**Sales Revenue:** Achieve 100% or more of assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets

**Qualified Client Meetings**: 12–16 per month

**New Sales Opportunities** 10–15 qualified opportunities per month

**Sales Conversion** Convert 25–35% of qualified proposals into confirmed contracts

**Sales Pipeline** Maintain a qualified pipeline of at least 3 times the next quarter's sales target

**Corporate & Educational Contracts** Secure 4–8 new workshop, team-building, or educational contracts per quarter

**Workshop & Course Sales** Meet agreed monthly enrolment and booking revenue targets

**Tasmeem Commercial Contracts** Secure 1–3 new contracts per quarter, depending on project value

**Branding & Graphic Design Sales** Meet agreed quarterly contract and revenue targets

**Cross-Departmental Sales** Generate measurable additional revenue through integrated, multi-service projects

**Wholesale Expansion** Secure 2–3 new stockists or wholesale accounts per quarter

**Repeat Business** Generate at least 30% of annual revenue from returning clients and repeat orders

**Profitability & Collections** Meet approved gross profit margins and coordinate timely collection of payments

**CRM & Reporting** Maintain accurate weekly pipeline updates and monthly sales forecasts

Performance will be evaluated primarily on confirmed contracts, collected revenue, profitability, new client acquisition, and repeat business, rather than enquiries or meetings alone.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales, Business Development, or a related field.
* Minimum 7 years of proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or commercial account management.
* Demonstrated success in achieving revenue targets and securing high-value commercial contracts.
* Experience selling professional services, creative consultancy, branding, interior design, corporate solutions, bespoke products, or educational programmes.
* Strong understanding of client acquisition, pricing, negotiation, contract management, and sales forecasting.
* Experience working with corporate organisations, government entities, procurement teams, developers, and hospitality clients.
* Established professional network within the UAE commercial market is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Proficiency in CRM systems and sales reporting.
* Fluent English required; Arabic is a strong advantage.

**Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a commercially focused B2B sales professional who can independently identify opportunities, approach decision-makers, negotiate contracts, and consistently close business.

They must understand how to sell both individual services and integrated solutions, recognising when a branding project can develop into a complete interior, product, and spatial design commission.

The successful candidate must be organised, proactive, confident in dealing with senior clients, and capable of coordinating with specialist teams without taking over their technical responsibilities.

* Serve as a senior-level subject matter expert for document control systems, processes, and standards, providing strategic direction and best practice guidance across the organization
* Mentor, coach, and provide technical support to Document Controllers, Program Analysts, and project teams, fostering a culture of accuracy and accountability
* Act as a system administrator or power user for enterprise Document Control Systems, managing configuration, user permissions, workflows, and troubleshooting to optimize system performance
* Lead enterprise document control initiatives, including system rollout, enhancements, adoption strategies, and change management efforts
* Oversee document intake, processing, distribution, storage, and archival activities while ensuring strict compliance with standards, contractual requirements, and regulatory obligations
* Enforce adherence to document control procedures, metadata requirements, naming conventions, version control, and classification standards across all projects
* Review document submittals for completeness, accuracy, and compliance prior to acceptance into document management systems
* Support audit readiness efforts by ensuring documentation is complete, traceable, properly maintained, and readily available for inspection
* Participate in the procurement, deployment, configuration, and optimization of enterprise-wide Document Control Systems
* Define system requirements, workflows, user roles, and reporting capabilities in collaboration with IT and business stakeholders
* Identify system gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities; recommend and implement enhancements to increase efficiency and data integrity
* Develop and maintain comprehensive process maps, standard operating procedures (SOPs), desk manuals, and system user guides
* Monitor and analyze document control performance metrics, workload trends, and compliance indicators to drive operational excellence
* Maintain document control dashboards, trackers, and reporting tools to provide visibility into system health and operational performance
* Support risk identification and mitigation by maintaining document control risk logs and issue trackers
* Prepare detailed summaries, reports, and briefings for leadership regarding document control performance, system adoption, and strategic recommendations
* Serve as the primary point of contact for document control matters with internal staff, consultants, contractors, and external partners
* Coordinate closely with project teams, IT departments, Business Analysts, procurement, and compliance staff to address document control needs
* Provide comprehensive training, onboarding, and ongoing support to users of document control systems

Title: Storekeeper cum Buyer
Description:
**Job Summary**

The Store Keeper cum Buyer is responsible for managing the hotel's inventory, receiving, storing, issuing, and purchasing of goods and materials required for daily hotel operations. The position ensures that all items are procured at competitive prices, maintained at appropriate stock levels, and delivered in accordance with the hotel's quality standards and operational requirements.

The role involves coordinating with various departments, suppliers, and the Finance Department to ensure efficient stock control, timely procurement, cost management, and compliance with hotel purchasing procedures.

**Key Responsibilities1. Store & Inventory Management**

* Receive, inspect, and verify all incoming goods against purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices.
* Ensure all received items meet the hotel's quality and quantity requirements.
* Maintain proper storage, handling, and organization of goods in designated storage areas.
* Monitor stock levels and ensure adequate inventory is maintained.
* Issue goods to various hotel departments against approved requisitions.
* Conduct regular stock counts and participate in monthly inventory checks.
* Maintain accurate records of stock receipts, issues, transfers, and balances.
* Monitor expiry dates and ensure proper stock rotation using FIFO (First In, First Out).
* Report damaged, expired, or slow-moving items to the concerned department.

**2. Purchasing & Procurement**

* Source products and materials based on approved purchase requests from hotel departments.
* Obtain quotations from suppliers and compare prices, quality, and delivery terms.
* Prepare purchase orders in accordance with the hotel's procurement procedures.
* Follow up with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of ordered goods.
* Negotiate with suppliers to obtain competitive prices and favorable payment terms.
* Maintain good professional relationships with suppliers and service providers.
* Ensure purchased items comply with the hotel's quality standards and specifications.
* Identify alternative suppliers and cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality.
* Coordinate with the Finance Department regarding invoices, quotations, and payment documentation.

**3. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of purchase orders, quotations, delivery notes, and invoices.
* Ensure all purchasing and inventory transactions are properly documented.
* Prepare monthly stock reports and inventory summaries.
* Monitor stock consumption and report unusual variations.
* Ensure proper filing and documentation for internal and external audits.
* Follow hotel purchasing policies, financial procedures, and internal control standards.

**4. Coordination & Communication**

* Coordinate with all hotel departments to understand their purchasing and stock requirements.
* Communicate with suppliers regarding product availability, pricing, and delivery schedules.
* Work closely with the Finance, Cost Control, and operational teams.
* Respond promptly to urgent departmental requirements while following approval procedures.
* Maintain effective communication with the Director of Finance and Purchasing Manager.

**5. Health, Safety & Compliance**

* Maintain cleanliness, hygiene, and safety standards within all storage areas.
* Ensure proper storage of food, chemicals, equipment, and other materials.
* Follow hotel health and safety policies and applicable UAE regulations.
* Ensure restricted and hazardous materials are stored and handled appropriately.
* Maintain confidentiality of supplier pricing, contracts, and purchasing information.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Purchasing, or a related field is preferred.
* Minimum 2–3 years of relevant experience in storekeeping and purchasing, preferably within the hospitality industry.
* Previous experience in hotel stores, procurement, and inventory management is an advantage.
* Knowledge of inventory control, purchasing procedures, and supplier management.
* Familiarity with hotel operating systems and inventory software.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Good negotiation and supplier management skills.
* Strong organizational and inventory control abilities.
* Good numerical and analytical skills.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in documentation.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and email correspondence.
* Knowledge of FIFO and stock management procedures.
* Honest, reliable, and committed to maintaining company standards.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Accuracy of stock records and inventory reports.
* Timely procurement and delivery of requested items.
* Effective inventory control and reduction of unnecessary stock.
* Cost savings through competitive supplier negotiations.
* Compliance with purchasing and inventory procedures.
* Minimization of stock shortages, wastage, and expired items.

**General Responsibilities**

* Perform any additional duties assigned by the Head of Department or Management.
* Demonstrate the Accor values and uphold the Heartist culture.
* Maintain professional conduct and support teamwork across all hotel departments.
* Contribute to delivering operational excellence and guest satisfaction.

**Department:** Finance / Stores & Purchasing

**Position:** Store Keeper cum Buyer

**Location:** Mercure Hotel Suites & Apartments, Barsha Heights, Dubai, UAE

**Reports To:** Assistant Purchasing Manage/Purchasing Manager

Pay: AED2,250.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Health Coordinator

Our mission is bold: To design and deliver research and evidence-based approaches to eliminate the gaps between young childrenʼs inherent potential and their achievement in school and life. * Oversees Health and Disabilities Advocates to assure that all families have quality medical and dental homes, and maintain consistent health insurance coverage, if eligible.

To meet the growing demand for AWS cloud computing capacity in EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa) we are now looking for a Commissioning Engineer to join the team.
  
  
Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning?  
  
As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of AWS owned data centres, Hybrid Colo's, Single Tennent Colo and Multi Tennent Colo builds . The AWS Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements.

You will be responsible for supporting vendors, contractors and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:  
  

* Medium and low voltage power systems
* Generators
* UPS
* HVAC
* Chilled Water Systems
* Building Management systems (BMS)
* Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
* Testing and balancing

The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning, the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects.

The CxE's daily focus is to ensure the commissioning quality and progress meet AWS's high standards by:  
Developing commissioning standards.  
Reviewing, comment on, and creating commissioning scripts L1-L5.  
Organize and attend meetings highlighting AWS requirements and tracking overall build and commissioning progress and blockers.  
Performing site walks to identify installation and testing deficiencies and maintain observation logs.  
Manage on-site 3rd-party commissioning vendors to ensure coverage of all Cx-activities.  
Gather, organize, and review design and commissioning documentation.  
Work with AWS partner teams to resolve coordination and delivery issues and report on project health and completion.

The AWS Data Center Commissioning Team (ACx) is a wholly independent business within the DCCD organization. * 4+ years of commissioning experience

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Facilities Maintenance Management**

* Coordinate facility inspections, audits, and preventive maintenance activities.
* Ensure compliance with local building regulations, safety standards, and organizational requirements.
* Support the implementation of energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives within facility operations.
* Monitor facility conditions and recommend corrective or improvement actions.

Title: SRO, Customer Excellence.
Description:
We are looking for a Senior Responsible Owner (SRO) for Customer Excellence to lead Echelon’s Customer Excellence Program and own the customer 360, our single view of each customer. You will set how AI agents and account teams work together, so that everyone who serves a customer works from the same, accurate picture.
  
  
****The role: one view of the customer****
Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you own the customer 360 across our accounts. You work with the CRO’s account teams, the Head of AI Transformation and the deployment strategists, the engineers in the pods, and the leadership team. You bring partner insight into each customer’s view and work closely with the marketing and communications lead on customer engagements.
  
  
****What you’ll do****

* Build the customer 360. One record and one account plan per customer, kept current by AI agents and approved by the account owner: organization and decision makers, systems and data landscape, AI maturity, contracts, projects, pipeline, delivery history and value delivered.
* Own customer data. The quality of customer data in our CRM and delivery tools: what is captured, by whom and when, who can edit it, and how the account teams and pods use it.
* Read the customer. Each customer’s strategy, budgets, AI priorities, leadership changes and buying cycles, briefed to the account teams and strategists before key meetings.
* Measure customer health. Satisfaction and health measures across accounts, feedback after each engagement, and early warnings on accounts at risk.
* Run the cadence. The weekly presence on accounts: account reviews, executive touchpoints, customer events and programs, and their follow-up.
* Inform leadership. A regular customer review for the COO and the leadership team: where we win, where we lose, and what customers ask for that we do not yet deliver.

****What you bring****

* Customer record: 6+ years in customer success, account operations, CRM or customer analytics in a technology or services business.
* Data fluency: At ease with CRM systems, dashboards and imperfect data, and able to make them useful to others.
* Rigour: You keep records accurate and current without being asked, and build simple processes that last.
* Connector: You work across sales, delivery and leadership, and earn trust by being useful.
* AI fluency: You find use cases for AI and turn them into agentic workflows that serve the Customer Excellence Program end to end, and you decide where a person must review their work.

****Strong advantage****

* Sector knowledge: Experience with customers in a sector where Echelon leads, such as government, energy, financial services or healthcare.
* CRM platforms: Hands-on administration of a major CRM platform.
* Arabic: Professional fluency in Arabic.

****Our values****

* Customer first: You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritize accordingly.
* Ownership mentality: You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* Clear communicator: You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* Long-term builder: You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.
* Builds others: You measure yourself by the people you develop and the capability you build with customers.

****How we work****
You start from the customer’s problem and choose the tool to fit it. You meet an unclear brief or a broken environment with energy and a plan.
  
  

* Curiosity: You learn how the work really happens on site and keep learning as the stack moves.
* Speed: You move from brief to a first working result quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions.
* Rigour: You test claims against the data, check what is delivered and can explain every choice.
* Confidence and humility: You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego.
* Autonomy: You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organize the work yourself.
* Resourcefulness: Missing access, partial data, an unfamiliar organization: you find a way with what is available.
* Situational leadership: You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call.
* A force multiplier: Your playbooks, reviews and coaching make the whole bench faster.
* AI-native depth: AI tools are part of how you research, write and decide. You are comfortable working alongside AI agents and setting the rules for when a person must approve their work.
* Who you are: An organized operator who loves customers and data in equal measure, and wants to build a function from the start.

****The seat****

* Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
* Reports to: Chief Operating Officer
* Travel: Time at customer sites and events across the Kingdom
* Package: A base salary with housing, transport and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity program. Terms are shared at offer stage.

Title: Infrastructure Engineer TID
Description:
**Company Description**

Egis is a leading global architectural, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services firm. We create and operate intelligent infrastructure and buildings that both respond to the climate emergency and contribute to balanced, sustainable and resilient development.

Our 23,500 employees operate across over 70 countries, deploying their expertise to develop and deliver cutting-edge innovations and solutions for clients. Through the wide range of our activities, we are central to the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.

 **Job Description**

**Job Purpose:**

Under general supervision performs responsible professional engineering review, assessment, inspection, and administrative duties. This includes reviews of design- & construction- and development proposals related to all infrastructure projects (i.e., roads, highways, bridges, utilities of all kinds, etc.) and ensuring compliance with Qatar Rail requirements, asset protection and future safeguarding. Further advises interfacing parties on NOC requirements, conditions and required actions to obtain approvals.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

The **Infrastructure Engineer** will be responsible for the review of 3rd party applications in reference to Metro/ LRT/Long Distance project interfaces for the operational railways and future phases. The tasks will include review of plans, schematics, calculations, and specifications. The Infrastructure Engineer is required to effectively work with all involved parties, assess proposals, make recommendations, and determines comprehensive response to 3rd party requests. It includes working closely with, coordinating, and collaborating with all Qatar Rail departments, agencies/authorities, designers, and contractors internal and external to ensure conclusive and timely response. These responsibilities include attending meetings with various stakeholders.

* Provide infrastructure interface & coordination services (assistance, guidance) for the Qatar Rail schemes in relation to multiple interfaces with applicants, designers, utility agencies, contractors, stakeholders, etc.
* Review, assess, evaluate, and respond to third party requests, design-, engineering-, and construction- documents including plans, work method and specifications to ensure compliance with applicable requirements, codes, ordinances, and standards (NOC, MME, DR, RO, PTW, IPD, others); with sound understanding of utility works.
* Supporting the sr. engineer and manager as well as the relevant co-workers, departments in tasks related to approvals.
* Ensure & check completeness of documents and submissions as part of the NOC process.
* Provide and prepare interface drawings and relevant response documents.
* Participate in and create manuals, forms, procedures for processing stakeholder applications.
* Identify elements for optimizations and improvement of the department.
* Act as a link between PMC, D&B contractor and third parties.
* Attend and record meetings and act as contact person for local authorities.
* As required, inspect sites on a periodical basis to ensure conformance with permits, design specifications and adherence to quality. Provide site inspection reports.
* Resolve issues within level of authority and address modifications or changes.
* Plan, organize, track, control and evaluate the assigned functions and activities. Works proactively and responsibly.
* Maintain logs and records of work performed; prepares periodic and special reports.
* Monitor and track the TID correspondence (documentation of day-to-day work).
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**General:**

* Incorporate zero harm into staff yearly performance reviews by incorporating and taking into consideration, staff commitment to the Qatar Rail values of safety and environment.
* Commitment to the Zero Harm Ethos by leading by example and taking personal responsibility for their own health and safety and proactively ensuring that any health and safety concerns observed are raised to prevent harm.
* Support the QR Environmental program in reducing QR carbon footprint.
* Managers need to be familiar with relevant laws, regulations and standards that apply to their area of operation.
* Proactive identification of potential hazards/environmental aspects and implementing effective control measures to minimize risks.
* Liaise with HSE professionals from QSHESE Department on complex issues.
* Comply with Qatar Rail’s Company Management System requirements which covers Quality, Health, Safety, Environment, Information Security, Business continuity, Security and Emergency preparedness requiements.
* Attendance of any QSHESE Induction, training, briefing, or meeting as and when required and/or requested to.
* Be mindful that Health and Safety, Quality, Security and Environment is everyone’s responsibility and as such all-Qatar Rail employees are accountable for reporting and intervening in Health, Safety, Quality, Security and Environmental violations.
* Report all incidents and/or near misses, and/or unsafe acts or conditions and where appropriate make recommendations for improvement.
* Ensure your visitor (including contractors, PMCs) are aware of Qatar Rail premise’s emergency response plans.
* Act ethically and within Qatar Rail’s Code of Conduct.
* Undertake additional tasks as required based emerging business needs.

**Authorities:**

The position covers all interfaces through Technical Interface Department with the relevant authorities and governmental bodies. The main interface is related to authorities and stakeholders in relation to 3rd party management for the purpose of permitting within the Rail-Protection-Zone.

**Accountabilities:**

* Establishing clear line of communication with the relevant team members, departments, external stakeholders.
* Review and approve NOC-third party applications, for resign review (DR)- and road opening (RO), permit applications.
* Participate & prepare clear procedure(s) related to stakeholder management.
* Produce status- and progress reports.
* Participate in meetings, audits, presentations, workshops, and other events

**Key Interfaces:**

***Internal:***

* All Metro-, Tram lines and Long-Distance Railway.
* Departments within Program Delivery & Service Delivery
* Contractors & Joint Ventures & Consultants.
* RKH Qitarat (Service Provider)

***External:***

* Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Municipality, Public Works Authority, Civil Aviation Authority, Qatar Foundation, Private Engineering Office, Ministry of Interior (multiple departments), Supreme Committee for Delivery & Legacy, Qatar Olympic Committee, Qatar Ports Authority, Qatar Armed Forces, Hamad International Airport .
* Kahramaa Electricity & Water, Qatar Cool, Qatar Energy (Petroleum), Vodafone, QNBN, Ooredoo, MOI Police, other affected utility companies.
* Third party developers (governmental & private)
* Contractors & consultants
* Third party entities potentially affecting the Qatar Rail assets within the Rail Protection Zone.

 **Qualifications**  

* (B.Sc.) degree in civil engineering or related engineering discipline.
* A minimum of 4 years of documentable experience in fields of infrastructure/utility design and preferably large-scale projects and railway projects. GCC experience is beneficial.
* Knowledge of permitting procedures, requirements, and public approvals.
* Knowledge in infrastructure planning, design, and construction of roads, bridges, drinking water, wastewater, storm drainage, irrigation, power transmission/distribution, and preferably gas-, oil pipelines, district cooling.
* Registered as professional engineer is desirable.
* Membership with professional bodies is desirable.

 **Additional Information**

**Skills:**

* Advanced computer skills in Microsoft office including Word, Excel, Power Point and other computer programs.
* Experience with web-based collaboration technologies for project information and process management software (i.e., Aconex, QDRS / QPRO, etc.).
* Experience with AutoCAD is desired.
* Excellent technical writing skills.
* Applicant to be fluent in English (verbal/written); Arabic language skills are beneficial.

**Soft Competencies:**

* Excellent verbal, written communication skills and presentation skills
* Self-motivated team-player, capable of working independently & organized
* Ability to analyze situations accurately and take effective action & make critical decisions in stressful situations
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders, peers, and members of the public.

In this role, you will identify and resolve complex network issues, guide technical investigations, and ensure network stability through advanced troubleshooting and strong solution ownership. You will drive Customer Service Requests (CSRs), coordinate activities across support functions, and provide technical leadership during major incidents, emergency handling, and crisis situations.The role requires strong knowledge of customer networks, operational processes, and Packet Core technologies, combined with the ability to work effectively with customers and global cross-functional teams.

* Own and drive complex Customer Service Requests (CSRs) from initiation to closure, ensuring effective coordination and customer satisfaction.
* Lead complex Packet Core network and node investigations, troubleshooting technical issues and identifying root causes.
* Develop and coordinate solutions to restore and maintain network stability.
* Provide technical leadership during major incidents, emergency handling, customer escalations, and crisis situations.
* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned solutions throughout investigation, resolution, and service improvement.
* Build strong customer relationships by understanding their network environment, priorities, and operational requirements.
* Collaborate with engineers and cross-functional teams to share knowledge and improve troubleshooting efficiency.
* Identify product, process, and service improvements and translate technical findings into clear requirements.
* Identify potential business opportunities arising from customer requirements and operational challenges.
* Escalate recurring problems, process deficiencies, and operational irregularities to relevant stakeholders.
* Create and maintain known solutions and technical knowledge articles.
* Apply relevant Solution Management and global support processes.

**The skills you bring:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Telecommunications, IT, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 10+ years of relevant telecommunications experience, with extensive Packet Core support, integration, or operations expertise.
* Strong troubleshooting, fault-finding, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills.

Under the general direction of the Manager, Systems and Infrastructure, the System Engineer is a senior level hands-on technical leader responsible for the architecture, design, implementation, and ongoing operation of enterprise grade server and systems infrastructure in a multi-site, 24x7 environment.
  
The System Engineer combines deep technical expertise with system architecture ownership, ensuring infrastructure solutions are secure, resilient, scalable, and operationally sustainable across geographically distributed locations. This role acts as the primary systems architect for their assigned domains, translating business and operational requirements into detailed technical designs and leading those designs through implementation and lifecycle support.

Working within a large IT team, the System Engineer diagnoses and resolves complex technical issues; proactively monitors, optimizes, automates, and patches systems; and builds and deploys new virtual and physical platforms on premises and hybrid multi cloud environments.

**Key Accountabilities:**

Infrastructure Operations & Technical Support

* Responsible for the administration, maintenance, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting of assigned systems and infrastructure, including cloud platforms, servers, storage, virtualization, Active Directory, Microsoft Azure and Office 365, endpoint management, databases, disaster recovery technologies, security tools, and virtual desktop environments.
* Perform regular system optimization and maintenance activities including patching, upgrades, configuration management, and performance tuning.
* Provide tier-3 escalation support and troubleshooting, resolving complex infrastructure, hardware, software, and operating system issues.
Participate in after-hours on-call rotation and works non-standard hours as required, with accountability for ensuring systems are architected to be stable, supportable, and recoverable.  

Systems Architecture & Infrastructure Design

* Own the system architecture for assigned infrastructure domains, including defining standards, reference architectures, design patterns, and technical roadmaps.
* Design, implement, and support systems that meet the demands of a 24x7, mission-critical, multi-site operation, with emphasis on high availability, resiliency, fault tolerance, and recoverability.
* Lead requirements gathering, architecture, technical design, and deployment of new systems and major enhancements in collaboration with the System Manager, IT peers, and business stakeholders.
* Act as technical lead and systems architect on small and large IT initiatives, providing design authority and implementation guidance.
* Define and implement standardized architectures and configurations across multiple sites to ensure consistency, reliability, and simplified operational support.

Security, Resiliency & Business Continuity:

* Ensure monitoring, alerting, backup, disaster recovery, and security controls are designed into all solutions and aligned with operational and business continuity requirements.
* Participate in disaster recovery testing exercises and contribute to business continuity planning for business-critical systems.
* Analyze recurring incidents and outages to identify architectural or design improvements and lead remediation efforts to reduce future operational risk.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and modernization, proposing solutions that improve reliability, security, and operational efficiency.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

* Provide technical leadership and guidance across infrastructure projects, operational initiatives, and modernization efforts.
* Mentor and support System Administrators, promoting best practices, knowledge sharing, and consistent engineering standards.
Collaborate with IT peers, leadership, vendors, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure solutions  

Change Management & Governance

* Ensure infrastructure solutions align with enterprise standards, operational requirements, and governance frameworks.
Create and maintain accurate system, architecture, and operational documentation and knowledge base articles.

* Demonstrated experience in systems architecture, technical design, and solution implementation.

Title: Process Coordinator
Description:
Role summary

The Process Coordinator leads AI-led process redesign. The role takes each business process cuts it down to the steps and fields that matter, gets the rules built into Zoho CRM, and replaces manual reports with live, AI-generated dashboards for each department and role.

The goal is simple: people put the right data in the right place at the right time, and AI turns it into decisions. Managers and coordinators should stop building reports and chasing updates by hand.

This is a process and data role, not a training role. The right person reads workflows and Zoho logic, thinks in fields and data, and is comfortable shortening a process and challenging a manager when a step adds no value.

Key responsibilities1. Process redesign

* Map each current process end to end from the CRM field list, the current SOP and how the team actually works.

* Cut steps and fields that do not feed a decision or a report.

* Set one owner and one time limit for every stage.

* Define the blocking rules the CRM must enforce (for example, no case closes without evidence; no paid job closes without an invoice number), each with a logged override.

* Link modules so data flows without re-entry (for example, case to invoice; confirmed deal to PRQ, PO and delivery).

* Write the one-page SOP for each process: stage, owner, time limit, what must exist before moving on, and what is automatic.

* Take each redesign to the department head and the fortnightly Signal review for approval; L&D then signs off the final SOP.

2. Live dashboards with AI tools

* Own the live dashboards produced through AI tools and Zoho Analytics.

* Assign department-specific and role-specific dashboards: what a sales coordinator, a manager, a division manager and a department head each need to see every day.

* Use the dashboards in real-time reviews and daily huddles so discussions run on live data, not on spreadsheets prepared the night before.

* Set up daily exception lists and weekly reports pulled automatically from the CRM and from source documents (SOPs, POs, invoices, PRQs), so nobody types the same data twice.

* Check data quality before trusting a dashboard: blocking rules come before dashboards, because AI on bad data gives confident wrong answers.

3. Less manual work

* Find every manual report, Excel tracker and repeated hand-off in each department and replace it with a dashboard or an automatic summary.

* Formally retire the old report the day the new dashboard goes live, so teams do not run both.

* Work with IT to clean up automatic tasks that a CRM rule can replace, and raise on-time completion of tasks.

* Track and report manual reporting hours removed.

4. Rollout and adoption

* Run the 8-step redesign cycle for each process: AI baseline audit, design, build, pilot, measure, fix, roll out, retire the old way.

* Write clear build requirements for IT (fields, module links, Blueprint rules, automations) and test them before go-live.

* Support DMs and department heads, who own adoption in their teams.

* Prepare and present at the fortnightly Signal review with senior leadership and IT: designs for approval, blockers and numbers against baseline.

Role requirements

* Can read a Zoho CRM module (fields, layouts, Blueprints, workflows) and explain what it does and where it breaks.

* Can take a field list and an SOP and produce a shorter, rule-based process on paper within a day.

* Uses AI tools daily for analysis, summaries and dashboards, and knows how to check their output.

* Comfortable telling a senior manager that a step or a report should go, and backing it with data.

* Measures improvement as numbers against a baseline, not opinions.

* Leads change across departments and holds a redesign under challenge from senior managers, with the Sponsor's backing.

* Fluent written and spoken English; Arabic or Hindi is a plus.

Education

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Information Systems, Operations Management, Business Analytics or a related field.

Industry experience

* **4-6 years** in process improvement, business analysis, CRM operations or sales/service operations.

* At least **2 years hands-on with a CRM**, ideally Zoho CRM (Salesforce or Dynamics also acceptable).

* Experience in **B2B trading, industrial equipment, distribution or after-sales service**, preferably in the UAE or GCC.

* Has led at least one process redesign or CRM rollout from mapping to go-live, with measurable results.

* Experience building or running management dashboards that replaced manual reports.

**Required skills**

Technical

* Zoho CRM: modules, fields, layouts, Blueprints, workflow rules, reports

* Dashboards and BI: Zoho Analytics, Power BI or similar

* AI tools for analysis and reporting (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot), including pulling data from documents and CRM exports

* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets (pivots, lookups, data cleaning)

* Process mapping (Visio, Lucidchart, Miro or BPMN tools)

* Basic understanding of automations and integrations (Deluge, APIs, Zapier) is a plus

Analytical

* Reads data and fields to find where a process breaks

* Builds a baseline and measures change against it

* Spots bad data and its root cause before it reaches a dashboard

* Turns findings into a short, clear decision for a manager

Behavioural

* Simplifier: removes steps instead of adding them

* Confident with senior managers; willing to challenge

* Structured and finishes what it starts: one process at a time, closed properly

* Clear writer: one-page SOPs, short build specs, plain reports

* Patient with teams during change; firm on the rules

Pay: AED3,000.00 - AED4,500.00 per month

Description:

**Our Team's Vision:**

Illumio is the breach containment company. Built on Zero Trust principles, the Illumio platform combines real-time visibility with segmentation and AI-powered detection and response, helping organizations stop the spread of breaches and ransomware across hybrid, multi-cloud, and on-premises environments before they become disasters. Illumio Segmentation contains attackers by stopping lateral movement across the enterprise, and Illumio Insights delivers AI-driven visibility and detection across hybrid cloud environments.

Illumio was named a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Microsegmentation Solutions, Q3 2026, earning the highest scores in current offering and strategy of any vendor evaluated, and is recognized as a Customers’ Choice in Gartner Peer Insights for Network Security – Microsegmentation. Global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, energy and utilities, government, manufacturing, retail, and telecommunications trust Illumio to reduce cyber risk and build resilience.

**Our Values**
==============

Our values reflect how we work together in practice — not just what we aspire to. They show up in everyday decisions, how we collaborate across teams, and how we treat each other while building and delivering our work. If these values resonate with you, you’ll likely feel at home here.

* **Bring Your Best:** We hold ourselves to a standard of excellence for our customers and each other, regardless of circumstance.
* **Build Trust:** We act with integrity, transparency, and follow-through, earning trust in every interaction.
* **Seek Truth:** We pursue facts over assumptions, stay curious, and remain open to being wrong.
* **Onwards Together:** We move forward as one team, supporting each other through challenges and wins alike.
* **Leverage Differences:** We treat diverse perspectives and backgrounds as a source of strength and better decisions.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Field CISO, Zero Trust Segmentation is a newly created, specialized role within the Global Solutions Engineering team, chartered to deepen Illumio’s credibility and category leadership within the CISO community. This role is intentionally sourced from the CISO community: we are looking for a security executive — a current or former CISO, Deputy CISO, or senior security leader — who brings a proven balance of business acumen, technical depth, and operational experience running a security program, rather than a traditional pre-sales background. This is a hybrid role by design: half executive advisor and evangelist, half hands-on architect.

As Field CISO, this person is Illumio’s most credible external voice on Zero Trust Segmentation and breach containment — engaging CISOs and CTOs at strategic accounts as a peer, shaping the category narrative with industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, and other leading firms), and representing the company at industry events. This person also personally owns the technical backbone of pre-sales for the category: the Use Case Map, demo environments, POC/POV frameworks, and reference architectures that the rest of the global SE team (AMS, EMEA, APAC) builds on.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategic Field Leadership & Evangelism**

* Serve as Illumio’s foremost executive voice on Zero Trust Segmentation and breach containment, in the field and in public — conferences, webinars, analyst briefings, and published content.
* Build and maintain analyst relationships (Gartner, Forrester, and other leading firms) to shape how the category is defined and evaluated in the market.
* Engage CISO- and CTO-level stakeholders directly on the most strategic opportunities, drawing on firsthand operating experience to act as a peer and trusted advisor alongside regional SE leads and AEs.
* Partner with Sales and GTM leadership to shape go-to-market and revenue acceleration strategy.
* Partner with Product Marketing and Product Management to shape positioning, messaging, and roadmap priorities, informed directly by field and firsthand operator signal.

**Technical Architecture & Enablement Ownership**

* Own and continuously evolve the Use Case Map, Demo Runbook, and reference architectures used across the global SE organization.
* Personally design and build flagship demo environments and POC/POV frameworks, including integration patterns and success-criteria templates.
* Partner directly with product engineering to translate roadmap into sellable, demoable capability, and drive pre-sales enablement to sell-ready status and beyond.
* Maintain deep, current hands-on fluency with the Illumio platform — including segmentation, hybrid cloud detection and response, and broader Zero Trust architecture concepts.

**Enterprise Pre-Sales & POC Execution**

* Lead or co-lead the most strategic and complex opportunities globally, engaging directly alongside AMS, EMEA, and APAC SE teams.
* Architect and execute high-stakes POCs/POVs, including technical prerequisites, integration scoping, success-criteria definition, and executive readout.

Title: Senior DevOps & SRE Engineer (SDE 3)
Description:
**Senior DevOps & SRE Engineer (SDE 3)**

**Platform & Reliability Engineering**

Location:
**Dubai, UAE**
|Function:
**Engineering**

**Full-Time**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are building one of the region's most ambitious e-commerce platforms: high-traffic, multi-region, and engineered for scale. Our platform — around fifteen backend services, a web storefront and native mobile apps — handles thousands of orders every day, and every one of them depends on infrastructure that is fast, observable, and always on.

*This is a founding role for our DevOps & SRE function. You will move our platform off a managed commerce PaaS onto infrastructure we own, set the reliability bar for every engineering squad, and build the team that keeps it there.*

**ABOUT THE FUNCTION**

DevOps & SRE sits at the centre of Lulu's e-commerce engineering. We own the platform every squad ships on: cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data stores, networking, security and observability. We run on-call and incident response, define SLOs with product squads, and make sure peak sales events are boring. Over the next 12–18 months our biggest goal is migrating our workloads from a vendor-managed platform onto our own cloud footprint. We are deliberately keeping the team lean and AI-first: we expect AI agents and assistants to take on a large share of the toil — writing infrastructure-as-code and pipelines, triaging alerts, drafting runbooks and postmortems — so a small team can run a large platform.

**Core ownership:**
Cloud infrastructure & Kubernetes, CI/CD & release engineering, observability stack, data-store operations, on-call & incident management, platform migration

**WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON**

* Lead the migration of our e-commerce platform from a vendor-managed PaaS onto our own cloud infrastructure: discovery, target architecture, migration waves, cutover and decommissioning
* Design and run production Kubernetes for ~15 Python/Django services (DRF, Celery workers and beat), a Next.js storefront and supporting APIs, with Helm and GitOps-based delivery
* Operate and scale the stateful core of the platform: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka and Elasticsearch — HA, backups, point-in-time recovery, upgrades and capacity planning
* Build an open-source observability stack across metrics, logs, traces and profiles (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) that every squad uses day to day
* Define SLIs, SLOs and error budgets with product squads for checkout, order management, delivery promise and storefront APIs, and alert on what customers actually feel
* Modernise CI/CD on Bitbucket Pipelines: build and release standards, progressive delivery (canary, blue-green), automated rollbacks and idempotent release scripts
* Codify everything as infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/OpenTofu), including networking, IAM, secrets management and environment provisioning
* Prepare the platform for peak events — load testing, autoscaling, capacity reviews and game days — so sale days run without incident
* Run incident response and blameless postmortems, and drive the reliability fixes that come out of them
* Own cloud cost visibility and optimisation (FinOps), making sure we spend where it buys reliability or speed

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Scope & Impact**

* Own multi-quarter, multi-team infrastructure and reliability goals, with the migration programme as the headline deliverable
* Make independent technical decisions on open-ended problems — build vs buy, managed vs self-hosted, which tool and when — grounded in business context and cost
* Drive cross-team initiatives across backend, frontend, mobile and data squads, optimising for the platform as a whole rather than any one team

**Technical Craft**

* Design infrastructure that meets its reliability, security and cost objectives and stays simple enough for a small team to run
* Debug non-deterministic production issues across the stack — kernel, network, container runtime, database, application — that escape less experienced engineers
* Automate toil relentlessly; treat runbooks, dashboards and alerts as code that is reviewed, versioned and tested
* Identify and retire technical risk early: single points of failure, untested backups, unpatched dependencies, end-of-life runtimes
* Champion an AI-first engineering culture — use AI tools and assistants to speed up infrastructure work, incident analysis and documentation

**Leadership & Strategy**

* Build the DevOps & SRE function: define its charter, roadmap and operating model, and how it works with product squads (platform-as-a-product, paved roads, self-service)
* Hire, coach and grow DevOps and SRE engineers; set the hiring bar and run interview loops for the function
* Keep the team lean by design — build automation and AI-assisted workflows that let a small team operate the whole platform, and measure the efficiency gains they deliver
* Design a sustainable on-call rotation with clear escalation paths, severity levels, incident command roles and stakeholder communication
* Establish reliability practices across engineering: SLO reviews, production-readiness reviews, postmortem culture, change management and DR drills
* Measure and report engineering health with DORA metrics, SLO attainment and cost dashboards; present them to engineering and business leadership
* Manage vendor relationships and infrastructure budget, and make the case for investment with data
* Act as a Culture Leader — partner with engineering leadership to set the tone, foster psychological safety and champion inclusive practices

**MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

These are non-negotiable. We need engineers who can hit the ground running with our stack and ways of working.

* 7+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering, including 2+ years leading or acting as technical lead for an infrastructure or reliability team
* Expert-level Kubernetes in production — cluster design, networking, ingress, autoscaling (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler), upgrades and troubleshooting
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable): VPC design, IAM, load balancing, managed databases and cost optimisation
* Strong infrastructure-as-code with Terraform or OpenTofu, plus Helm and a GitOps tool (Argo CD or Flux)
* Set up end-to-end observability and monitoring from scratch using open-source tools — metrics (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager), logs (Loki or ELK/OpenSearch), distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry with Tempo or Jaeger) and error tracking (self-hosted Sentry) — covering infrastructure, Kubernetes, databases, queues and application code, with dashboards, alert routing and on-call integration that teams rely on
* Practical SRE experience: defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, symptom-based alerting, incident command and blameless postmortems
* CI/CD expertise (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins) with deployment strategies such as canary and blue-green
* Strong Linux, networking (DNS, TLS, CDN, load balancers) and scripting skills in Python, Go or Bash — able to read and debug Python/Django application code
* Experience running Python web services and async workers (Celery or similar) in production, ideally in e-commerce, retail or other high-traffic consumer platforms

**NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

These will set you apart and accelerate your impact, but aren't required on day one.

* Hands-on leadership of at least one production migration between cloud providers (e.g. AWS to GCP, Azure to AWS) or from a managed PaaS to self-managed infrastructure — planning, data migration, cutover and rollback
* Proven experience migrating stateful systems with minimal downtime: PostgreSQL (logical replication, CDC), Kafka (MirrorMaker 2), Elasticsearch (snapshot/restore, reindexing) and Redis
* Experience operating Kafka on Kubernetes (Strimzi), PostgreSQL operators (CloudNativePG, Zalando, Patroni) and the Elastic operator (ECK)
* Long-term metrics storage and scale-out observability: Thanos, Mimir or VictoriaMetrics; continuous profiling with Pyroscope; self-hosted Sentry
* Platform security and supply chain: HashiCorp Vault or External Secrets, Trivy, Kyverno or OPA Gatekeeper, Falco, image signing and SBOMs
* Chaos engineering and load testing with LitmusChaos or Chaos Mesh, and k6 or Locust
* Cost tooling and FinOps practice: OpenCost or Kubecost, rightsizing, committed-use and spot strategies
* Building an internal developer platform or portal (e.g. Backstage) for service templates and self-service environments
* Familiarity with GCP data services (BigQuery, Pub/Sub) and supporting data-platform workloads
* Certifications such as CKA/CKS, Google Professional Cloud Architect or DevOps Engineer, or AWS DevOps Professional
* Public contributions: conference talks, technical blog posts or open-source maintainership

**TECH STACK**

**Application stack**

Python 3.9–3.12 (Django, DRF), Celery, Next.js / React, React Native

**Data stores**

PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch

**Messaging**

Kafka

**Cloud**

GCP (GKE, BigQuery, Pub/Sub) — target for platform migration; AWS / Azure exposure valued

**Containers**

Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD

**IaC**

Terraform / OpenTofu, Ansible

**CI/CD**

Bitbucket Pipelines

**Observability**

Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry, Sentry

**Security**

Vault / External Secrets, Trivy, Kyverno, WAF

**Reliability**

SLOs & error budgets, k6, Chaos Mesh, OpenCost

**OUR VALUES**

At Lulu, our values aren't wall decorations — they guide how we work, hire, and grow.

**Be Customer Obsessed —**
Every decision in service of the customer's success.

**Speak & Act Courageously —**
Challenge the status quo, take calculated risks, and advocate for new ideas.

**Take Extreme Ownership —**
Nothing is someone else's problem. Uphold excellence and accountability.

**Learn Voraciously —**
Growth mindset, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

**Move with Focus & Urgency —**
Identify the highest-impact work and move fast.

**Win as One Team —**
Celebrate wins, lend a hand, and invest in each other's growth.

*We believe great engineering is about judgment, ownership, and craft — not just code.*

*If that resonates, we would love to hear from you.*
