Description:
**Job Summary**  
The Tow Truck Driver and Operator is responsible for the safe recovery, transport, and towing of vehicles that are stalled, illegally parked, or involved in accidents. This role involves operating specialized hydraulic equipment, performing minor roadside repairs, and providing professional customer service to distressed motorists.

Beyond just driving, the operator acts as a fieltechnician who must assess scene safety, secure vehicles according to strict weight and balance standards, and maintain accurate digital logs of all services rendered.

Key Responsibilities

* Vehicle Recovery & Transport: Safely winch, hook, and secure vehicles onto flatbeds or wheel-lifts without causing additional damage.
* Emergency Roadside Assistance: Perform basic on-site services including jump-starts, tire changes, fuel delivery, and lockout assistance.
* Safety & Compliance: Adhere to all DOT (Department of Transportation) regulations and traffic laws, especially while navigating heavy machinery through high-traffic areas.
* Vehicle Inspection: Conduct daily pre-trip inspections of the tow truck’s fluids, lights, brakes, and hydraulic systems to ensure operational readiness.
* Documentation: Maintain detailed records of service calls, mileage, and customer payments using mobile dispatching software.
* Customer Relations: Communicate clearly with customers, law enforcement, and dispatchers to manage expectations and provide updates on arrival times

**Duties**

* Safely operate assigned vehicles and equipment in compliance with all traffic laws and safety regulations
* Conduct thorough pre- and post-trip inspections to ensure vehicle safety and readiness
* Assist in security functions by monitoring premises, controlling access points, and conducting patrols as needed
* Manage conflict situations professionally, de-escalating disputes and ensuring safety for all parties involved
* Provide exceptional customer service by assisting visitors, staff, or clients with directions or information
* Prepare detailed reports on incidents, vehicle logs, or operational activities using clear and accurate report writing skills
* Collaborate with security personnel and law enforcement when necessary to address security concerns or incidents

**Experience**

* Proven experience operating commercial or specialized vehicles, with a valid driver’s license appropriate for the vehicle type
* Background in law enforcement or security is highly desirable, demonstrating familiarity with security protocols and conflict management techniques
* Strong communication skills with the ability to handle stressful situations calmly and effectively
* Experience in report writing, documenting incidents accurately and comprehensively
* Knowledge of safety regulations, traffic laws, and vehicle maintenance procedures
* Ability to remain alert during long shifts, maintaining focus on safety and security at all times

Join us to be part of a dedicated team committed to safety, security, and exceptional service. Your skills will help create a secure environment while supporting operational excellence every day!

Pay: $85.00 - $1,700.00 per week

Title: School Nurse - Full Time
Description:
**Job Title:** School Nurse  
**Location:** Mill Springs Academy, Alpharetta, GA

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About Mill Springs Academy:**

For more than 40 years, Mill Springs Academy has been dedicated to empowering neurodivergent students to discover their strengths and thrive. Our unique approach to education combines academic learning with practical skill development through project-based learning. Our hands-on curriculum engages students in real-world challenges, fostering critical thinking, executive functioning skills, and social-emotional intelligence. At Mill Springs, our mission is clear—prepare students to be Real World Ready, equipped with the confidence, life skills, and resilience to succeed in whatever path they choose.

**Position Overview:**

The School Nurse plays a vital role in promoting the health and well-being of students and employees by providing skilled medical care and first aid with professionalism, expertise, and compassion. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong collaboration skills and the ability to effectively manage a dynamic Health Services Office while maintaining a composed, organized, and positive demeanor.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as campus first responder to medical emergencies and provide Emergency Responders with needed information. Provide care for students and staff in need, due to injury or illness
* Develop individual healthcare plans (IHP) for students with chronic health issues.
* Within the nurse’s scope of practice and state laws, train and delegate unlicensed school personnel in medication administration and/or the delivery of health services as ordered by a licensed healthcare provider.
* Assist faculty and staff in monitoring students with chronic health conditions.
* Coordinate care and student emergency care plans related to diabetes, asthma, seizures, and allergies, and training in the use of emergency medications.
* Administer daily, PRN, and emergency medications as needed.
* Maintain student medications as required by law and school policy.
* Obtain and maintain Authorization for Prescription Medication Forms. Report Communicable Diseases to the Georgia Department of Health as required by state law.

* Serve as a member of the school emergency crisis management team and any other positions as requested by the Head of School.
* Stay abreast of changes in state law concerning areas of responsibility.

* Review and update standing orders for OTC medications yearly Maintain a file of GA Form 3231, GA Form 2208, and any older Religious Waivers (prior to the 2015-2016 school year) in preparation for the yearly audit.
* Communicate daily air quality, pollen count, and extreme temperature alerts, when students may be at risk. Stay abreast of changes in state law concerning areas of responsibility.
* Review and update standing orders for OTC medications yearly.

**Professional and Personal Attributes, Skills, Knowledge and Experience:**

* Registered Nurse with a current license to practice nursing in Georgia
* Certified in AED/CPR
* Considerable knowledge of medical disorders and treatment
* Experience in school, pediatric, public, or community health nursing
* Knowledge of current trends in nursing and literature in the fields of school health
* Knowledge of medicine, medical supplies, and equipment
* Demonstrates appropriate, effective, and professional written and oral communication skills
* Demonstrates computer literacy and proficiency
* Engenders trust based on sound judgment and service orientation.
* Communicates clearly and effectively.

**What we offer:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* A supportive community that values collaboration and innovation.
* Access to exceptional facilities, including fine arts, athletics, and technology resources.

Description:

-------------------------------------------------------------

**Reporting structure**
-----------------------

**Reports to:** Head of Chartering

**Direct Reportees:** None

**Job Summary and Purpose**
---------------------------

Monitor and timely process claims related to Nakilat’s commercially managed fleet, collaborate and align with all related stakeholders internally to get the best possible outcomes via the charterparty terms and/or support in negotiations with the relevant counterparties.

**Key Accountabilities 1**
--------------------------

* Build a well-established knowledge of charter parties and their commercial implications in any regard that may result in exposure to claims.
* Monitor the performance of the vessels against the charter parties and highlight any areas that may result in any demurrage, performance warranty and off-hire claims, as necessary.
* Monitor the performance of the vessels in line with charter party warranties and generate a monthly summary report highlighting any areas of over/underperformance (actual and potential). Further, follow up immediately with the vessels’ technical manager to address any underperformance observations or concerns.
* Recommend actions to resolve performance issues and continuously work towards the performance and efficiency of the fleet of ships.
* Monitor, track, and execute relevant cost reimbursement claims to charterers while liaising with the relevant internal stakeholders, i.e. Insurance, Finance, Fleet, etc.
* Provide relevant documents and information to successfully address any audit (internal and/or external) requirements.
* Support chartering & post fixture activities by ensuring compliance with charter party terms.
* Ensure compliance with proper procedures regarding management and approval of claims with reference to the respective and relevant internal lines of approval.
* Monitor and track the Charterers’ accounts, in collaboration with Finance, from a financial perspective to highlight any areas of concern where transactions would need attention. i.e. Hire, claims, cost reimbursement, etc.
* Facilitate regular meetings with Charterers for business discussions on the topic of claims, as required.

**Key Accountabilities 2**
--------------------------

**Legal and Insurance:**

* Review terms of Charter Party with Legal and Insurance functions and ensure that company’s interests are protected by ensuring necessary insurance coverage is in place, proper defense is arranged through vessels’ P&I Club and finally seek reimbursement of relevant expenses from charterers as per charter party clauses.
* Negotiate TCP claims, seek legal advice and provide recommendations to Head of Chartering.

**Planning:**

* Use all possible means for voyage planning including the use of software tools to monitor and coordinate all activities related to voyage. Also, analyze variance between the voyage plans versus the actual plan, while generating report for the Head of Chartering.
* Support the team in coordinating the periodical meetings with vessels’ technical manager to address any technical/operational issues which could have a commercial impact as well as address any customers’ concerns.
* Support the team in coordinating timely between Charterers and vessels’ technical manager to conduct any Owners’ related matters (e.g., SIRE, Crew change, spares delivery, lube oil supply) with minimum deviation and minimum (target zero) off hire & claim avoidance.

**Generic Accountabilities**
----------------------------

**Quality, Health, Safety, & Environment (QHSE):**

* Adhere to all relevant SHEQ policies, procedures, instructions, and controls so that NAKILAT provides a safe, world class, secure and environmentally responsible service to customers, the public and its own people.
* Track EUETS reports, procure EUAs and seek re-imbursement from charterers.
* Track Fuel EU compliance balance and other environmental regulations related to commercial settlement with charterers.

**Policies, Systems, Processes & Procedures:**

* Implement approved policies, processes, and procedures, and provide instructions to subordinates to ensure their proper implementation.
* Recommend updates for the division’s relevant P&Ps for claims, as deemed appropriate to cope with evolving business needs.

**Qualifications, Experience and Job Skills**
---------------------------------------------

**Qualifications:**

* Degree in Business/Economics/Technical of Marine Engineering or any other relevant field.
* Diploma in ship management and operations (ICS preferred).
* Diploma in ship chartering (ICS preferred).

**Experience:**

* A minimum of 4 years of relevant experience as a charterer, shipping and commercial operator in a ship-owning company, chartering desk, trading desk, International Oil & Gas Company, or brokerage house.

**Job Specific Skills:**

* Experience in contracts and claims negotiation will be an added advantage.
* Good knowledge of Shipping Commercial management – Chartering and Post-fixture Operations.
* Good record of leading and managing claims negotiations and minimizing commercial exposure.

Title: Senior Contract Administrator
Description:
Senior Contract Administrator (SCA)

Position Type:  
Independent Contractor (Incorporated)

Contract Duration:  
One (1) year

Location:  
5160 Yonge Street, North York, Ontario, Canada. Hybrid work arrangement, with a minimum of two (2) days per week in the TTC office or on-site and the remaining days remotely, subject to hiring manager approval. Remote work must be performed within Ontario. Candidates may also be required to attend meetings at various TTC locations across the Greater Toronto Area.

Work Schedule:  
Up to 35 hours per week, seven (7) hours per day, during TTC business hours. Work may begin no earlier than 7:00 a.m. Candidates must be able to travel to the TTC office and attend on-site meetings as required.

Remuneration:  
Competitive hourly rate

Role Overview

We are seeking experienced Senior Contract Administrators to support the Toronto Transit Commission’s (TTC) Commercial Management Department. The successful candidates will provide professional contract administration and commercial management services, with a focus on post-award activities involving construction contracts and design, engineering, and professional service contracts.

The role involves reviewing and interpreting contractual requirements, managing contract changes and claims, negotiating commercial matters, monitoring contract performance, administering payment processes, and maintaining accurate contract records. The successful candidates will work closely with project delivery teams, contractors, consultants, legal representatives, and other internal stakeholders to ensure contractual obligations are met, commercial risks are managed, and TTC’s interests are protected.

Key Responsibilities

1. Contract Administration and Management

* Coordinate and administer post-award contract activities for construction, design, engineering, and professional service contracts.
* Review, interpret, and analyse contract documents, specifications, terms, and conditions to ensure consistent application of contractual requirements.
* Provide contract administration support to project delivery teams and respond to assigned requests and tasks.
* Ensure that contractual strategies and individual clauses are appropriately applied to reduce risk and protect the TTC’s interests.
* Administer contracts throughout their lifecycle, from post-award activities through to final close-out.

2. Contract Review and Compliance

* Review contractor and consultant submissions, including work plans, task and work assignments, contract changes, amendments, invoices, contractual notices, claim notices, statements, and other correspondence.
* Assess submissions for compliance with contract terms, conditions, and approved scopes of work.
* Identify contractual inconsistencies, irregularities, performance concerns, and other issues requiring resolution.
* Provide recommendations and advice to project teams and management on contractual matters.

3. Commercial Negotiations and Contract Changes

* Lead and support commercial negotiations involving contract rates, work plans, assignments, amendments, changes, claims, unit-price settlements, and other contractual matters.
* Evaluate and negotiate commercial aspects of work plan submissions and process work plan or assignment releases.
* Administer the full lifecycle of contract changes, amendments, claims, and change directives.
* Evaluate contractual entitlement, scope, pricing, schedules, labour, material, and equipment costs.
* Prepare independent cost estimates and analyses to support the assessment and negotiation of proposed changes and claims.
* Chair negotiations with contractors to establish acceptable settlements on pricing and contractual terms.
* Negotiate final settlement of quantities for unit-price contracts and recommend commercially sound agreements that provide fair market value and protect TTC’s interests.

4. Claims Management and Risk Mitigation

* Review and assess contractor claims, notices, and supporting documentation.
* Develop and implement claims avoidance and mitigation strategies.
* Identify and evaluate commercial, contractual, financial, and project delivery risks.
* Support the resolution of complex contractual matters, including contractor performance issues and disputes.
* Engage internal legal representatives when necessary to support negotiations, resolution of contractual matters, and enforcement of contractual obligations.
* Support the application of contractual penalty clauses and liquidated damages where applicable.
* Escalate complex or high-profile contractual issues to the Commercial Manager and/or Director.

5. Payment Administration and Financial Management

* Oversee and administer payment processes in accordance with approved contract price breakdowns and contractual requirements.
* Review and verify vendor invoices against applicable contract payment terms.
* Assess payment-related matters, including statutory holdbacks under the Construction Lien Act, final payments, set-off charges, off-site inventory payments, and liquidated damages.
* Prepare cost estimates for materials, labour, and equipment.
* Analyse production and construction schedules when evaluating contractor change requests, claims, and proposed amendments.
* Monitor contract expenditures, allowances, contingencies, forecasts, and other financial commitments.

6. Contract Performance Monitoring and Reporting

* Monitor assigned contracts, contractor performance, progress, expenditures, and commercial risks.
* Prepare and provide contract status reports, analyses, and recommendations to management and project delivery teams.
* Prepare Performance Review Reports and participate in meetings concerning unsatisfactory performance assessments.
* Monitor contract performance indicators and ensure assigned performance KPIs and targets are achieved.
* Provide information and recommendations to support effective financial, contractual, and project-related decision-making.

7. Contract Documentation and Records Management

* Maintain accurate and complete contract administration records throughout the contract lifecycle.
* Manage documentation relating to work plan releases, contract amendments, changes, change directives, payment certificates, notices, correspondence, and close-out activities.
* Maintain records within the Contract Management System and other relevant corporate systems.
* Process Requests for Quotes, contract amendments, changes, and change directives.
* Review and provide input into the development of Purchase Authorization Amendment Board Reports.
* Prepare and process contract close-out documentation.

8. Stakeholder Coordination and Process Improvement

* Attend project progress meetings, engineering review meetings, and other meetings as required.
* Collaborate with project delivery teams, contractors, consultants, legal representatives, and internal stakeholders to resolve contractual and commercial matters.
* Contribute expertise and recommendations to the design, planning, and development of contract management systems, standards, and operational procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve contract administration processes, procedures, and controls.
* Apply quality assurance and quality control principles to support effective contract management practices.

Required Qualifications and Experience

* Completion of a university degree or college diploma, preferably in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Quantity Surveying, or a related discipline.
* Strong knowledge and experience in contract administration practices within complex construction and infrastructure environments.
* Demonstrated experience managing projects and contracts in a multifunctional environment.
* Ability to read and interpret technical specifications and drawings, with a good understanding of technical issues relating to engineering design and construction.
* Strong understanding of legal and commercial issues and practices related to tendering and contract law.
* Strong knowledge of contracting principles, processes, methods, and practices, as well as accounting and scheduling principles.
* Strong knowledge of claims management techniques and practices in large-scale, multifaceted environments.
* Knowledge of quality assurance and quality control principles, practices, and methods for implementing contract management controls.
* Demonstrated ability to assess situations, determine importance, urgency, and risk, and make timely decisions.
* Strong negotiation skills, including the ability to develop strategies and chair complex commercial negotiations.
* Demonstrated project management abilities and the capacity to achieve results.
* Excellent planning and time management skills, with the ability to multitask and work effectively in a fast-paced, changing environment.
* Must have or rapidly acquire comprehensive knowledge of the Ontario Human Rights Code and related orders, including disability accommodation and accessibility requirements pertaining to passengers and employees.

Technical Knowledge and Skills

* Contract administration and commercial management best practices.
* Construction contract management and infrastructure project environments.
* Contract changes, amendments, claims, change directives, and contract close-out processes.
* Contractual entitlement assessment, cost analysis, pricing, and settlement negotiations.

Core Competencies

* Attention to Detail: Ability to review complex contractual documents and maintain accurate records with minimal supervision.

* Planning and Organization: Strong research, organizational, and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Adaptability: Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, changing, and multifunctional environment.

Preferred Qualifications and Assets

Title: Land Surveyor
Description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

**1. Job Purpose**
------------------

To carry out all surveying, setting-out verification, and dimensional control activities ensuring that the Contractor's setting-out, levels, alignments, and as-built records comply with the approved IFC drawings, project specifications, and the requirements of the Client and relevant Dubai authorities (DM, RTA, DEWA). The Land Surveyor provides the Resident Engineer with independent verification of all survey-related works and ensures full traceability to the Dubai Local Transverse Mercator (DLTM) coordinate system and DMD (Dubai Municipality Datum) vertical datum.

**2. Key Responsibilities**
---------------------------

**2.1 Survey Control & Datum**

* Establish, verify, and maintain primary and secondary survey control networks on site, tied to DLTM and DMD via Dubai Municipality benchmarks.
* Carry out periodic verification of control stations to confirm stability and accuracy.
* Maintain the Project Control Register, including coordinates, elevations, descriptions, and check records.
* Verify the Contractor's survey control submissions and recommend approval to the Resident Engineer.

**2.2 Setting-Out Verification**

* Independently check the Contractor's setting-out of roads, bridges, tunnels, structures, drainage, and utility corridors against approved IFC drawings.
* Verify horizontal alignment, vertical alignment, cross-sections, super-elevation, gradients, and chainages.
* Sign off setting-out check sheets prior to commencement of works and maintain the setting-Out Register.
* Issue Survey Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) where setting out does not comply with approved drawings or tolerances.

**2.3 Roadworks Surveying**

* Verify levels and lines for subgrade, subbase, aggregate base course (ABC), and asphalt layers (binder and wearing course).
* Check kerbs, gullies, channels, manhole covers, road markings, and signage positions.
* Confirm camber, crossfall, super-elevation transitions, and gradient compliance with approved geometric design.
* Carry out asphalt level checks before and after paving to verify thickness compliance.

**2.4 Bridges & Structures**

* Verify setting-out and levels for piles, pile caps, piers, abutments, bearings, girders, deck slabs, parapets, and expansion joints.
* Check geometric control of formwork, falsework, and reinforcement positioning.
* Carry out monitoring surveys for movement, settlement, and deflection of structures during and after construction.
* Verify final geometry of bridge decks, including camber, alignment, and joint positions.

**2.5 Tunnels**

* Verify tunnel alignment control, including horizontal and vertical setting-out of the tunnel axis.
* Check setting-out for segmental linings, cross-passages, shafts, portals, and tunnel finishes.
* Carry out convergence and settlement monitoring of tunnel sections and surrounding structures.
* Coordinate with the Contractor's tunnel survey team on TBM guidance and as-built tunnel geometry.

**2.6 Infrastructure Utilities**

* Verify setting-out of water, sewerage, irrigation, district cooling, telecom, and electrical networks.
* Check trench alignment, invert levels, gradients, and connection points to existing utilities.
* Confirm chamber, manhole, and valve positions and levels.
* Coordinate with DEWA, DM Sewerage, Etisalat/du, and Empower surveyors during joint surveys and tie-ins.

**2.7 Topographic & Pre-Construction Surveys**

* Witness and verify topographic surveys, pre-construction condition surveys, and existing utility surveys carried out by the Contractor.
* Check existing levels, ground conditions, and surface features against design assumptions.
* Identify and report any discrepancies between design and existing site conditions to the Resident Engineer.

**2.8 Quantity Verification Support**

* Carry out joint surveys with the Contractor and Quantity Surveyor for measurement of earthworks (cut/fill), excavation, backfill, and pavement layers.
* Prepare cross-sections, longitudinal sections, and volume calculations using survey software (Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Trimble Business Center).
* Support the Quantity Surveyor with survey-based quantity verification for interim payment applications.

**2.9 As-Built Surveys & Records**

* Verify the Contractor's as-built surveys for all completed works and ensure compliance with project specifications and DM/RTA submission requirements.
* Check accuracy, completeness, and format of as-built drawings prior to recommendation for approval.
* Maintain a comprehensive As-Built Survey Register and ensure traceability to hand over documentation.

**2.10 Instruments & Calibration**

* Maintain Consultant's survey instruments (Total Stations, GNSS/RTK GPS, automatic and digital levels, prisms, and accessories) in good working order.
* Verify that all Contractor's survey instruments are calibrated by accredited laboratories with valid certificates.
* Maintain a Calibration Register for all survey equipment used on the project.

**2.11 Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain comprehensive survey records: control sheets, setting out check sheets, level books, monitoring records, NCRs, and as-built data.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly survey activity reports for the Resident Engineer.
* Support authority audits and submissions to DM, RTA, and DEWA with verified survey data.

**2.12 Coordination & Reporting**

* Report directly to the Resident Engineer on all survey-related matters.
* Coordinate with Site Engineers, Materials Engineer, Quantity Surveyor, and the Contractor's Survey Manager and team.
* Attend technical meetings, progress reviews, and joint surveys with authorities.

**3. Qualifications & Experience**
----------------------------------

* **Education:** B.Sc. in Surveying / Geomatics / Civil Engineering, or a recognized Diploma in Land Surveying with relevant professional experience.
* **Experience:** Minimum 10 years' experience in land surveying on construction projects, with at least 7 years on major infrastructure projects (roads, bridges, tunnels, utilities) and a minimum of 3 years in the UAE/GCC.
* **Certifications:** Dubai Municipality / RTA approval as Land Surveyor is highly preferred.
* **Knowledge:** Dubai Local Transverse Mercator (DLTM) projection, DMD vertical datum, DM and RTA survey specifications, geometric design standards, and infrastructure construction tolerances.
* **Skills:** Expert use of Total Stations, GNSS/RTK GPS, digital levels, and 3D laser scanners. Strong proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D. Good technical report writing, attention to detail, and effective communication.

**4. Reporting Line**
---------------------

The Land Surveyor reports directly to the Resident Engineer and works in close coordination with the Assistant Resident Engineer, Site Engineers, Materials Engineer, Quantity Surveyor, and the Contractor's Survey Manager and survey team.

Title: HS&E Specialist
Description:
Description:

Sese Industrial is a greenfield operation that has an immediate opening for an HS&E Specialist.

This will include assessment and implementation of absent programs and the continued oversight and administration of existing programs. This position will interface with all departments to ensure existing processes and special projects follow all Federal, State, and Local regulations. The HS&E specialist implements and maintains an environmental health and safety program involving hazard identification evaluation and control, accident/injury prevention, hazardous material/waste management, emergency preparedness, fire/life safety, ergonomics, industrial hygiene, workers compensation claims, incident monitoring and tracking, and environmental regulatory compliance.

**ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provides HSE leadership, training, and operational support to all levels of the organization and across all functional groups.
* Ensures all HSE processes and procedures are implemented and standardized across the manufacturing facility.
* Tracks company health and safety metrics and use the data to identify and to reduce risk.
* Facilitate the safety team meetings.
* Administer Near Miss Program and assign action items, as necessary.
* Works closely with Engineering and Facilities on special projects involving plant construction, equipment design, and hazardous assessments.
* Provide information to management about recommendations for process improvements and decision proposals.
* Assists in all aspects of incident investigation including verifying root cause and approving the implementation of preventative actions.
* Ensures emergency response systems, policies and procedures are in place to manage emergency situations.
* Maintains all Federal, State, and Local permits in current and valid condition.
* Provides hazardous material/right to know training and MSD management.
* Performs industrial hygiene activities including chemical monitoring, ozone monitoring, and any other monitoring programs, as necessary.
* Prepares regulatory agency submissions.

* High motivation to confront challenges and changes.
* Oral and written ability to give instructions to groups.

Title: Senior Technology Infrastructure Engineer
Description:
**Shasta Union High School District**

**Senior Technology Infrastructure Engineer**

**Definition:**

Under the general direction of the Technology Infrastructure Manager, the Senior Technology Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the architecture, configuration, maintenance, daily operations, and strategic lifecycle management of the District’s enterprise technology ecosystem. This position serves as a senior technical role overseeing physical and virtual datacenters, enterprise networking, storage networks and disaster recovery, identity systems, hybrid cloud infrastructure, database platforms, communications systems, physical security systems, cybersecurity, and the Google for Education platform. This role also serves as Tier-3 support for incidents, problems, and service requests, and may lead on certain projects. The scope for this role includes the SUHSD sites, and the contract supported LEA sites.

**Essential Job Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Maintain and manage enterprise datacenter equipment and systems such as: server racks, PDUs, UPS’s and generators, environmental sensors, and CRAC systems to ensure power, thermal stability, and physical facility uptime.

* Configure, maintain, and monitor enterprise core / edge routers, switches, dynamic routing protocols, structured fiber / copper cabling, and network performance baselines to ensure continuous WAN / LAN connectivity.

* Design, patch, and manage hypervisor host clusters and enterprise storage arrays to optimize virtual machine allocation, storage performance, and high availability.

* Deploy, update, and administer Windows Server DataCenter services, DHCP, Active Directory, DNS, IIS, Print management, SQL Server, and Hyper-V / Azure Local hybrid HCI to ensure high availability.

* Establish and validate enterprise backup policies, immutable cloud storage, and disaster recovery replication routines to uphold strict RPO/RTO objectives and execute annual business continuity failover tests.

* Implement, patch, and monitor network and endpoint security controls (MDR), firewalls, NAC, MFA, SIEM, and email consoles in alignment with CIS benchmarks to safeguard systems and respond to cybersecurity incidents.

* Manage and update the enterprise video management and access control systems and devices, including IP cameras, NVR archives, card / biometric readers, door controllers, and access permissions.

* Configure, update, and troubleshoot enterprise IP-PBX systems, SIP trunks, call queues, E911 locator services, devices, and voice quality metrics (QoS) across telecom pathways.

* Design and maintain Active Directory, Entra ID, SSO, GPOs, PAM, and IAM controls, along with ERP, SIS, and educational app integrations to manage user identities across their complete lifecycle.

* Administer Google Workspace for Education tenant settings, Chrome OS policies, domain routing, GAM CLI tools, and SIS integrations to support administrative and instructional cloud operations.

* Build, secure, and monitor hybrid cloud connectors and SaaS integrations for SSO, data, and application interfaces.

* Configure and maintain the ITOM monitoring system for the entire infrastructure ecosystem and integrate with the ITSM platform to automate alerting, incident creation and escalation, and system service status.

* Develop, maintain, and execute PowerShell modules and AI-assisted automation pipelines to streamline routine system administration, user provisioning, and log analysis.

* Deploy and configure EDR / XDR, MDM, ITAM, imaging, software deployment and patch management back-end systems for managing endpoint assets and maintaining licensing compliance.

* Create and routinely update infrastructure documents such as architectural and network diagrams, IPAM tables, SOPs, and disaster recovery runbooks within central knowledge repositories to satisfy enterprise audit standards.

* Establish, evaluate, and execute formal ITIL-aligned change requests, including CAB workflows, risk assessments, rollback and communication plans, business service associations, and maintenance window / status page updates for all production maintenance.

* Serve as Tier-3 support for infrastructure and escalated standard and major incidents, problems, and service requests, and author Post-Incident Reviews and Root Cause Analysis reports.

* Architect project charters, technical scopes of work, resource schedules, and budgets to lead complex infrastructure initiatives from initiation to closure for our District and the contract supported LEA’s.

* Draft technical requirements for E-Rate RFPs, work with our E-Rate consultant to manage compliant equipment procurement and USAC audits, and oversee hardware deployment projects.

* Work off-hours occasionally for planned implementation projects and maintenance windows. Maintain a District-supplied mobile phone for operational communication and off-hours emergency contact; off-hours response to emergency notifications is requested when available.

* Adheres to and promotes the IT Services department mission, vision, and values.

* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

Knowledge of:

* Datacenter & Facility Systems: Principles of enterprise server rack deployment, power distribution (PDUs, UPS, generators), environmental monitoring sensors, and Computer Room Air Conditioning (CRAC) systems.

* Enterprise Networking & Telecommunications: Core/edge routing and switching, dynamic routing protocols, structured fiber/copper cabling, IP-PBX systems, SIP trunking, QoS prioritization, and E911 services.

* Compute, Storage & Virtualization: Windows Server DataCenter services (AD DS, DNS, DHCP, IIS, Print), SQL Server administration, hypervisor host clusters, SAN/NAS storage arrays, and Hyper-V / Azure Local hybrid HCI.

* Cybersecurity & Physical Security: Defense-in-depth tools (MDR, EDR/XDR, NAC, MFA, SIEM, firewalls), CIS Benchmarks, physical Video Management Systems (VMS/NVR), card/biometric access control, and door controllers.

* Identity Management & Cloud Ecosystems: Active Directory, Entra ID, IAM, SSO, GPOs, PAM, hybrid cloud/SaaS connectors, and Google Workspace for Education (Chrome OS policies, GAM CLI, SIS/ERP integrations).

* Data Backup & Business Continuity: Enterprise backup frameworks, immutable cloud storage repositories, disaster recovery replication, and RPO/RTO alignment.

* Systems Automation & Management: PowerShell scripting, AI-assisted automation pipelines, ITOM/ITSM system integrations, MDM, ITAM, and automated endpoint imaging/patching.

* IT Service Management (ITSM) & Compliance: ITIL service delivery frameworks (Change Advisory Board/CAB, Incident/Problem Management, RCA/PIR), central technical documentation standards, and E-Rate (USAC) procurement rules.

Ability to:

* Collaborate with other teams to share knowledge, resources, and achieve common goals.

* Analyze complex technical problems and trends and implement effective, scalable solutions.

* Communicate technical information clearly to non-technical staff and stakeholders.

* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting strict deadlines.

* Foster positive working relationships with District and contract-supported LEA sites, and external vendors.

* Work independently with minimal supervision and exercise sound professional judgment.

* Operate a vehicle and regularly travel between multiple school sites.

**Education and Experience:**

**Experience:** Eight (8) years of technical support experience is preferred, including at least three (3) years of experience in a technology infrastructure role. Experience in an educational environment is highly preferred.

**Education:** An associate’s degree or higher in information or educational technology, or a closely related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience that demonstrates the ability to perform the position's duties.

**License and Certificates**

Possession of a valid California driver’s license.

Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CompTIA Server+ / Network+ / Security+ / Cloud+ and Microsoft, Google, Cisco, PMI, ITIL) are highly desirable.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to lift 25 pounds at times.

Title: Division Chief - Pediatric Endocrinology
Description:

The Division Chief is a clinical and managerial leader working with the Sidra executive team to develop and deliver strategy and business plans and is accountable for resources and performance in Endocrinology and integrates research and education priorities into a program of excellent clinical service delivery, specialized outpatient clinical services including diagnostic and therapeutic procedures for complex and complicated procedures, consultations and case management, and other associated clinical and academic activites. The Division Chief continues with personal clinical education and research activities albeit in a reduced and modified manner, and will have a full-time appointment to Weill Cornell Medical College – Qatar and hold the position of Associate Professor or Professor of Pediatrics - Endocrinology.

* Takes decision related to budgeting and budget controlling mechanism for the Endocrinology Division
* Makes decisions impacting recruitment and management of staff in the division.
* Drives the strategic plan for the division and contributes towards the strategic plan of the department.
* Coaches, mentors and monitors staff performance.
* Supports and takes decisions related to educational, clinical & research activities of the Endocrinology Division.
* Identifies and articulates the vision, strategic direction, and growth of the Division of Endocrinology and collaborates on the implementation of strategies to achieve them.
* Leads clinical service planning, service development and capacity planning for the Outpatient/Inpatient activities of Endocrinology services.
* Promotes leadership and direction for the development of strategies to promote the recruitment, retention, and directs mission of excellence for the medical staff, and collaborates with the Division Chiefs to execute the strategies.
* Recommends clinical privileges, appointment, reappointment and corrective action for each member of the Division of Endocrinology as well as promoting mentorship and academic career development for these staff members.
* Responsible for all administrative activities of the Endocrinology Division unless otherwise provided for by the hospital, and serves on all requested committees including medical executive committee, and appointing such committees as necessary to conduct the function of the department.
* Develops and implements policies and procedures that guide support provision of services to the Endocrinology Clinic services.
* Continues surveillance of the professional performance of all individuals in the Endocrinology Division who have delineated clinical privileges, including performance, and ongoing and focused professional practice evaluations (OPPE and FPPE).
* Continues surveillance of patient care and the professional performance of all individuals in the Endocrinology Division who have defined clinical privileges.

* Accountable for the financial performance and management of all budgets within the Endocrinology Division.
* Implements the clinical service strategies and business plan for the Endocrinology Division.
* Makes recommendations for the purchase of capital and other equipment and participates in the evaluation of products for use by different members of the Endocrinology Division to ensure their safety and efficacy.
* Sets and achieves targets to drive continuous assessment and improvement of the quality of care and services provided and initiates actions for necessary improvements according to Sidra Board initiatives.
* Works with the Chair - Pediatrics to establish and update the work week standards for all physicians and staff and assures that there is appropriate clinical coverage for all patients requiring medical care from the Endocrinology Division (including emergency care).
* Ensures all members of the Endocrinology Division optimize the use of electronic medical records.
* Sets and achieves targets for programs and procedures for confidentiality of all patient information in accordance with hospital policy and the privacy laws of the State of Qatar.
* In conjunction with the Clinical Service Chief, ensures the implementation of robust clinical governance structures and processes to ensure patient safety.
* In conjunction with the Chief Research Officer and division heads of research, ensures a program of clinical and translational research is developed and promoted and delivered within the Endocrinology Division.
* In conjunction with the Dean of Weill Cornell Medical College – Qatar ensures there is an active and continuous program of undergraduate teaching within the Endocrinology Division to ensure an effective learning environment for students, residents, and medical staff.
* Involves in research, graduate teaching, and publication in higher impact refereed journals, advising fellows, and students and participates in academic services.
* Ensures effective communication with and involvement of all staff within the Endocrinology Division in regards to key decisions and initiatives.
* Works collaboratively with other service chiefs, chief officers, and executive directors to achieve broad Sidra objectives.
* Conducts other duties as may be directed by the Chief Medical Officer and/or Chief Executive Officer.
* Initiates, implements and oversees programs designed to foster positive relations between Endocrinology physicians and the hospital operations and administration.
* Assists with marketing strategies to inform physicians and their staff of Sidra’s clinical diagnostic procedures, services and resources.
* Promotes and evaluates physician community outreach programs as appropriate.
* Develops, manages and supports physician and community relationships, coordinating and disseminating information to all stakeholders to solicit ongoing support from the State of Qatar for Endocrinology.

**QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE**

**Education**

* MD degree
* Residency training in Pediatrics
* Fellowship in Pediatric Endocrinology

**Experience**

* 10+ years clinical experience
* 5+ years in Academic leadership as section chief or chief of Endocrinology

**Please Note:** This position requires extensive weekly overnight travel. Employees are typically away from home Sunday through Thursday nights and work at various locations throughout the region. Hotel accommodations are provided by the company. This is not a local route or home-daily position.
  
  
**Who we are:**  
Sweeping Corporation of America (SCA) is the nation’s leading street sweeping company, operating in over 20 states and supporting more than 600 municipalities, counties, and government agencies. With over six million miles serviced annually, SCA is uniquely focused on the delivery of high-performance street sweeping, jet-vac, and environmental services. SCA has built its entire organization, its people, processes, technology, and investments around providing uninterrupted, accountable, and results-driven services tailored to the needs of our clients. Our mission is to provide essential sweeping and environmental services that support cleaner, safer, and more sustainable communities.
  
  
**Your daily impact:**  
As our next Street Sweeper, you'll be at the heart of our mission—delivering essential services that help improve public safety and enhance environmental quality. In this role, you’ll take ownership of assigned routes, drive the street sweeper, and operate specialized equipment to keep streets clean and well-maintained.
  
  
The job responsibilities below outline the core duties and expectations of a position, providing clarity on how the role supports Company goals. However, not all duties can be listed, and as business needs evolve, responsibilities may shift over time to reflect new priorities, processes, or technologies:
  
  
**Safety & Inspection:** Perform required pre-trip and post-trip inspections of equipment in accordance with company standards. Ensure all safety features are operational before beginning route.
  
  
**Execution:** Review assigned routes thoroughly prior to departure. Be proactive in asking clarifying questions if the route or expectations are unclear. Complete assigned jobs within the allotted timeframe while maintaining expected quality and attention to detail.
  
  
**Equipment Operation:** Operate equipment safely and efficiently at all times, following all traffic laws, company safety procedures, and site-specific protocols. Exercise additional caution during inclement weather or challenging site conditions.
  
  
**Material Handling:** Handle materials safely and securely; Apply correct procedures for material types and disposal sites.
  
  
**Reporting:** Report any equipment issues, malfunctions, near misses, crashes, or injuries within 30 minutes or as soon as safely possible. Immediately escalate opportunities, work issues, or safety concerns to management.
  
  
**Professional Communication:** Maintain a professional attitude and appearance while representing the company on job sites or in public areas. Communicate effectively with team members, supervisors, and clients when needed.
  
  
**Compliance & Documentation:** Accurately complete required logs, manifests, and forms.
  
  
**Adaptability & Problem Solving:** Respond appropriately to changes and challenges; identify and solve issues timely.
  
  
**Regular & Predictable Attendance:** The ability to consistently report to work on time and as scheduled, with minimal unexcused absences. This includes being present and prepared to work throughout assigned shifts, and reliably adhering to start times, breaks, and end times.
  
  
**Minimum Job Requirements:**  
Minimum job qualifications define the essential skills, experience, and abilities needed to succeed in the role. They set the baseline for hiring but may evolve as the job and business requirements change:
  
  
**Education:** ​High School or GED​
  
  
**Experience:** 1 year DOT driving experience – waste & recycling services experience preferred
  
  
**License:** CDL-B & DOT Medical Card
  
  
**Age:** Must be at least 21 years of age
  
  
**Compliance:** Must maintain an acceptable driving record and successfully pass a motor vehicle record (MVR) check, background check, and drug screening in accordance with Company policy and applicable law.
  
  
**Skills & Competencies:**  
Skills and competencies define the abilities and behaviors essential for success in the role. They guide performance expectations and may evolve as the role, team, or business priorities change:
  
  
**Safety & Compliance Focus:** Ability to follow safety procedures, conduct inspections, operate equipment responsibly, and comply with all traffic, site, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Operational Execution & Reliability:** Strong ability to plan routes, complete work efficiently and accurately, adapt to changing conditions, and maintain consistent, dependable attendance.
  
  
**Communication & Issue Reporting:** Effectively communicate with supervisors and teammates, represent the Company professionally, and promptly report equipment issues, incidents, or safety concerns.
  
  
**Safety is #1:**  
Our safety culture is more than a policy—it’s a mindset. We have a full-time safety team, rigorous training programs, and detailed operating procedures to protect our people and the communities we serve. You’ll be supported from Day One with the tools and knowledge to work confidently and safely.
  
  
**Benefits & Wellness at SCA:**  
We believe great people deserve great perks. When you join SCA, you’re not just keeping the streets clean—you’re paving the way to a better future (with some solid benefits under the hood).
  
  
**Here’s what we’ve got in our hopper:**

**Weekly Pay:**  Consistent weekly pay you can count on, plus on-demand pay so you can access earned wages when you need them.
  
  
**Health, Dental, Vision & Life Insurance:** Take care of what matters most with benefits designed to support you and your family’s wellbeing and future.
  
  
**Short- & Long-Term Disability:** If life throws a pothole your way, we help you keep rolling.
  
  
**Indemnity Insurance:** Extra protection for life’s unexpected detours.
  
  
**Paid Time Off & Holidays:** Even the best machines need downtime.
  
  
**Training Programs:** Shift into high gear with learning and career advancement opportunities.
  
  
**Team Focus:** We show up for our customers and each other, every day.
  
  
**A Culture that Cares:** People are the heart of everything we do, fostering a culture of respect, safety, and growth.
  
  
**Rooted in Respect:** A company with a name people know & trust - built on relationships, community pride and a people focused approach to leadership.
  
  
**Physical Requirements:**  
Physical requirements outline the essential on-the-job demands needed to perform the role safely and effectively.
  
  
**Work Environment & Exposure:** Constant work outdoors with regular exposure to weather, elements, and traffic; occasional exposure to loud noise, dust/debris, and jarring conditions; limited exposure to chemicals.

Title: Chief Operating Officer
Description:
Syntys is a leading digital infrastructure platform specializing in the design, development, and operation of carrier-neutral data centers across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA). With an established and expanding network of facilities across strategic markets, Syntys delivers secure, resilient, and scalable infrastructure for hyperscalers, AI clusters, and wholesale colocation providers. Through purpose-built facilities and build-to-suit solutions, Syntys supports the growing demand for cloud, AI, and advanced computing infrastructure, enabling the continued growth of the digital economy.

We are seeking a seasoned and results-driven
**Chief Operating Officer (COO)**
to provide strategic and executive leadership across our data center operations, with enterprise-wide accountability for operational excellence, mission-critical infrastructure availability, reliability, resilience, scalability, customer commitments, and service delivery.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the COO will play a pivotal role in translating Syntys’ ambitious growth strategy into scalable operational capabilities, building a high-performing organization, and ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of our data center platform.

The role encompasses executive leadership and oversight of Data Center Operations, Critical Mechanical & Electrical (M&E) Infrastructure, Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management, Physical Security, Information Technology (IT), Cybersecurity, and Operational Sustainability, ensuring integrated governance, operational resilience, and consistent performance across all markets.

The COO will be instrumental in enabling business growth and delivering world-class operational standards to meet the demanding requirements of hyperscale cloud providers, AI infrastructure customers, GPU-intensive computing environments, and wholesale colocation clients.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Enterprise Operations & Strategic Leadership:**
  Develop and execute the enterprise-wide operations strategy, establishing scalable, standardized, and performance-driven operating models across all markets and facilities.
* **Mission-Critical Infrastructure & Engineering Operations:**
  Oversee mission-critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, power, fire protection, and facilities infrastructure, ensuring availability, reliability, uptime, and maintenance excellence. Ensure commissioning acceptance, integrated systems testing, and seamless transition from construction and project delivery into live operations.
* **Hyperscale & AI Infrastructure:**
  Drive operational readiness for hyperscale cloud, AI training, AI inference, and high-performance computing environments, including high-density power requirements, GPU infrastructure, advanced liquid cooling technologies, large-scale customer deployments, and phased capacity activation.
* **Executive Oversight of Operational Functions:**
  Provide executive oversight across headquarters and market operations, Critical Facilities Operations (Mechanical & Electrical), Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management (FM), Physical Security, Information Technology (IT), Cybersecurity, and Operational Sustainability.
* **Operational Governance, Risk & Compliance:**
  Establish operational governance frameworks, policies, procedures, and controls across all facilities. Oversee incident management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, business continuity, disaster recovery, emergency response, crisis management, operational audits, risk assessments, regulatory compliance, Operational Technology (OT) Security, cybersecurity resilience, and third-party operator and contractor performance. Ensure adherence to applicable industry standards and data center frameworks, including Uptime Institute Tier standards and relevant ISO standards.
* **Customer Experience & Strategic Account Management:**
  Ensure delivery against contractual obligations, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and customer-specific requirements. Act as the senior executive escalation point for major operational incidents and customer concerns. Lead operational business reviews and support commercial growth through operational assurance and executive-level customer engagement.
* **Financial Performance, Asset Management & Sustainability:**
  Own operational expenditure (OPEX) performance and contribute to capital expenditure (CAPEX) planning and investment prioritization. Drive cost optimization, asset lifecycle management, operational productivity, procurement effectiveness, vendor performance, budgeting, and financial forecasting. Lead energy efficiency, carbon reduction, resource optimization, and sustainability initiatives, including Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) and Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE).
* **Leadership, Organization & Talent Development:**
  Build and lead high-performing operations teams, establish clear organizational structures and leadership accountability, and drive succession planning, talent development, retention, and performance management. Foster a culture of ownership, operational discipline, safety, customer focus, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Engineering, Computer Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline. A Master's degree or relevant professional certifications are advantageous.
* **Minimum 20 years of relevant professional experience**
  , including significant senior leadership experience in data center operations, mission-critical infrastructure, or critical facilities environments.
* Proven track record of leading
  **large-scale, multi-site or geographically distributed data center operations**
  , preferably at COO, SVP Operations, or equivalent senior leadership level.
* Solid experience managing
  **hyperscaler, cloud service provider, and strategic customer relationships**
  , with a strong understanding of contractual commitments, SLAs, and service delivery expectations.
* Strong technical expertise in
  **mission-critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure**
  , including power systems, cooling technologies, maintenance strategies, operational reliability, and resilience.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing key operational functions, including
  **Data Center Operations, Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management, Physical Security, IT, and Cybersecurity**
  , with the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage operational interdependencies.
* Proven ability to manage
  **operational risks, critical incidents, business continuity, and crisis situations**
  , demonstrating sound judgment, accountability, and effective decision-making under pressure.
* Strong
  **commercial and financial acumen**
  , including operational budgeting, cost optimization, asset management, and vendor performance management.
* Demonstrated ability to
  **build and develop high-performing teams, strengthen operational governance, and scale operations**
  in a growing, multi-market business environment.
* Exposure to
  **AI infrastructure, high-density computing, GPU environments, and advanced cooling technologies**
  is highly desirable.

Title: Cybersecurity Consultant
Description:
**Location:** Doha, Qatar

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Consultant to deliver both hands-on security operations and expert advisory services to the organization and its clients. The role combines security monitoring, detection, incident response, threat analysis, and vulnerability coordination with cybersecurity consultancy, including security assessments, risk and compliance advisory, security architecture, and strategic roadmap development. The successful candidate will have strong hands-on knowledge of enterprise cybersecurity, SIEM, EDR/XDR, network security, identity security, cloud security, threat intelligence, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC).

This role will support and strengthen security operations capabilities, lead complex security incidents and assessments, translate technical findings into clear business-focused recommendations, and work closely with clients, Infrastructure, Development, IT Operations, and management to reduce cyber risk, achieve regulatory compliance, and improve overall security maturity.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. SOC Operations & Security Monitoring:

· Support and, where required, lead day-to-day SOC operations, ensuring continuous monitoring, alert triage, investigation, escalation, and response.

· Design, establish, and maintain SOC processes, operating procedures, runbooks, escalation paths, and shift models for the organization and its clients.

· Monitor security events across endpoints, servers, networks, identity platforms, cloud environments, applications, and security appliances.

· Ensure security alerts are investigated within defined priorities and response targets, with appropriate evidence and documentation.

· Continuously improve SOC workflows to reduce false positives, improve alert quality, and increase analyst efficiency.

2. SIEM, EDR/XDR & Security Tooling:

· Design, implement, and optimize SIEM operations, including log onboarding, normalization, correlation rules, dashboards, alerting, and retention.

· Configure and optimize EDR/XDR capabilities for endpoint detection, investigation, containment, and response.

· Ensure appropriate security telemetry is collected from firewalls, network devices, servers, applications, cloud platforms, identity services, and critical systems.

· Evaluate security tooling and provide vendor-neutral recommendations to improve detection, investigation, automation, and response capabilities.

· Develop and maintain security monitoring use cases aligned with business risks, threat intelligence, and emerging attack techniques.

3. Incident Response & Threat Management:

· Lead the investigation and response to high-severity cybersecurity incidents, including malware, ransomware, phishing, account compromise, data exfiltration, and unauthorized access.

· Coordinate containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident activities with technical teams, business stakeholders, and client representatives.

· Lead root-cause analysis and ensure corrective and preventive actions are identified, tracked, and completed.

· Develop, maintain, and facilitate testing of incident response plans, playbooks, and tabletop exercises.

· Support digital forensics and evidence preservation activities, engaging specialist resources when required.

4. Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting:

· Establish threat intelligence processes to identify relevant threats, indicators of compromise, vulnerabilities, and attacker tactics.

· Lead proactive threat hunting across endpoint, network, identity, cloud, and SIEM data sources.

· Develop and tune detection rules, correlation logic, queries, and use cases based on MITRE ATT&CK and observed threats.

· Translate threat intelligence into actionable monitoring, detection, and advisory recommendations.

· Track emerging threats and assess their potential impact on the organization's and clients' technology environments.

5. Vulnerability & Security Exposure Management:

· Coordinate vulnerability monitoring and remediation activities with Infrastructure, Systems, Network, Application, and Cloud teams.

· Review vulnerability findings, prioritize remediation based on risk, and monitor closure of critical and high-risk issues.

· Monitor external attack surface, exposed services, misconfigurations, and security weaknesses.

· Plan, scope, and support penetration testing, security assessments, and remediation validation activities.

6. Cloud, Network & Infrastructure Security:

· Provide security oversight and advisory across Azure, Google Cloud, on-premises data centers, enterprise networks, servers, endpoints, and identity environments.

· Demonstrate strong understanding of firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, network segmentation, DNS, secure remote access, and network traffic analysis.

· Monitor cloud security events, IAM activity, privileged access, configuration risks, and security controls.

· Recommend and support hardening, patching, segmentation, MFA, privileged access, and secure configuration baselines.

7. Cybersecurity Consultancy & Advisory Services:

· Act as a trusted cybersecurity advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, providing expert guidance on security strategy, risk, and technology decisions.

· Lead consulting engagements end-to-end, including scoping, planning, stakeholder interviews, fieldwork, analysis, reporting, and close-out.

· Develop cybersecurity strategies, target operating models, and multi-year security roadmaps aligned with business objectives.

· Translate complex technical findings into clear, prioritized, and business-focused recommendations for executives and technical teams.

· Manage engagement timelines, deliverables, quality, and client expectations to ensure successful outcomes.

Title: Transport Coordinator
Description:
##### **Job Purpose**

Join our Transport Services team, where you will play a key role in managing and optimizing our fleet and transportation operations. The team is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and on-time performance through quality control, route management, transport assessments, and continuous improvements our transportation standards.

If you are passionate about logistics, operational efficiency, and upholding the highest health and safety standards, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of Emirates Group. As part of the world’s largest international airline, our transport services team is essential in keeping our operations running smoothly and efficiently every day.

As a **Transport Coordinator** , you will be responsible for creating, updating, and maintaining vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) throughout the entire vehicle lifecycle, from inception to disposal, ensuring data accuracy and compliance with all system requirements. Generate reports and maintain comprehensive records of vehicle-related costs, monitor expenditures, reconcile pending issues, and ensure timely resolution of discrepancies. Coordinate application upgrades and system enhancements in line with operational requirements to improve efficiency. Liaise with vehicle users to identify and assess repair requirements based on reported non-technical information, conduct preliminary assessments, and assist senior management in establishing higher repair standards by recommending effective and economical solutions. Ensure efficient coordination of vehicle maintenance and repairs while maintaining cost control and optimal fleet performance.

**In this role, you will:**

* Maintain accurate and comprehensive vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) from inception to disposal. Records include vehicle specifications, user details, registration, insurance, and fuel card information. Exercise utmost care when entering technical data, as certain information cannot be amended once entered.
* Arrange repair appointments, prepare Repair Request Forms (RRFs) using appropriate technical terminology, coordinate drivers for vehicle delivery, and arrange collection upon completion of repairs. Ensure effective scheduling to minimise delays and allow sufficient time for repairs.
* Assist in inspecting vehicles and identifying technical faults within the Central Services fleet. Interpret reported problems from users who may lack technical knowledge and translate them into accurate automotive terminology to facilitate effective repairs while saving time and costs.
* Liaise with workshops to ensure accurate, timely, and cost-effective repairs. Obtain repair estimates and approvals from user departments, communicate approvals to workshops, follow up on repair progress, and ensure all relevant transactions are updated in CSTMS.
* Ensure timely collection and accurate uploading of workshop and agency invoices into CSTMS. Coordinate with IT and workshops to resolve data errors during invoice downloads, ensuring complete reconciliation with corresponding RRFs. Manually process invoices received from agencies and other garages on an invoice-by-invoice basis.
* Coordinate with internal departments regarding vehicle registration renewals, Traffic Department repair recommendations, accident-related repairs, and settlement of fines. Liaise with insurance companies, tyre suppliers, and EPPCO for insurance-related matters, tyre requirements, and fuel card issuance or cancellation.
* Assist senior management in preparing exception reports, analysing data, preparing case notes, and communicating findings. Monitor registration renewals, fuel card issuance, quotations, invoice verification, and CSTMS records to prevent overcharging and ensure cost-effective repairs and quality workmanship.
* Maintain comprehensive records of vehicle servicing, registration, insurance documents, invoices, accident reports, and other vehicle-related correspondence. Ensure timely communication of company vehicle user details to HR, Management Accounts, and Payroll.
* Provide technical guidance to user departments and workshops, as required, to ensure repairs meet the required standards. Advise vehicle users on appropriate vehicle care following major repairs, including engine and air-conditioning system overhauls.
* Prepare vehicle handover and takeover checklists, conduct random inspections of the Central Services fleet, and prepare snag lists. In the absence of available resources, arrange or personally undertake vehicle delivery and collection to and from workshops or senior managers' residences, as required.

##### **Qualification**

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**

* Have completed 12 years of schooling or equivalent.
Have at least 5 years of experience working in Supply Chain, Logistics or Transport.  

  

**You will have an edge if you have:**

* Have experience working with Resource Management Systems (RMS), Real-Time Control (RTC), Multi-Access Check-in System.
* Have experience working with Microsoft Office Applications.

Title: Construction Telecomm Skilled Labourer/Technician
Description:
**JOB OPPORTUNITY POSTING**

**POSITION TITLE:** Telecom Construction Technicians/Labourers

**LOCATION: Oshawa/Port Perry area**

**REPORTS TO:** General Manager

**Rate of Pay:** $26-30 hour

**SUMMARY: Total Cable Contracting Inc., is the fibre optic construction division of Vianet, a telecom provider that builds, owns, and operates fibre optic and wireless broadband networks across Ontario and has been in business for over thirty years.**

We have an immediate opening for telecom construction labourer/technician. The ideal candidate will have a great work ethic while working as part of a team installing underground telecommunications infrastructure in the Oshawa/Port Perry area. These positions hold the potential for continual employment for the right candidates.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Safely operate a variety of trucks and construction equipment as required. Mini excavator expereince as an asset.
* Read and properly interpret utility locates.
* Assist with aspects of the fibre optic construction process (HDD trenching, fibre installation etc.) as directed by General Manager.
* Assist the crew with restoration of work areas including backfilling holes and spreading topsoil by hand.
* Assist with installation of cable into underground conduit systems and pedestals.
* Assist all crew members as needed and requested.
* Perform different construction tasks using rakes, shovels, wheelbarrows, and related construction tools.
* Assist in transporting, loading, and unloading materials and tools.
* Communicate with co-workers for prep work and project coordination.
* Regularly perform health and safety inspection of equipment and tools

**EXPERIENCE / KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED:**

* Previous field experience in the telecommunication industry.
* Valid class G driver’s license with clean abstract.
* Ability to perform physical labour for extended periods.
* An upbeat attitude with a positive approach to work, punctual and reliable
* Willingness to learn new skills and grow.
* A team player with the ability to work well with others and assist other field crew members when needed.
* Able to work extended hours as required and, in all weather conditions.
* Ensure the safety of the job site and maintain equipment.
* Book 7 knowledge an asset.

**Why Work at Total Cable Contracting?**

* Stable, continuous employment working exclusively on Vianet fibre optic projects.
* Comprehensive wages and benefits package that include vision, dental, pension plan, extended health care, wellness benefits, and employee assistance programs.
* Regular overtime
* Low-stress work, primarily in low traffic, rural areas of the Oshawa/Port Perry area
* Modern fleet and equipment with continual maintenance and upgrades
* Training and advancement opportunities
* We provide PPE, high viz clothing and have a safety boot program.

**HOW TO APPLY:**

Please apply directly on Indeed.

* Casual dress
* Company events
* Company pension
* Dental care
* Disability insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* On-site parking
* Vision care
* Wellness program

Position Summary  
Reporting to the Manager, Technology Infrastructure & Client Support, this role leads the delivery of efficient and effective client support while bringing coordination, expertise and advice to ensure Service Desk daily activities adhere to established goals and service level objectives. This role will assist with helping develop and report on internal customer service standards, processes and trend reporting that support enhanced service delivery by the Client Services and Technology Support team.

**Major Job Responsibilities**
==============================

**Strategy & Planning**

* Provides daily leadership and direction for the team, including determining work priorities; scheduling and assigning responsibilities; monitoring procedural compliance and service quality; and assist with staff recruitment.
* Provide daily, weekly, monthly & annual service desk stats to the Manager to help with resource evaluation/utilization, capacity planning and setup procedures and standards.
* Evaluate documented service desk resolutions and analyze trends in order to develop proactive responses to enhance business continuity.
* Assist in preparing, maintaining, and upholding procedures for logging, reporting, and statistically monitoring hardware and software performance across the organization.
* Coordinate appropriate response to emerging trends in service desk incidents with I.T. Management.
* Assist in developing strategies and capacity planning for meeting future customer hardware and software requirements.
* Aid in development and maintenance of support and disaster response procedures; maintain current knowledge of plan executables and respond to crises in accordance with established procedures.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of hardware and software contracts.
* Support development and implementation of new I.T. projects and new hardware installations.

**Acquisition & Deployment**

* Perform hardware and software updates and deployments according to established Change Management processes.
* Assist with developing technical specifications for purchase of client hardware, software and related products. Liaise with vendors for the procurement of new systems technologies.
* Assist with the preparation of RFP, RFQ, Agreements, and Tender documents for client-hardware/software, evaluation of proposals.

**Team Leadership and Operational Management**

* Lead daily service desk tasks, assess them, prioritize them and assign them to service desk team to get it done within approved SLA.
* Lead and manage first level escalation from service desk team and work with manager for further escalation.
* Provide 1st and 2nd level I.T. service operation support, including incident management, problem management, and request fulfillment in order to re-establish normal business functions as quickly as possible.
* Assist with prioritization and distribution of daily service desk operations to ensure efficient and effective service delivery.
* Diagnose customer issues in-person or remotely, implement workarounds, and resolve underlying problems in order to limit customer impact and restore business services as quickly as possible; fully documenting all pertinent information throughout process lifecycle.
* Apply diagnostic utilities, processes, knowledge, and documented methodologies to aid in incident and problem resolution.
* Access software updates, drivers, knowledge bases, and internal/external FAQ resources on the Internet/Intranet to aid in problem resolution.
* Establish relationships and strengthen rapport with service desk customers through daily in-person, phone, or email interactions.
* Perform regular maintenance tasks, including daily system health checklists, security update deployments, and client device inspections.
* Perform post-resolution follow-up with Technical Support Analysts as required to ensure consistent, accurate service delivery across the team.
* Create and maintain help sheets, guides and FAQ lists to increase computer literacy and self-sufficiency amongst internal staff.
* Reinforce Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to manage customer expectations.
* Configures control and audit (inventory) of all desktop equipment; assists with design and deployment of standard desktop images and software repositories.
* Provide coaching, training and supervision of temporary Co-Op support personnel.
* Assist with the design and implementation of request handling and escalation processes and procedures for first and second-level I.T. support staff.
* Lead service desk related projects and major initiatives
* Track and analyze trends in Service Desk requests and generate statistical reports.
* Complies with and assumes appropriate responsibility for health and safety practices of the division in accordance with standard operating guidelines and the Occupational Health & Safety Act.
