==========================

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Post-secondary diploma in computer science, engineering, or information technology.
* 5 years of combined experience working in Level I & Level II Information Technology Service Desk Operations with a deep-seated troubleshooting knowledge of business hardware, software, and solutions.
* ITIL v3 certification
* In depth knowledge of Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) with the ability to align I.T. support services to the practices and processes outlined by the ITIL framework.
* Proven ability to enforce and meet service level agreement (SLA) targets across the organization.
* Ability to motivate, lead, coach staff members and colleagues.
* Exceptional written and oral communication skills with the ability to present technical ideas in a non-technical language.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills, with a focus on active listening.
* Ability to conduct research into a wide range of technology issues as required.
* Keen attention to detail with proven analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Sound organizational and time management skills with the ability to adapt to changing priorities, meet deadlines and work through frequent customer interruptions.
* Exceptional customer service orientation.
* Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
* Will need to travel between different work locations. Access to transportation to travel between work locations in a timely manner is required.

* Experience with supporting AMANDA, CLASS, CMiC, FMW, Gtechna, PerfectMind and VTAX software.

Title: Associate Administrative Officer (OPAS)
Description:
The Organizational Setting

Under the direction of the Director, Capacity Development and Implementation Bureau/ICAO (D/CDI), the Field Operations Section (FOS) is responsible for the strategic planning, development, execution, and evaluation of programmes in the Capacity Development and Implementation (CDI) Bureau. FOS assists with the identification of priority development requirements across civil aviation and with technical cooperation to recipient States. It carries out resource mobilization with multilateral and bilateral development partners and industry. FOS develops regional and country-specific technical cooperation programmes and projects and executes these programmes and projects in accordance with the policies and contractual modalities of CDI.

The Associate Administrative Officer is a combined finance and administration function that oversees the project office’s administrative and accounting tasks under the CDI Project: FSA2201. The incumbent reports to and works under the supervision of the CDI Programme Manager overseeing the project, in accordance with the terms of reference set out in this job description. The position is located in the General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) of Saudi Arabia, in Riyadh, and works in close coordination with the CDI Field Operations Officer, ICAO Headquarters, GACA, and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to ensure the efficient, compliant and timely delivery of all financial and administrative services required for the successful implementation of the project. The incumbent exercises professional judgement in planning and delivering assigned work, analysing issues and identifying appropriate action within established policies, procedures and responsibilities. Complex or exceptional matters are referred to the supervisor for guidance.

Major duties and Responsibilities

Function 1 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides accounting and financial support for the effective administration of the project office by reviewing transactions, monitoring resource use and applying established financial procedure, achieving results such as:**

* Collaborate with relevant authorities to prepare the annual manning requirement list and coordinate with ICAO-HQ for budget preparation and submission of the budget report to the GACA Finance Department on a yearly basis.
* Liaise with GACA to ensure proper budget administration, authorization, and project funding, and bring discrepancies or delays to the attention of the supervisor.
* Manage petty cash, process payments towards project office expenses, reconcile monthly expenses, and prepare and submit Electronic Journal Cash Transactions (EJCT) cash book reports to ICAO Finance in Montreal.
* Analyse and monitor petty cash balances against the established threshold stipulated under ICAO financial rules and regulations, identify and address variances, coordinate the timely deposit of excess funds to UNDP, and prepare monthly replenishment requests to ensure the project’s petty cash balance remains consistent.
* Monitor local payments and payment authorizations for ICAO OPAS Experts, vendors, and other project-related expenses through UNDP, ensuring proper fund transfers and timely follow-up.
* Review vendor statements and invoices for completeness and submit them for approval and/or facilitate payment processing and manage the financial aspects of the ICAO experts and support staff members under the project.
* Manage travel claim records of ICAO OPAS Experts, ensuring compliance with ICAO and ICSC standards, monitor unsettled claims, and follow up on payments.

Function 2 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides administrative support to the project office, achieving results such as:**

* Coordinate day-to-day administrative activities, draft and review routine correspondence and letters, coordinate and monitor official email correspondence, and monitor follow-up actions to support timely field-project implementation.
* Organize project documentation, and coordinate the review, finalization and signature of the Management Service Agreement (MSA), the ProDoc, and related records.
* Coordinate the procurement of office supplies, and official operational requirements from local markets, and facilitate the procurement of digital publications for GACA and ICAO OPAS Experts.
* Contribute to the review of project reports, presentations, and financial analysis for the CDI Programme Manager.
* Organize and maintain an orderly e-filing system and documentation of all assigned tasks, correspondence and reports, applying applicable records-management standards; ensuring confidentiality and compliance with GACA, ICAO, and UN regulations; such documents to be shared only with the consent of the CDI Programme Manager.

Function 3 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides personnel and contract administration support, achieving results such as:**

* Compile, Analyse and submit key reports such as the Monthly Strength Return, Quarterly Reports, and Annual Reports.
* Coordinate with GACA authorities/Department Heads and ICAO-HQ on critical administrative matters, including contract extensions, staff performance reports, probationary reports, new expert arrivals, and repatriation of OPAS Experts.
* Review, reconcile and submit travel expense claim reports and educational grant claim reports for ICAO experts, and review, verify and submit leave requests (Annual, Sick, Home Leave, Family Visit, Lump Sum, and Mission Requests) to ICAOHQ in accordance with established procedures.
* Coordinate with the travel agency to arrange flight itineraries and issue domestic airline tickets for approved official travel and missions.
* Maintain updated and accurate administrative records, including contract renewal documentation, annual staff performance reports? (SPRs), driving authorization letters, and vehicle insurance records.
* Liaise with UNDP and GACA to facilitate the issuance and renewal of UN/GACA identification cards (IDs), and manage government-related requests such as Visas, IQAMA, Multiple Re-entry Visas, Final Exit Visas, and Driving Licenses through coordination with UNDP, UNRC and GACA.
* Coordinate training requirements for ICAO experts, including liaison with ICAO Global Aviation Training (GAT) Section, and prepare employment-related letters (bank letters, visa request letters, staff arrival letters, etc.).

Function 4 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides coordination, meetings and stakeholder support, achieving results such as:**

* Organize annual, quarterly and urgent meetings for the project office, and prepare draft agendas and minutes of the meetings (MOM) for project records.
* Liaise with GACA, ICAO, UNDP, UNDSS, UNRC and other relevant offices for project coordination, recruitment, and administrative support, and assist in meetings with these stakeholders to address project requirements.
* Facilitate recruitment processes, including coordination with GACA and ICAO for candidate approvals and onboarding, and assist with contract extensions, SPR, and repatriation processes for project staff.
* Ensure smooth communication and coordination across all stakeholders, inside and outside the project office, for the effective implementation of the project.
* Maintain the confidentiality of all project-related data and ensure compliance with GACA, ICAO, and UN regulations.

Function 5 (incl. Expected results)

**Performs any other duties as required for the successful and timely implementation of the programme.**

Impact of The Outcome of the Position

The Associate Administrative Officer ensures effective project administration by managing communications, documentation, and stakeholder coordination. This role directly supports project efficiency, compliance, and the seamless operation of administrative tasks within the ICAO-CDI Project. The position plays a key role in maintaining efficient administrative operations, ensuring compliance with policies, and supporting project coordination, which directly impacts smooth project execution and stakeholder collaboration.

Work Relations and Contacts

The Associate Administrative Officer reports to the GACA Authorities in close coordination with the CDI Programme Manager. The incumbent also coordinates with ICAO experts on administrative matters, ensuring compliance with policies and procedures.

COMPETENCIES

**Core Competencies** **:**

**Professionalism** : Shows pride in work and in achievements; demonstrates professional competence and mastery of subject matter; is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results; is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns; shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges; remains calm in stressful situations. Takes responsibility for incorporating gender perspectives and ensuring the equal participation of women and men in all areas of work.

**Teamwork** : Works collaboratively with colleagues to achieve organizational goals; solicits input by genuinely valuing others’ ideas and expertise; is willing to learn from others; places team agenda before personal agenda; supports and acts in accordance with final group decision, even when such decisions may not entirely reflect own position; shares credit for team accomplishments and accepts joint responsibility for team shortcomings.

**Communication:** Speaks and writes clearly and effectively; listens to others, correctly interprets messages from others and responds appropriately; asks questions to clarify, and exhibits interest in having two-way communication; tailors language, tone, style, and format to match the audience; demonstrates openness in sharing information and keeping people informed.

**Planning and Organizing** : Develops clear goals that are consistent with agreed strategies; identifies priority activities and assignments; adjusts priorities as required; allocates appropriate amount of time and resources for completing work; foresees risks and allows for contingencies when planning; monitors and adjusts plans and actions as necessary; uses time efficiently.

**Accountability** : Takes ownership of all responsibilities and honours commitments; delivers outputs for which one has responsibility within prescribed time, cost and quality standards; operates in compliance with organizational regulations and rules; supports subordinates, provides oversight and takes responsibility for delegated assignments; takes personal responsibility for his/her own shortcomings and those of the work unit, where applicable.

**Client Orientation** : Considers all those to whom services are provided to be “clients ” and seeks to see things from clients’ point of view; establishes and maintains productive partnerships with clients by gaining their trust and respect; Identifies clients’ needs and matches them to appropriate solutions; monitors ongoing developments inside and outside the clients’ environment to keep informed and anticipate problems; keeps clients informed of progress or setbacks in projects; meets timeline for delivery of products or services to client.

Qualifications and Experience

Education

**Essential**

* A first-level university degree (Bachelor’s) in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

**Desirable**

* An advanced university degree (Master’s) in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

Professional Experience

**Essential**

* A minimum of four years of relevant experience in administration, finance, or project management, preferably in aviation or international projects.
* Proficiency in financial reporting, budget management, and cash management.
* Proven experience in office management and administrative procedures.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize and multi-task, and strong attention to detail, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication skills, with experience in coordinating with international and local organizations and various stakeholders.
* Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel and PowerPoint), document editing software (Microsoft Office, Adobe Pro), financial software and ERP systems.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

**Desirable**

* Knowledge of ICAO CDI – Field Service Staff Rules (FSSR) and associated Personnel Instructions (PIs).
* Experience in vendor management and procurement.
* Experience and knowledge in the aviation industry.

Languages

**Essential**

* Fluent reading, writing and speaking abilities in English.

**Desirable**

* Knowledge of any of the other languages of the Organization (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish).

Remuneration

Professional Category (P-2)

Manages acquisitions, contracts, lifecycle planning, policy development, and implementation of secure nationwide P25 and encrypted communications.

* Managing a national or multi-regional Land Mobile Radio (LMR) program by developing strategic plans, establishing program priorities, and overseeing lifecycle management activities for mission-critical communications systems.

* Leading acquisition and procurement activities for communications equipment, systems, and services, including development of technical requirements, statements of work, acquisition strategies, and technical evaluations.

* Overseeing communications-related contracts and agreements by providing technical direction, monitoring contractor performance, and ensuring compliance with Federal acquisition regulations and agency requirements.

* Serving as the primary liaison with Law Enforcement and Investigations (LE&I) organizations, providing program leadership, technical guidance, and coordination of communications requirements supporting law enforcement operations.

* Developing, implementing, and evaluating communications policies, standards, procedures, and governance affecting agency-wide or nationwide communications programs.

* Developing, implementing, managing, or supports secure P25, encrypted, and interoperable Land Mobile Radio communications systems that support law enforcement, public safety, and multi-agency operations.

* Providing expert technical consultation and program oversight for nationwide LMR systems, including communications planning, system sustainment strategies, network requirements, and modernization initiatives supporting mission-critical law enforcement communications.

Title: IT Coordinator
Description:
The IT & AV Coordinator is responsible for the day-to-day operation, support and maintenance of all information technology systems and audio-visual (AV) equipment across the hotel. The role ensures that guest-facing technology (Wi-Fi, in-room entertainment, digital signage, meeting and banquet AV) and operational systems (PMS, POS, back-office networks and devices) run reliably, securely and to the standard expected of a quality hospitality brand.

The postholder acts as the first point of contact for technical issues from guests, event clients and hotel staff, coordinates with external vendors, and supports events with hands-on AV setup and operation.

**A. IT Operations and Support**

* Provide first- and second-line support to all hotel departments (Front Office, Housekeeping, F&B, Sales, Finance, HR, Engineering) for hardware, software, printers, phones and accounts.
* Log, prioritise and resolve incidents through a ticketing system, meeting agreed response and resolution times.
* Install, configure and maintain desktops, laptops, tablets, handheld devices, printers, scanners and point-of-sale terminals.
* Manage user accounts, email, permissions and access rights, including onboarding and offboarding of staff.
* Support and troubleshoot hotel core systems such as Property Management System (PMS), Point of Sale (POS), Central Reservation System (CRS) interfaces, revenue and sales/catering software, door-lock systems, and payment terminals.
* Maintain accurate IT asset inventory, licences, warranties and support contracts.

**B. Network, Wi-Fi and Infrastructure**

* Monitor and maintain LAN/WAN, guest and staff Wi-Fi, switches, routers, firewalls, access points and structured cabling.
* Ensure guest Wi-Fi performance, captive portal, bandwidth management and quick resolution of guest connectivity complaints.
* Support servers, virtualisation, backup systems and cloud services; verify that backups run successfully and test restores periodically.
* Coordinate with internet service providers and system vendors on faults, upgrades and outages.
* Support telephony/VoIP, CCTV, IPTV and building-management integrations as required.

**C. Audio-Visual (AV) and Events Support**

* Set up, operate and dismantle AV equipment for meetings, conferences, weddings, banquets and other events, including projectors, LED/LCD screens, microphones (wired and wireless), mixers, speakers, video-conferencing systems, lighting controls and presentation switchers.
* Meet with event organisers and the Sales/Events team to understand technical requirements before each event; carry out equipment and connectivity checks prior to start
* Provide live technical support during events and resolve issues immediately and discreetly.
* Maintain, test, store and track all AV equipment, cables and accessories; report damage, loss or the need for replacement.
* Manage and support in-room and public-area displays, digital signage, music/background audio systems and screen-casting solutions.
* Coordinate with external AV suppliers for large or specialised events and verify their set-up against safety and hotel standards.

**D. Guest Experience**

* Respond promptly to guest technology requests (Wi-Fi, TV, casting, charging, device connection, business-centre needs) in a polite and professional manner.
* Work with Front Office and Guest Services to track recurring guest IT issues and recommend improvements.
* Support in-room technology rollouts, smart-room features and self-service kiosks.

**E. Security, Compliance and Risk**

* Apply and enforce IT security policies: antivirus/endpoint protection, patching, password and access controls, and secure Wi-Fi configuration.
* Support compliance with PCI-DSS for payment systems and applicable data-protection and privacy regulations for guest and employee data.
* Report security incidents, suspicious activity and data-handling concerns to the IT Manager without delay.
* Maintain disaster recovery and business-continuity documentation and take part in testing

**F. Implementations, Vendors and Administration**

* Support IT and AV projects such as renovations, new outlet openings, system upgrades and migrations.
* Liaise with vendors and contractors, obtain quotations, and monitor service-level agreements.
* Prepare reports on incidents, system uptime, asset status and AV usage; contribute to IT budget planning.
* Maintain clear technical documentation, user guides and event AV checklists.
* Provide basic training to staff on hotel systems and AV equipment.

**G. Health and Safety**

* Follow hotel health and safety procedures when handling equipment, working at heights, running cables and setting up in public areas.
* Ensure all AV and IT installations are safe, tidy and do not obstruct guest or emergency routes.

***REQUIREMENTS***

**Education (Mandatory)**

* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Electronics, Networking or a related field.

**Experience**

* Essential: 2–4 years of experience in IT support, network administration or a combined IT/AV role.
* +
* 3Preferred: At least 1–2 years in a hotel, resort, hospitality or large events/conference venue environment.
* Preferred: Hands-on experience operating AV equipment for live events.

**Technical Skills**

**IT**

* Windows desktop and server environments; Microsoft 365 / Active Directory / Azure AD administration.
* Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, VPN, firewalls, switching and Wi-Fi design and troubleshooting.
* Hardware troubleshooting for PCs, printers, POS devices and mobile devices.
* Backup, patching, antivirus and basic cybersecurity practices.
* Familiarity with hotel systems such as Opera PMS, Micros/Simphony POS, or similar (preferred).
* Experience with ticketing or helpdesk tools.

**AV**

* Operation of projectors, LED walls, sound systems, digital mixers, wireless microphones and video-conferencing platforms (Zoom, Teams, Webex).
* Signal routing and cabling (HDMI, SDI, XLR, audio/video over IP), and basic lighting control.
* Experience with room-control and signage systems (such as Crestron, Extron, QSC or equivalent) is an advantage.

**Soft Skills and Competencies**

* Strong guest-service mindset, with a calm and professional approach under pressure.
* Excellent verbal and written communication in English; additional languages are an advantage.
* Ability to explain technical issues in simple terms to non-technical users.
* Strong problem-solving, prioritisation and time-management skills.
* Team player who works well with Sales, Events, Banquets, Front Office and Engineering.
* Attention to detail, reliability and a sense of ownership.
* Discretion and integrity when handling confidential guest and company information.

**Working Conditions**

* Work is shift-based and includes evenings, weekends and public holidays, particularly during events.
* On-call availability for critical system failures may be required.
* The role involves moving and lifting AV equipment (up to approximately 20 kg), standing for long periods and working in event venues, server rooms and back-of-house areas.
* Smart, presentable grooming in line with hotel standards is required when working in guest areas.

**5. Career Development**

This role provides a pathway towards IT Supervisor or Systems/Network Specialist positions, supported by training and certification opportunities.

Pay: AED2,500.00 - AED3,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Expert Engineer/Security Operation Centre
Description:
**Job Description**
The Subject Matter Expert – Security Operations Center (SOC) oversees advanced security monitoring and incident management activities within the Cyber Security function. This role serves as the primary escalation point for complex or high-severity security incidents, providing technical leadership and validation before handover to Incident Response teams.
  
  
The SME leads deep-dive investigations using SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewalls, endpoint detection, and network telemetry, and applies frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and DEFEND to strengthen threat-hunting and detection coverage. The role is responsible for designing, tuning, and validating detection rules, developing and maintaining SOC playbooks and runbooks, and ensuring effective monitoring across hybrid infrastructures (on-prem, cloud, and telco cloud).
  
  
In addition, the SME mentors SOC engineers, conducts trainings and technical workshops, drives automation opportunities (SOAR playbooks and workflows), and contributes to continuous improvement of SOC processes and content. The role also monitors threat intelligence, tracks emerging threats and vulnerabilities, and communicates findings through clear reports and presentations to security leadership and stakeholders. The SME may participate in RFP processes, providing technical input to help select best-fit security solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary contact for advanced security monitoring, threat detection, and investigation methodologies.
* Lead and supervise team members to ensure effective incident detection and response.
* Provide technical guidance and escalation support to SOC analysts for complex or high-severity incidents.
* Act as the final technical validation authority before escalating to Incident Response (IR) teams.
* Utilize the MITRE ATT&CK and DEFEND frameworks to map detected threats and enhance threat-hunting capabilities.
* Lead in-depth analysis of security events from multiple sources, such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewall logs, endpoint detection tools, and network traffic data.
* Conduct deep-dive technical investigations for high-impact or ambiguous alerts.
* Identify gaps in detection coverage and recommend improvements.
* Continuously support the content development team by recommending detection rule tuning to reduce false positives and by proposing new advanced correlation rules, behavioral detections, and anomaly-based use cases.
* Develop and maintain SOC playbooks and runbooks to ensure consistent investigation standards.
* Ensure effective detection and monitoring across hybrid environments, including on-premises, cloud, and telco cloud.
* Support SOC shift staff in maintaining SLA compliance.
* Review and quality-check investigation reports before closure.
* Participate in major incident calls as the SOC technical lead.
* Conduct post-incident detection gap analysis.
* Mentor analysts and organize trainings to maintain team expertise.
* Develop knowledge articles, technical documentation, and use-case libraries.
* Lead internal technical workshops and purple-team collaboration exercises.
* Monitor and analyze threat intelligence feeds, security blogs, and industry news to stay informed on emerging threats and vulnerabilities.
* Communicate findings through detailed, high-quality reports and presentations to security teams, management, and relevant stakeholders.
* Participate in the RFP process to provide technical recommendations and propose best-fit solutions.

**Qualifications**
**Formal Education Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

**Related Professional Training, Certification Or Membership**

* Cybersecurity-related certification(s).

**Preferred**

* CISM
* CISSP
* Microsoft Sentinel training
* Splunk training

**Years & Field Of Experience Required**

* 8–10 years

**Job-Specific Competencies**

* Mandatory: Team Lead experience
* Deep experience in monitoring and interpreting SIEM outputs, including log correlation, alert triage, and threat prioritization.
* Ability to design, validate, and tune detection rules and alerts for multiple platforms (SIEM, EDR, NDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls).
* Advanced log analysis skills across endpoints, network, identity systems, and cloud environments.
* Experience with SIEM technologies such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, etc., EDR, and Threat Intelligence Platforms.
* Proficiency in building and executing complex queries (KQL, SPL, or vendor-specific languages) for detection and investigation.
* Expertise in identifying automation potential in SOC manual processes/workflows and designing their transformation into automated SOC/IR playbooks and modules within SOAR, such as FortiSOAR and Splunk SOAR.
* Strong knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP/S, DNS, FTP, SMTP) and the ability to identify malicious activity patterns.
* Ability to analyze threat intelligence feeds and apply IOC/TTP indicators to operational detection logic.
* Expertise in monitoring Anti-DDoS solutions and understanding mitigation at an operational level.
* Strong capability to validate alerts and investigation outputs from SOC engineers to ensure quality and accuracy.
* Experience in documenting investigations, creating runbooks, and maintaining operational knowledge repositories.
* Understanding of the global threat landscape through analysis of cyber threat intelligence.
* Ability to mentor and coach SOC engineers on technical best practices, complex investigations, and use-case development.
* Awareness of the current threat landscape, malware trends, and attack vectors, with the ability to translate this into operational detection priorities.

Title: Technical Supervisor - Digital Delivery - Civil 3D/ Naviswork - Infra/ utilities
Description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

AECOM Middle East Infrastructure delivers civil and utility infrastructure design across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. The Digital Delivery / BIM team models and documents wet utilities, dry utilities, MEICA and smart technology networks for these projects, and is responsible for the quality, coordination and timely issue of the information that comes out of them.

**Purpose of the role**

Supervise a group of BIM team leads delivering concurrent infrastructure projects, and carry the accountability for what that group produces. On the team's responsibility assignment matrix this is the second most accountable position after the BIM Manager: it owns resource deployment, clash resolution, validation of model and drawing submissions, and the final check before anything is issued for design review.

**Key responsibilities**

**Deployment and progress**

* Own the deployment of resource across the group's disciplines, and rebalance it as project demand moves.
* Chair production progress meetings and discipline coordination meetings for the group.
* Own the key performance indicators reported for the group, and the progress position on clash and issue resolution.
* Onboard third parties brought in to support the project team.

**Delivery management**

* Own model and drawing delivery for the group, against the master information delivery plan and the discipline task information delivery plans.
* Own the standards that the work is produced to: NOC data standardisation, base plan standardisation, base plan and title block milestone requirements, and the authoring tool template files.
* Own data shortcut setup and the part catalogue or object library arranged for each project.
* Own the implementation of design automation in support of the production teams.
* Maintain the single source of truth for the 2D extraction of drawings.

**Validation and issue**

* Validate discipline model submissions against the model checklist, and BIM data for GIS submission against the GIS checklist.
* Own the drawing checklist and CAD standard compliance check.
* Perform the final drawing sanity check before anything is issued to discipline or interdisciplinary review.
* Own quantity take-off compliance where it feeds the bill of quantities.

**Clash and interface**

* Own the clash resolution activity for the group, end to end.
* Issue direction and provide the solution where a clash needs a decision.
* Agree the solution with the engineering team and establish which modeller carries the fix.
* Ensure interfaces and tie-ins between disciplines and with third parties are coordinated.

**People**

* Deliver internal training on the authoring tools, and confirm the group's capability against project requirements.
* Manage performance and development for the team leads reporting to the role.
* Support recruitment, technical interviewing and onboarding.

**Technical requirements**

* Civil 3D and AutoCAD to an advanced level, with a working command of Navisworks for clash and interface management.
* Autodesk Construction Cloud or BIM 360, including model coordination spaces and package sharing.
* ISO 19650 in practice: BIM execution plan, master and task information delivery plans, information states and level of information need.
* Data shortcuts, part catalogues, object styles and authoring templates at a level that lets the role set them for others.
* Local authority requirements in the UAE and Saudi Arabia, including utility depth, cover and corridor allocation standards.

**Qualifications and experience**

* Degree in Civil Engineering, or a diploma with equivalent proven experience.
* Ten or more years in infrastructure design production, of which at least five supervising multiple teams or a large production team in an engineering consultancy.
* Demonstrable record of delivering to ISO 19650 on live projects; formal certification is an advantage.
* Middle East consultancy experience strongly preferred.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

**Behaviours we are selecting for**

* Holds a standard consistently, including when programme pressure argues against it.
* Takes the decision on a clash rather than letting it circulate.
* Plans resource ahead of demand rather than reacting to a shortfall.
* Develops people deliberately, and is judged on their progression.

**How performance is measured**

* On-time issue of the group's deliverables against the agreed programme.
* Model and drawing checklist failures found after the role's own validation.
* Clash resolution rate and the ageing of open clashes in the group.
* Utilisation and bench time across the group against the deployment plan.

Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. **Position Summary**  
Reporting to the Manager, College Events, the Program and Events Coordinator coordinates the implementation and delivery of Centre for Faculty Development and Teaching Innovation (CFDTI) events and other programming. The Program and Events Coordinator works with the Manager, CFDTI, internal clients and stakeholders, and external partners and vendors to translate event objectives into practical event plans. They coordinate critical paths, run-of-show, timelines, budgets, logistical requirements, communications, catering, hotel accommodations, travel arrangements, vendors, staffing and volunteer plans, registration processes, set-up support, day-of execution, and wrap-up activities of assigned events. The incumbent coordinates support and services from a range of internal and external resources to ensure events are delivered in a professional, accessible manner within approved scope and budget; this includes College services and departments (ex. Facilities, Audio-Visual Services, etc.) and external vendors and other stakeholders.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Works with CFDTI faculty and staff to implement an annual plan of CFDTI programming and activities.
* Coordinates a range of CFDTI programs and events, including scheduling, registration, logistics, room bookings, hospitality, and administration (ex. registrations, reminders, attendance monitoring, etc.).
* Organizes and supports the logistical planning of institutional teaching and learning events and participates in the planning committees; ex. Teaching and Learning Symposium, Faculty Summit, etc.
* Provides support in scheduling, planning, and coordinating annual institutional training initiatives and programs, such as New Faculty Orientation, Professional Development Leave, Scholarship of Teaching and Learning program, etc.

* Coordinates staff and logistics for livestreaming, including submitting service request tickets to AV/IT teams with event details, AV requirements, associated links to share via event communications and websites, and any additional support needed.
* Collaborates with IT and AV services to perform event technology testing, checking during technical rehearsals and ahead of go-live time day-of that livestream is working and supporting with testing links, presentations, embedded videos, etc. to ensure successful operation in a live environment.
* Coordinates the CFDTI calendar of events and weekly compendium broadcasts and responds to general inquiries via phone call, email, etc. regarding CFDTI events.
* Monitors general email boxes for events, convocations, and campus tours, etc., responding to questions, information requests, and other inquiries.
* Provides back-up and logistical support for other Events Coordinators as required or assigned, which may involve travel or temporary relocation to another College campus other than their primary/assigned campus.

Network Operation Center Supervisor I
Description:
**Job Title:** Network Operations Center Supervisor I

**Department:** Network Operation Center

**Reports to:** Network Operations Center Manager

**Location:** On-site located in Spokane Valley, WA

**About NoaNet**

NoaNet is a non-profit mutual corporation providing telecom solutions and services and is headquartered in Spokane Valley, Washington. For over 20 years, NoaNet has operated a reliable public open-access broadband network that today totals over 3,800 fiber miles and touches every county in Washington State. Our organization provides rural areas access to broadband services, supporting more than 100 last-mile providers that serve more than 260,000 customers. NoaNet’s owner/members are nine public utility districts and a joint operating agency. Learn more about NoaNet at https://noanet.net.

**Career Overview**

Support network operations center analysts in a leadership role by leading, training, and coaching a team of network analysts to provide superior customer support relating to monitoring, troubleshooting and repairing NoaNet’s and our NCS members networks consisting of multiple systems including PON, carrier Ethernet, and MPLS. Provide technical support to clients via telephone, remote access, and on-site service; provide circuit design support by interfacing with engineering, provisioning, and customers; provide technical expertise and training to network operations analyst for troubleshooting and maintenance of the network and associated equipment, interface with installers to test and turn up new circuit orders; and other duties as assigned. Provide field support to install, maintain and troubleshoot circuits and systems and, work closely with NoaNet’s engineering and sales teams, and provide guidance and support to contract installers.

**Responsibilities**

* Supervise a team of network analyst to provide superior customer service through effective leadership, documentation, training, and coaching techniques.
* Provide exceptional customer service by possessing strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ensure NOC Analysts are properly trained and adhere to company policies associated with monitoring the network, proper call handling techniques, and best practice troubleshooting skills.
* Work closely with the field engineering and engineering teams in support of installations, provisioning, troubleshooting, and repair of the network following good engineering practices with a primary focus of network reliability.
* Install and configure network equipment for service order implementation and train network operations analysts to do the same.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and maintain a positive attitude.
* Provide telephone-based technical support to clients and customers.
* Train network operations analysts in learning NoaNet’s network architecture, equipment, troubleshooting techniques, and industry standard installation practices.
* Assist in maintaining the internal IT infrastructure of NoaNet systems.
* Assist field installers configuring the network to complete circuit order installations.
* Possess intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office, and PC and server hardware.
* Possess intermediate knowledge of structured cabling.
* Possess intermediate knowledge of installation, maintenance and troubleshooting practices to install and maintain optical systems and cabling.
* Possess basic Windows and/or Linux/Unix server knowledge.
* Have ability and motivation to learn new technologies on own quickly and with minimal support and guidance.
* Demonstrate clear and professional communications both verbally and in writing.
* Have ability to read, listen to, and follow complex technical instructions, as well as research, locate, and follow written technical documentation.
* Provide direction, training, and mentoring to others.
* Work independently, organizing and setting priorities with minimal supervision.
* Be available to respond to emergencies 24/7/365.
* Seek and take advantage of opportunities for professional growth.
* Ability to install, maintain and troubleshoot MPLS, Ethernet and optical networking equipment.
* Complete and submit work orders, job tickets, time records, reports, and assignments promptly and efficiently.
* Other duties assigned.

  

**Education, Training, Knowledge, Skills and Qualifications**

* Understanding of IP/Ethernet routing and switching.
* Familiarity with Routing Protocols.
* Configuring and troubleshooting Ethernet circuits (VLANs) on a service provider network.
* Advanced knowledge of Core, Distribution, and Access layer designs and topologies.
* Familiarity with best network security practices.
* Cisco, Nokia, or similar certification or the ability to obtain the required certification within 6 months (equivalent certifications accepted).
* Knowledge and experience with process management and improvement techniques.
* Ability to independently manage assigned projects.
* Strong organizational, coordination, written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.
* Strong people skills and the willingness to be accountable for results.
* Ability to set own priorities as well as manage time responsibly.
* Must have excellent customer relationship skills.
* Required – Comptia Network+ Certification.
* Desirable – ALU MPLS Certification(s) – NRS1.

  

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to perform the essential job functions, including any required physical duties, with or without reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodations will be made in accordance with applicable law.
* Maintain dress and appearance appropriate for a professional office setting.

  

**Working Conditions**

* Regularly sit, reach with hands and arms, and talk and hear.
* Frequently stand, walk and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
* Regularly lift and move up to 10 lb., frequently lift and move up to 20 lb., and occasionally lift and move up to 50 lb.
* Use close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and have ability to adjust focus.

  

**Driving Requirements**

* Must maintain and possess a valid driver’s license, proof of insurance, and a satisfactory driving record.

  

**Location**

  

* On-site at Redwood Plaza located in Spokane Valley, Washington

  

**Wage**

* Wage range $32.56/hr - $46.00/hr DOE non-exempt position

  

**Benefits**

* Defined Benefit Retirement Plan through the WA State Department of Retirement Systems
* 457b Optional Supplement Plan
* Medical, Dental and Vision insurance
* Accidental Death and Long Term Disability Plan

Title: Logistics Operations Officer
Description:
### KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

#### 1. Shipment & Logistics Coordination

\* Coordinate daily import and export shipments from origin to final delivery.

\* Arrange and monitor \*\*FCL, LCL, air freight, and land transportation\*\*.

\* Coordinate with shipping lines, freight forwarders, airlines, transporters, customs brokers, and clearing agents.

\* Obtain freight quotations and negotiate competitive rates and service terms.

\* Ensure timely booking of containers, vessels, flights, and trucks.

\* Monitor shipment schedules, ETD/ETA, transshipment, delays, and delivery status.

\* Maintain an updated shipment tracker for all active shipments.

#### 2. Import & Export Operations

\* Handle complete import/export logistics documentation.

\* Coordinate \*\*Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin, Phytosanitary Certificate, Health Certificate, COO and other relevant documents\*\*.

\* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure documents are received accurately and on time.

\* Liaise with customs and relevant government authorities for shipment clearance.

\* Ensure compliance with UAE import regulations and GCC requirements.

\* Coordinate inspection, approval, sampling, and release of shipments where required.

#### 3. Perishable & Food Cargo

\* Manage logistics for \*\*fresh fruits, vegetables, rice, wheat flour, sugar, edible oils and other food products\*\*.

\* Coordinate temperature-controlled transportation and reefer containers where required.

\* Monitor cold-chain requirements and ensure cargo is handled within the required temperature range.

\* Coordinate urgent action in case of cargo delays, port issues, customs holds, or quality concerns.

\* Ensure perishable shipments are prioritized for clearance and delivery.

#### 4. Port, Airport & Customs Coordination

\* Coordinate with \*\*Jebel Ali, Khorfakkan, Fujairah and UAE airports\*\* as required.

\* Follow up on container discharge, D/O, customs clearance, inspections, port releases and gate-in/gate-out activities.

\* Coordinate trucking arrangements for container pickup and delivery.

\* Resolve operational issues involving shipping lines, terminals, ports, airlines, customs, and transport companies.

\* Monitor demurrage, detention, storage, port and other logistics-related charges.

#### 5. Transportation & Delivery

\* Arrange local and GCC transportation according to shipment requirements.

\* Coordinate container trucks, refrigerated trucks and delivery vehicles.

\* Ensure timely collection from ports/airports and delivery to warehouses or customers.

\* Obtain PODs and maintain proper delivery records.

\* Monitor vehicle movement and coordinate with drivers and transport companies.

#### 6. Supplier & Freight Forwarder Management

\* Maintain strong working relationships with suppliers, freight forwarders, shipping lines, airlines, transporters and clearing agents.

\* Request and compare quotations before confirming logistics arrangements.

\* Evaluate service quality, transit time, pricing and reliability of logistics providers.

\* Escalate repeated operational failures and negotiate corrective actions.

\* Develop a reliable network of logistics service providers across key trade lanes.

#### 7. Cost Control

\* Review freight quotations and logistics invoices.

\* Negotiate freight, trucking, clearance, handling, storage and other operational charges.

\* Monitor and minimize \*\*demurrage, detention, storage, waiting time and unnecessary additional costs\*\*.

\* Verify logistics invoices against agreed quotations and shipment records.

\* Maintain shipment-wise logistics cost records.

#### 8. Documentation & Reporting

\* Maintain complete and organized shipment files.

\* Prepare daily/weekly shipment status reports.

\* Maintain records of:

\* Shipment status

\* ETA/ETD

\* Container numbers

\* BL/AWB details

\* Customs status

\* Clearance status

\* Delivery status

\* Logistics costs

\* Outstanding documents

\* Provide management with regular updates on delayed, urgent, or high-value shipments.

### MANAGER-LEVEL RESPONSIBILITIES

For the \*\*Logistics Operations Manager\*\* position, additional responsibilities include:

\* Lead and supervise the logistics operations team.

\* Develop logistics SOPs and operational procedures.

\* Establish and manage freight-forwarder and transporter contracts.

\* Negotiate annual/monthly freight rates and credit facilities.

\* Develop strategic relationships with shipping lines, airlines and logistics providers.

\* Monitor overall logistics performance and operational KPIs.

\* Optimize shipping routes, freight costs and delivery schedules.

\* Plan logistics capacity based on projected purchasing and sales volumes.

\* Identify operational risks and develop contingency plans.

\* Manage major shipment escalations and resolve operational disputes.

\* Train and supervise logistics staff.

\* Report logistics performance, costs and issues directly to senior management.

### KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

\* On-time shipment booking

\* On-time customs clearance

\* On-time delivery

\* Freight cost savings

\* Reduction in demurrage and detention

\* Documentation accuracy

\* Shipment visibility and tracking

\* Supplier/forwarder response time

\* Reduction in shipment delays

\* Successful handling of perishable cargo

\* Logistics cost per shipment/container

\* Customer delivery performance

### REQUIREMENTS

\*\*Education:\*\*

\* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, International Trade, or a related field.

\*\*Experience:\*\*

\* Officer: \*\*2–4 years\*\* relevant logistics/import-export experience.

\* Manager: \*\*5+ years\*\* relevant logistics/supply chain experience.

\* UAE logistics experience is highly preferred.

\* Experience with \*\*foodstuff, FMCG, agricultural products, perishables, or trading companies\*\* will be an advantage.

### REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE

\* UAE import/export procedures

\* Customs clearance

\* Shipping and freight forwarding

\* FCL/LCL operations

\* Air freight operations

\* Reefer and temperature-controlled cargo

\* Port and terminal procedures

\* Transportation and trucking

\* Import/export documentation

\* Demurrage and detention

\* GCC logistics

\* Incoterms

\* Basic logistics cost analysis

### SKILLS

\* Strong negotiation and communication skills

\* Excellent coordination and follow-up abilities

\* Strong problem-solving skills

\* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines

\* Good knowledge of MS Excel and Microsoft Office

\* Strong documentation and organizational skills

\* Ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously

\* Strong commercial awareness

\* Ability to communicate effectively with suppliers, forwarders, transporters and government authorities

\* Fluent English required; \*\*Hindi/Arabic\*\* would be an advantage.

### PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

\* Proactive and responsible

\* Highly organized and detail-oriented

\* Strong sense of urgency

\* Commercially minded

\* Reliable and accountable

\* Good team player

\* Capable of independently handling operational issues

\* Willing to work beyond standard hours when urgent shipments require attention

### WORKING ENVIRONMENT

The role requires frequent communication and coordination with suppliers, freight forwarders, shipping lines, airlines, customs brokers, transport companies, warehouses, customers and internal departments.

The candidate must be prepared to handle urgent shipment requirements, delays, port/airport issues and time-sensitive perishable cargo operations.

### AUTHORITY & ACCOUNTABILITY

The Logistics Operations Officer / Manager will be accountable for ensuring that shipments are:

\*\*Booked → Shipped → Cleared → Collected → Delivered\*\*

efficiently, cost-effectively, safely, and within the required timelines.

For the Manager position, the role will also be responsible for \*\*team performance, logistics cost optimization, service-provider management and overall logistics strategy\*\*.

Pay: AED2,500.00 - AED4,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: IT Specialty - Major Incident Commander
Description:
**Title – IT Specialty - Major Incident Commander**

**Location – Remote - Partial Travel**

The Major Incident Manager (MIM) for a Healthcare IT Enterprise Operations Center (EOC) is a high-impact leadership role responsible for the end-to-end management of critical IT service disruptions that affect patient care, clinical workflows, and hospital operations. This is senior level, decision authority role within Core Tech, responsible for leading enterprise-level, Tier 1 incidents across the healthcare environment. This role goes beyond traditional incident coordination and requires command authority, strong executive communication, and deep understanding of healthcare IT operations, including infrastructure, networking, clinical imaging, and EHR access. This role exists because the current incident model is not meeting enterprise needs and requires experienced leadership to reset and stabilize Tier 1 incident response across multiple facilities.

This role is accountable for incident outcomes, not coordination alone. Candidates should be vetted for sound judgement, executive level communication and styles, and ability to lead people.

**Role Summary**

The Major Incident Manager acts as the "Incident Commander," (single point of command) driving the swift restoration of critical healthcare services (e.g., EHR access, diagnostic imaging, and network connectivity) while maintaining transparent communication with executive leadership and clinical stakeholders. This role is responsible for incident outcomes, not just processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Incident Command & Coordination:**

* Lead the Major Incident Bridge by facilitating 24/7 technical bridge calls and "war rooms" to triage and resolve Priority 1 (P1) and Priority 2 (P2) incidents impacting multiple health ministries or systems.
* MIM impact to multiple facilities, wider user impacts, or multiple technology failures.
* Lead real‑time decision‑making under pressure, balancing technical recovery with patient‑safety and clinical impact.
* Resources will not typically be responsible for concurrent major incident ownership

**Clinical Impact Assessment:**

* Quickly evaluate the scope of technical outages to determine their impact on patient safety and critical business applications.
* Outages may impact EHR systems, Clinical Imaging, Network dependencies, as examples.
* Identify trends, anomalies, and recurring failure patterns

**Stakeholder Communication:**

* Issue regular, clear updates to senior leadership (CIO/CTO) and Service Portfolio leads using pre-defined communication templates and protocols.
* Maintain confidence and calm in high‑pressure situations with senior leaders and clinical partners.

**Post-Incident Management:**

* Own and facilitate after action reports and Post-Incident Reviews (PIR) within 48 hours to identify root causes and drive preventive actions.
* Conduct root cause discussions and ensure corrective actions are identified and tracked.
* Communication and stakeholder management are the number‑one success factor for this role and is treated as top priority for candidate review.

**Process Improvement:**

* Own and continuously optimize the enterprise incident management process in alignment with ITIL best practices and healthcare regulatory requirements.

**Vendor & Matrix Management:**

* Coordinate with third-party vendors and internal cross-functional teams (Network, Security, Clinical Apps) to ensure rapid service recovery.

**Monitoring and Alerting:**

* Utilize AIOps, triaging and monitoring tools, dashboards, and alerting systems across on-premise and cloud environments (e.g. SolarWinds, NetPath, ScienceLogic) to assist with MTTD and MTTR.

**Incident Response:**

* Serve as an escalation point for complex operational incidents, guiding technical teams to swift and effective resolution for critical monitoring issues.

**Performance Optimization:**

* Analyze monitoring data and performance metrics (MTTD, MTTA, MTTR, Incident Recurrence Rate, SLA Compliance) to identify trends, anomalies, and potential issues, providing recommendations for improvement and capacity planning.

**Automation:**

* Identify and implement automation opportunities for major incident management and routine tasks to reduce manual workload and improve efficiency.

**Collaboration and Documentation:**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Application, Network, Security, Cloud Enablement, Managed Service Provider, etc.) to maintain Major Incident Management comprehensive documentation, including standard operating procedures (SOPs) and runbooks.

**Problem Management:**

* Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) and post-incident reviews to prevent recurring issues and drive long-term solutions.

**Compliance and Security:**

* Ensure MIB processes comply with organizational security standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., SOC, HIPAA).

**Qualifications and Skills**

* 8+ years of progressive IT operations or enterprise support experience.
* 5-7+ years in IT major incident management or IT service management, with specific experience in healthcare environments and enterprise operations centers.
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, 5-7 years of technical experience in one or more of the following areas - Networking, Clinical Imaging devices and applications and EHR access fundamentals. Infrastructure experience is non-negotiable; candidates that worked MIMs without background in infrastructure will not be a fit. For example: prior Epic‑only or application‑only backgrounds without infrastructure experience will not meet requirements.
* Strong understanding of HIPAA and HITECH compliance regarding protected health information (PHI).
* Proven track record in managing large-scale, network or operations center with complex operations.
* In-depth knowledge of enterprise network architecture, data center operations, cloud environments, and relevant software/tools (e.g., ScienceLogic, Solar/Winds, SendWordNow, ServiceNow).

Soft skills are the first priority in candidate review-

* Excellent crisis leadership and decision-making abilities under pressure.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data and performance metrics to drive strategic decisions.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, capable of effective collaboration with stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Strong problem-solving and organizational skills, with a focus on details and time management.

**Education and Certifications:**

* A Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is required; an MBA or a related Master's degree is highly preferred.
* Preferred Qualifications and Certifications: ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
* Experience with industry-standard monitoring and observability tools (e.g., ScienceLogic, SolarWinds).

**Work Environment**

* Dynamic and collaborative work environment.
* May require off-hours work or participation in an on-call rotation to support operations.

* This role often operates in a dynamic, fast-paced, remote operations center and may require working irregular hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to help manage critical incidents and service delivery escalations.

1. Stakeholder Communication and personality fit
2. Technical Depth (infrastructure centric)
3. Relevant Senior Level Leadership Experience – not just years of experience but depth of what candidate has actually done in career

Title: Network Engineer II
Description:
iT1, a leading national technology solution provider headquartered in Tempe, AZ, is looking for a skilled and experienced Network Engineer II to join our Consulting team. iT1 has been ranked as one of Arizona’s Best Places to Work for over a decade, running in the Small Business category. This role is an exciting opportunity to continue your career in the IT consulting and managed services world. You will be exposed to many of the top technology offerings in the market and can work with some of the most talented engineers in the country.  
  
The Network Engineer II provides day-to-day operational support for the client’s in-scope network, connectivity, wireless, security, optical, voice, and unified communications infrastructure. With at least two years of relevant network support experience and hands-on Cisco ACI/APIC experience, the engineer monitors platform health, performs incident triage and routine troubleshooting, implements approved standard changes, maintains documentation, and escalates complex issues to senior engineers, carriers, or technology vendors. The role works closely with iT1 service management, the dedicated Client Success Manager, client stakeholders, and other technical teams.

 **Requirements**  

* Serve as a dedicated Tier 2 network support resource, resolving incidents within documented procedures and escalating complex or high-impact conditions to senior engineering resources.
* Provide operational support for routers, LAN and data center switches, firewalls, load balancers, network access control, WAN edge devices, VPN infrastructure, routing and switching protocols, VLANs, segmentation, QoS, and high-availability configurations.
* Provide hands-on Cisco ACI/APIC operational support, including fabric-health monitoring, fault and event triage, endpoint and EPG troubleshooting, VLAN/VXLAN connectivity. Escalate fabric design or high-risk changes to senior engineers.
* Monitor, investigate, and improve infrastructure availability and performance using health, capacity, telemetry, configuration, threshold, log, interface, latency, jitter, packet-loss, redundancy, and failover indicators where supported.
* Troubleshoot and manage Cisco SD-WAN controllers, edge devices, overlays, tunnels, internet circuits, and site-to-site or remote-access VPN services.
* Support wireless controllers and access-point infrastructure, including availability, registration, RF utilization indicators, authentication failures, roaming, interference, firmware status, configuration backup, security alerts, capacity, and coverage trends.
* Perform alert validation, incident triage, service-restoration actions, incident remediation, problem management, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, known-error tracking, and corrective-action follow-up.
* Implement approved standard changes and assist senior engineers with normal or emergency changes, including maintenance-window coordination, validation, rollback execution, closure documentation, and follow-up actions.
* Coordinate OS, firmware, and infrastructure patching activities within the approved scope, including planning, testing, rollout, validation, and vendor coordination.
* Maintain accurate HLD/LLD documentation, logical and physical diagrams, configuration records and backups, SOPs, runbooks, troubleshooting procedures, IPAM/DNS/DHCP records, inventories, monitoring definitions, change logs, and knowledge-base articles.
* Provide technical input for recurring service reviews, including infrastructure health, incident and alert trends, capacity, performance, lifecycle concerns, risks, documentation currency, vendor cases, and continuous-improvement recommendations.

**Introduction**

Women’s College Hospital (WCH) is seeking a dynamic, inspiring and visionary medical leader to lead the Department of Medicine and join the medical leadership team. The Department Head will advance innovative models of specialized ambulatory care and strengthen academic, interprofessional, and interorganizational collaboration to improve access, quality and health outcomes for women and gender-diverse people.

The Department Head will report to the Hospital President & CEO through the Vice President, Medical Affairs & System Transformation and Lead Medical Executive. The Department Head is responsible for aligning the Department of Medicine’s clinical, academic and research activities with the Hospital’s strategy, in partnership with the Clinical Director for Specialized Medicine programs. The Department Head works collaboratively with the Temerty Faculty of Medicine, the Toronto Academic Health Science Network (TAHSN), partner hospitals, and the Women’s College Hospital Foundation leadership team.

**The Department of Medicine**

The Department of Medicine at WCH advances the practice and science of medicine through holistic, innovative, and interprofessional approaches to complex health conditions and distinctive models of specialized ambulatory care. The Department advances care for conditions that disproportionately affect women and special populations, including through the specialized Dermatology, Menopause and After Cancer Treatment Transition Clinics.

The Department includes approximately 150 physician faculty members, including clinician teachers, educators, quality and innovation leaders, clinician investigators and clinician scientists. Its Specialized Medicine programs bring together nursing and health discipline professionals as well as clinical and academic administrative staff.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

The Department Head will lead the clinical, academic and resource oversight of the WCH Department of Medicine. More specifically, the Department Head will:

* Provide visionary leadership and operational oversight of the Department to advance the Hospital’s strategic plan and delivery of high-quality, equitable and integrated specialized ambulatory care.
* Build and lead a team of dedicated medical professionals committed to excellence in clinical care, clinical innovation, and continuous quality improvement through physician engagement and collaborative leadership.
* Pursue excellence and represent WCH in academic medicine by advancing the educational, research and scholarly objectives of the Temerty Faculty of Medicine.
* Participate actively in WCH medical leadership.
* Grow existing and build new partnerships to advocate for and advance the goals of WCH beyond its walls.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

The successful candidate will be:

* A Fellow of the Royal College of Physicians of Canada or equivalent, eligible for medical licensure in Ontario, and for an academic appointment at the rank of Associate or Full Professor in the Temerty Faculty of Medicine.
* An individual with a demonstrated record of supporting others engaged in education, research and creative professional activity, in addition to having their own strong record of scholarship.
* A dynamic, compassionate and people-oriented leader, who demonstrates an empathetic, trusting, and responsive demeanor, with strong mentorship skills and a demonstrated ability to communicate strategically, engage physicians and lead change collaboratively and with accountability.
* An individual experienced in interprofessional models of care and committed to interprofessional education and patient care.
* A person with a strong commitment to social justice, equity and the health of women, gender-diverse people and equity-seeking communities, both locally and globally.
* A person with demonstrated fiscal management and resource stewardship skills, with an emphasis on linking quality outcomes with optimizing costs.

  

**EXPECTATIONS & TERM**

The successful candidate will be an outstanding academic leader and clinician, with proven excellence in managing complex health care environments. Candidates should have a deep commitment to scholarly enterprise, with experience in advancing peer-reviewed research and education in Medicine.

Salary for the role of Department Head will reflect an expected 2.5 days per week commitment, in addition to clinical compensation and other academic support based, in part, on fee-for-service billings and sessional fees.

The appointment is generally for a term of five years. After successful completion of the initial five-year appointment, a University/Hospital review will be conducted with potential reappointment for a final five-year term.

The position deliberately splits attention: 70% product execution, 30% discipline accountability. Product delivery is the immediate, ongoing accountability; discipline work compounds over time and requires protected but smaller blocks of focus so it doesn't get crowded out by delivery pressure. This role sits at the center of Maestro's matrix structure, accountable for craft quality and standards company-wide, while ensuring embedded engineering talent on each product team is pointed at the right priorities.
  
  
**SCOPE • Org reach:** all engineering leads across all product lines report into this role (directly or via a lead layer), the senior-most engineering accountability in the company. • Product surface: full product suite, every active product line's engineering output. • Discipline surface: engineering-wide standards, tooling, and process, independent of which product team an engineer sits on. THE 70%: PRODUCT ACCOUNTABILITY The Head of Engineering is the single accountable owner for engineering execution across Maestro's product portfolio.
  
  
**What this looks like day to day:** • Partners with the engineering leads of every product line to ensure their teams are resourced against the right priorities: not just busy, but correctly sequenced. • Accountable for ensuring product strategy and roadmap direction are translated into clear, actionable engineering plans, serving as the connective layer between Product and Delivery leadership and the engineering organization, primarily through engineering leads embedded within product teams. • Accountable for applying technical judgment to turn high-level strategic priorities into concrete technical execution plans, enabling and guiding engineering leads to scope, sequence, and de-risk delivery across their product areas. • Identifies where product priorities and engineering capacity are misaligned across teams and resolves the tradeoff, including cross-team resourcing calls.
  
  

* Is the escalation point when a product line's engineering execution is off track, and is accountable for getting it back on track. Impact: Every product line ships against strategy, not just against what's easiest to build. Product and Delivery leaders have one accountable engineering partner instead of negotiating separately with each product line's lead. THE 30%: DISCIPLINE ACCOUNTABILITY The Head of Engineering owns what "good engineering" means at Maestro, independent of the product line.

**What this looks like day to day:** • Sets and maintains company-wide engineering standards (code quality, architecture principles, technical debt posture). • Owns cross-cutting technical initiatives that no single product team should solve independently, e.g. product suite services and universal QA automation. • Defines how AI tooling is used across engineering, including guardrails to ensure AI usage improves output quality and velocity rather than introducing risk or degrading craft.
  
  

* Identifies and removes friction in how engineering work gets done company-wide, streamlining processes that slow every team down in the same way. • Is the ultimate accountable owner for engineering management practice (how EMs lead, how performance is evaluated, how the craft is grown) even where day-to-day people management is embedded in product teams. Impact: Engineering quality, velocity, and management practice don't fragment by product line. An engineer's experience of "how we build software here" is consistent no matter which team they're on, and the org gets the benefits of scale (shared tooling, shared standards) instead of each team reinventing its own.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE • Engineers across the organization deliver flawless technical execution that earns long-term client retention and supports growth. • Product lines are resourced against strategic priority, with tradeoffs made explicitly rather than by default. • Engineering leads across product lines operate with a shared technical bar and shared tooling. • Company-wide initiatives (QA automation, AI usage standards) ship and get adopted, not just get designed.
  
  

* Engineering management practice is consistent and healthy across the org, even though EMs are embedded in product teams day to day. QUALIFICATIONS Maestro hires for demonstrated capability, not years-of-service checkboxes. The bar below is competency-based: what someone needs to be able to do, not how long they've been doing it. Required competencies: • Has personally carried end-to-end accountability for engineering delivery across more than one product or team simultaneously: not just led a single team, but balanced competing priorities across several.
* Can translate ambiguous, high-level strategy (from product, business, or leadership) into a technical execution plan that engineers can actually build against, without needing someone else to do that translation. • Has designed or materially improved an engineering standard, process, or tooling investment that worked across teams (not a single-team fix) and can point to the before/after. • Comfortably operates in a matrixed environment, influencing and aligning engineering leads, their teams, and cross-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority. • Has hands-on technical depth sufficient to earn credibility with senior engineers and to personally evaluate technical tradeoffs.

This is not a purely managerial role. • Has direct experience managing or mentoring engineering managers, not only individual contributors. • Demonstrates sound judgment on when to standardize company-wide versus when to let product teams operate with autonomy. Strongly preferred: • Experience operating at this scope inside a company of comparable size (roughly 15 to 50 engineers), where formal process is lighter and judgment calls happen more often than policy lookups.
  
  

* Direct experience setting a company's approach to AI-assisted engineering (tooling choices, guardrails, or usage standards) rather than just using AI tools personally. • A track record of building or scaling QA automation, testing strategy, or release process across multiple teams. • Experience partnering directly with Product and Delivery leadership as a peer, not just receiving requirements from them. • Experience leading engineering for always-on, customer-facing digital products or live-service platforms, where availability, release discipline, observability, incident response, and rapid cross-functional coordination directly affect the end-user experience and client retention.

**What we're explicitly not requiring:** • A specific prior title (VP Engineering, CTO, etc.). We care about scope actually carried, not the title it came with. • A minimum years-of-experience threshold. Competency and evidence of impact matter more than tenure.
  
  

* Deep expertise in every technology in Maestro's stack. Technical judgment and the ability to evaluate tradeoffs matter more than hands-on fluency in any one language or framework.
